event: this permanent enters the battlefield (own ETB)
multiplicity: per object (+1 copy per Panharmonicon-style extra trigger / additional-trigger effect)
notes: mixed: triggered + replacement + marker. Main check EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects (processLandETBEffects first runs land as-enters choices; processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers skips own ETB), queueing via EtbTriggerService#queueMandatoryETBEffects, gating via EtbEffectResolver#resolve (ChooseOneEffect unwrapped to cast-time etbMode, Kicked/CastFromZone/Prowl/Madness/Gift/Tribute/evoke etc. intervening-ifs unwrap or drop, gate conditions such as Metalcraft/Morbid stay wrapped, LoseGameIfNotCastFromHandEffect/ReturnSelfToHandIfDashCostPaidEffect/blitz riders dropped). Replacement-style classes read in place and filtered out of the trigger list: every ReplacementEffect implementer (isEntryReplacementEffect, also inside ConditionalEffect/ConditionalReplacementEffect) - in this slot mainly EnterWithCountersEffect, CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect, DevourEffect, AmplifyEffect, ChooseOpponentOnEnterEffect, ChoosePlayerOnEnterEffect, ChooseTwoPlayersOnEnterEffect, ChooseCardNameOnEnterEffect, ChooseNonlandPermanentOnEnterEffect, ChooseManaValueParityOnEnterEffect, ChoosePowerToughnessFormEffect, BecomeDayAsEntersEffect, PayAnyAmountOfLifeOnEnterEffect, MillAsEntersEffect, DiscardHandAsEntersEffect, DiscardCreatureCardsAsEntersForKeywordCountersEffect, SacrificeAllPermanentsAsEntersEffect, LoseLifeEqualToLifeTotalAsEntersEffect, FlipCoinOnEnterEffect, NoteControllerLifeTotalEffect, CreateEmblemAsEntersEffect, WerewhatOnEnterEffect, UpgradeEffect, CopyCreatureCardInExileOnEnterEffect, CopyCreatureCardFromGraveyardOnEnterEffect, MimeoplasmCopyOnEnterEffect, EnterWithKeywordEffect, EnterWithTokenAttachedEffect, EntersTappedEffect, ExileIfLeavesBattlefieldEffect, PutPhylacteryCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect, RollDiceAndEnterWithCountersEffect, Sacrifice*OnEnter*/RemoveAllCounters*ThenEnterWithCountersEffect; plus non-ReplacementEffect as-enters choices filtered by class: ChooseColorEffect, ChooseCardTypeOnEnterEffect, ChooseBasicLandTypeOnEnterEffect, ChooseCreatureOnEnterEffect, ChooseEquipmentAttachmentOnEnterEffect, ChoosePrimalClayFormOnEnterEffect, SubtypeChoiceOnEnterEffect, ChooseRandomNumberOnEnterEffect, ChooseModeOnEnterEffect, ChooseIndependentModesOnEnterEffect, DraftProteanWarEngineSpellbookEffect, DraftCardFromSpellbookToExileEffect (lands only - on a nonland it stays a trigger), BecomePreparedEffect(asTriggeredAbility=false). They are applied by BattlefieldPlacementService#applyEntryReplacementEffects (EntryReplacementHandlerRegistry, reads ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD + STATIC) / applyEnterWithCounters / applyEnterWithKeywords / applyEnterWithAttachedTokens, CloneService, AuraCopyService, AsEntersInteractionService, StackResolutionService#beginChoose*OnEnter, BattlefieldEntryService#begin*CardNameChoice. Grouping: all plain mandatory registrations share ONE stack object (and one target choice through the card's target filter/groups); each MayEffect is queued separately (graveyard-target, Soulbond, Puca's Mischief and no-legal-target special cases); each ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect (modal ETB of a non-cast permanent, or of a cast one with no declared mode) is its own TriggeredModalTrigger; each TriggerMode.INDEPENDENT registration and every granted/temporary/persistent/perpetual ETB is its own object; SacrificeSelfIfEvokedEffect is its own object; OncePerTurnTriggerEffect is unwrapped. Inside the shared group, graveyard-targeting effect kinds (ExileGraveyardCardsEffect, CastTargetInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardEffect, ReturnTargetCards*, etc.) and spell-targeting effects are split off into their own target-choice triggers. SURPRISE: if the mandatory group contains an ExileCardsFromGraveyardEffect, otherEffects becomes empty and the whole mandatory list rides along with the graveyard-exile targeting flow. SURPRISE (suspected rules issue): a cast permanent's modal ChooseOneEffect ETB uses the mode declared at cast time (etbMode) rather than choosing when the trigger is put on the stack. SURPRISE: no single choke point - ~140 call sites call processCreatureETBEffects directly plus ~156 handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield calls. Also read as a presence marker elsewhere (StepTriggerService/TurnCleanupService look for RememberTargetPlayerEffect/ChooseOpponentOnEnterEffect; PermanentRemovalService#handleExileReturnOnLeave; AI/target services).

The same loop also reads UPKEEP_TRIGGERED from face-up schemes. No face-down command-zone check (the end-step command-zone readers have one)

event: beginning of your upkeep
notes: StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers: active player's graveyard only, via GameQueryService#getEffectiveGraveyardEffects (global graveyard ability loss, perpetual grants). Intervening-if checked at trigger time; graveyard-target effects -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger; MayPayManaEffect/MayEffect -> queueMayAbility bound to this graveyard stay; else stack entry with graveyard entry version (SourceCardInGraveyard rebound). One per registration

event: beginning of each upkeep
notes: StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers eachUpkeep lambda over all battlefields + face-up schemes (forEachFaceUpSchemeSource): printed + temporary + persistent + GrantedUpkeepEffectSupport#appendGrantedEachUpkeepEffects, skipped if hasLostAllAbilities. UpkeepPlayerDependentEffect#triggersFor gate; intervening-if; any-target -> UpkeepAnyTargetTrigger, player-target -> UpkeepPlayerTargetTrigger, graveyard-target -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger, untargeted MayEffect -> queueMayAbility (ACTIVE_PLAYER choice supported), permanent-target -> UpkeepPermanentTargetTrigger (active player may choose), else stack entry with active player as targetId; one per registration. Also planes via PlanechaseService#step. SURPRISE: no isFaceDown check (face-down permanents keep their real Card, so a manifested card's printed ability would trigger) and no AdditionalTriggeredAbilityEffect copy scope. TargetLegalityService#targetPredicateController re-reads the slot to evaluate 'opponent' from the active player for Oath-style MayEffects

event: beginning of each upkeep
notes: StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers: scans all exiled cards with time counters that are suspended (exiledCardsWithNonSuspendTimeCounters excluded unless suspended from hand); controller = owner; MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else stack entry with active player as targetId. No intervening-if check at trigger time (Curse of the Cabal's ConditionalEffect only re-checked on resolution)

event: beginning of owner's upkeep (card in exile with scream counters)
notes: StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers: for each exiled card owned by the active player with exiledCardScreamCounters > 0, every registration goes straight to gameData.stack.add. Draft family 12 is wrong: this is an upkeep step trigger whose source happens to be in exile. Reads card.getEffects only (no perpetual grants), no may/intervening-if handling. Only user All Hallow's Eve.

event: beginning of owner's upkeep (card in exile)
notes: StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers: every exiled card owned by the active player; reads card.getEffects plus perpetualTriggeredAbilityGrants (Tawnos Endures registers nothing itself, it perpetually grants this slot). Intervening-if ConditionalEffect checked at trigger time; MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else direct stack.add. Draft family 12 is wrong (step trigger). Also read as a presence marker by the egg-counter upkeep path (skips the built-in RemoveEggCounterFromExileAndReturnEffect trigger when this slot already has one) and written at runtime by ConjureDarigaazShivanChampionSpellbookEffectHandler (card.addEffect on the conjured card).

event: a time counter is removed from this card while it is exiled
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkTimeCounterRemovedFromExiledCardTriggers dispatches each registration with sourceCard. Called from RemoveTimeCounterFromExiledCardEffectHandler#removeTimeCounter and RemoveSuspendCounterFromExiledSpellEffectHandler. The ExiledCardTriggerCollectorService default handler re-reads the slot and queues every registration as one entry, but only on the first registration's dispatch (later ones return true without queuing); a targeted effect goes to SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget. ConditionalEffect(NotCondition(SourceCardSuspended)) is the 'last counter' gate (remaining==0); YouRemoveTimeCounterFromExiledCardTriggerEffect gates on who removed it. SURPRISE: RemoveSuspendCounterFromExiledSpellEffectHandler only calls the check when the last counter comes off, so suspendedSpellExiles cards miss intermediate 'a time counter is removed' triggers. The bundling also needs the first registration to pass its own gate: a failing first conditional suppresses the rest, and later last-counter conditionals are not re-checked.

event: beginning of each opponent's upkeep
relation: opponent (active player is not the controller), or the chosen player
notes: StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers: all battlefields + face-up schemes; skips face-down and hasLostPrintedAbilities. If the card has RememberTargetPlayerEffect / ChooseOpponentOnEnterEffect it fires only on the CHOSEN player's upkeep (fallback: opponent of original controller) and can then fire on the controller's own turn if that player is chosen. Intervening-if, DealDamageIfFewCardsInHandEffect and ActivePlayerHand* conditions checked at trigger time; permanent-target effects -> UpkeepPermanentTargetTrigger, else non-targeting stack entry with the upkeep player as targetId; one per registration. No copy scope

event: spell cast
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers (many cast sites): dispatchSlot over every battlefield, dispatchFaceUpSchemes (command zone), planes (planechase controller), and TriggerCollectionService#collectTemporaryGlobalSpellCastTriggers (temporary global watchers registered by e.g. Nuka-Nuke Launcher; enqueued with caster as targetId). dispatchSlot: isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn / static losesAll(NonMana)Abilities / hasLostPrintedAbilities (printed only), text-change transform, OncePerTurn unwrap, plus granted triggered effects; one registry dispatch per registration with AdditionalTriggeredAbilityEffect copies. ~35 handlers (SpellCastTriggerCollectorService, PlayedCardNameTriggerCollectorService); each SpellCastTriggerEffect carries its own resolvedEffects list = one ability; MayEffect handling is per handler (wrapped on stack, or PendingMayAbility cast-time prompt for targeted/X cases). No default handler, but every registered class has one. No face-down check in dispatchSlot

event: spell cast
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers (many cast sites): dispatchSlot over the caster's battlefield, TriggerCollectionService#dispatchDepartedManaSourceSpellCastTriggers (LKI of a departed mana source, only SpellCastTriggerEffect.requiresManaProducedBySource riders), face-up schemes, planes, collectTemporaryControllerSpellCastTriggers (temporary watchers) and processDelayedControllerSpellCastTriggers. ~52 handler classes; all registered classes (incl. OncePerTurn>May>X and SourceHasChosenMode ConditionalEffect) resolve to a handler. Also read by TriggeredAbilityQueueService#triggerOrderLabel (labels), SpecializeGaleEffectHandler (adds to specialized card). No face-down check in dispatchSlot

event: you set a scheme in motion
multiplicity: per scheme set in motion (dispatched up to 3x under the next-scheme replacement)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSchemeSetInMotionTriggers dispatches the setting player's battlefield + dispatchFaceUpSchemes; only handler SchemeTriggerCollectorService#handleSchemeSetInMotion (SchemeSetInMotionTriggerEffect with optional schemeFilter; its resolvedEffects bundled into one non-targeting entry); other effect classes ignored. SURPRISE: the only main-code caller is AbandonSchemeAndSetTriggeringSchemeInMotionAgainEffectHandler (My Laughter Echoes replay) - no archenemy turn path reaches it; card tests call it directly. Plots That Span Centuries uses this slot unfiltered as its own 'when you set this scheme in motion'. With the 3-schemes replacement the same schemeEntry is dispatched 3 times.

event: you give a gift
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerGivesGiftTriggers (dispatchSlot over the giver's permanents) called only from TargetOpponentCreatesTokenEffectHandler, EachOtherPlayerDrawsCardEffectHandler and ConjureCardToOpponentBattlefieldEffectHandler - gift detection lives in effect handlers, no central choke point. Default handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerGivesGift: one enqueued entry per registration, no target step.

event: you solve a Case
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCaseSolvesTriggers from SolveSourceEffectHandler. Bypasses dispatch: printed effects only, TriggeringCardConditionalEffect filtered against the Case card, one enqueued entry per registration with triggeringPermanentId = Case. No ability-loss check and no granted, once-per-turn or target handling.

event: you foretell a card
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerForetellTriggers called only from the GameService foretell special action. Only handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleForetellBoostSelf (BoostSelfEffect); no default handler, so any other effect class registered here never triggers.

event: one or more cards exiled from hand
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCardsExiledFromHandTriggers -> dispatchSlot over the hand owner's battlefield -> MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerExileTriggers (direct stack.add, eventValue = count). ~18 callers (SpellCastingService, CardChoiceHandlerService, ChoiceHandlerService, AbilityActivationService, GameService, PutCardsFromHandOnLibraryCardChoiceInteractionHandler). SURPRISE: fires whoever caused the exile (e.g. an opponent's reveal-and-exile in CardChoiceHandlerService#handleRevealCardsDiscardChosen) although Hero of Bretagard says 'you exile'; that caller also passes count 1 even when several cards were exiled. Hero/Ranar register the same effect here and in ON_CONTROLLER_SPELL_OR_ABILITY_EXILES_PERMANENT, so one event exiling from both zones gives two triggers.

event: exiled from the battlefield by your resolving spell or ability
relation: you (controller of the resolving spell/ability); exiled permanent any controller
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerSpellOrAbilityExilesPermanentTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToExile and #processGraveyardAndTriggers (graveyard-replaced-by-exile); exiler = currentlyResolvingControllerId or pendingEffectResolutionEntry controller (exile as a cost does not count). MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerExileTriggers, direct stack.add, eventValue 1. SURPRISE (suspected rules bug): Ranar's 'exiles one or more permanents' is one trigger per event, but the collector runs once per exiled permanent, so a mass exile makes several Spirits (Hero's counter total is still right). No look-back for watchers exiled in the same event.

event: spell copied
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCopyTriggers, called only from CopySupport (3 copy-to-stack sites; Paradigm copy-and-cast is a card copy and does not fire it). Abilities ignored. dispatchSlot per permanent of the copying player; only handler SpellCopyTriggerEffect (SpellCastTriggerCollectorService#handleSpellCopyTrigger): instant/sorcery unless allSpellTypes, optional copiedSpellCondition/spellFilter, then targeted or non-targeting entry

event: spell copied
relation: opponent (any player other than the copy's controller)
notes: Same TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCopyTriggers loop (else-branch for non-copying players) and same SpellCopyTriggerEffect handler as ON_CONTROLLER_COPIES_SPELL; fired only from CopySupport

event: spell countered
relation: you (controller of the countering spell or ability)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCountersSpellTriggers from CounterSupport#notifyCounteredSpell (countered abilities return early; copies included). dispatchSlot over the countering player's battlefield; CardEffect default handler CounterTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerCountersSpell enqueues one entry per registration (MayEffect resolves on the stack)

event: spell countered
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerSpellCounteredTriggers from CounterSupport#notifyCounteredSpell, skipped for copies, keyed on target.getCasterId(); dispatchSlot over the caster's battlefield; default handler enqueues one entry per registration

event: this spell countered or fizzles (all targets illegal)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSelfSpellCounteredOrFizzledTriggers from CounterSupport#notifyCounteredSpell and the fizzle branch of StackResolutionService (after removal from the stack); instant/sorcery entries only, copies included; source is the spell card (no permanent). SURPRISE: only handler is CopyThisSpellWhenCounteredOrFizzlesEffect (Trial and Error) and there is no default, so any other effect class here is silently dropped

event: land played
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerPlaysLandTriggers (land-play sites only: SpellCastingService, MayCastHandlerService, ChoiceHandlerService, PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService, CloneService, BrilliantUltimatumSupport): dispatchSlot over the playing player's battlefield (the just-played land is already there and counts), planes for the planar controller, collectTemporaryControllerLandPlayTriggers (TemporaryGlobalTriggerEffect watchers). Handlers in PlayedCardNameTriggerCollectorService etc.; CardEffect default PlayedCardNameTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerPlaysLandDefault pushes the bare effect with the playing player as non-targeting targetId (no target selection; a bare TriggeringCardConditionalEffect is rejected there and needs its own handler). The default dereferences match.permanent(), so a bare effect on a plane would NPE (planes currently use PlayedCardExiledWithPlanarSourceTriggerEffect)

event: land played
notes: Same loop in TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerPlaysLandTriggers (land-play sites only: SpellCastingService, MayCastHandlerService, ChoiceHandlerService, PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService, CloneService, BrilliantUltimatumSupport): dispatched only when perm.getOriginalCard() is not the played land; not read for planes or temporary watchers. Only the CardEffect default handler (City of Traitors' SacrificeSelfEffect)

event: land played
relation: opponent (any player other than the land player)
notes: Else-branch of TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerPlaysLandTriggers (land-play sites only: SpellCastingService, MayCastHandlerService, ChoiceHandlerService, PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService, CloneService, BrilliantUltimatumSupport) plus planes when the land player is not the planar controller. Handlers: TriggeringCardConditionalEffect, DrawCardForTargetPlayerEffect, LandPlayFromExileTriggerEffect, PlayedCardExiledWithSource*; CardEffect default handleOpponentPlaysLandDefault pushes the bare effect with the land player as non-targeting targetId

event: spell cast
relation: opponent (any player other than the caster)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers (many cast sites): dispatchSlot over every non-caster battlefield, face-up schemes of non-casters, and TriggerCollectionService#dispatchSuspendedExiledCardSpellCastTriggers (suspended exiled cards with time counters owned by a non-caster, e.g. Deep-Sea Kraken; so zone is also exile). 23 handler classes incl. ConditionalEffect and DealDamageToPlayersEffect/MillEffect; all registered classes covered. No face-down check

event: this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield ('dies' for creatures, any permanent type)
zone: battlefield (look-back; collected after it reached the graveyard)
notes: mixed: also holds 'when you sacrifice this' (effects with onlyTriggersOnSacrifice(), e.g. SacrificeOnlyEffect) collected by TriggerCollectionService#collectSelfSacrificedTriggers from checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers instead of the death path, and HauntEffect on instants/sorceries fired on spell resolution by TriggerCollectionService#collectSpellHauntTrigger (StackResolutionService). Main check TriggerCollectionService#collectDeathTrigger: printed (minus perpetually removed; skipped if face-down or lost-abilities-until-EOT), temporary, persistent/delayed and attachment-granted effects, each dispatched separately to DeathTriggerCollectorService (handleDeathDefault, handleDeathMayEffect, handleDeathMayPayMana, modal-at-trigger-time, many specific). Choke points: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers (from removePermanentToGraveyard / processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard; batches via performSimultaneousRemovals and DepartureService), PermanentRemovalService#removeOrphanedAuras / enforceAttachmentLegality (call with dyingPermanent=null, so granted/temporary death effects are lost there). Overlaps ON_SELF_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD_FROM_BATTLEFIELD (same event, different choke point).

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkHauntedCreatureDeathTriggers (from PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers when the permanent went to a graveyard): all non-modal effects form ONE ability (one DeathTriggerTarget if any effect targets, else one stack entry); each TriggeredModalEffect is its own TriggeredModalTrigger. Controlled by the haunting card's owner. Not registry-dispatched; no doublers.

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
relation: another you control (watchers include simultaneously dying permanents of that controller)
multiplicity: per object; BatchedCreatureDeathTriggerEffect -> per event via collectBatchedAllyCreatureDeathTriggers
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreatureDeathTriggers. Self: the dying permanent is skipped iff its printed card has type CREATURE; a printed noncreature that was animated is explicitly added as a watcher and sees its own death. SURPRISE: the batched path TriggerCollectionService#collectBatchedAllyCreatureDeathTriggers always excludes the watcher's own death, so an animated noncreature behaves differently in single vs batched deaths. Grouping: targeted effects -> own DeathTriggerTarget each; MayEffect/MayPayManaEffect/MayPayLifeEffect -> dispatch (handleAllyCreatureMay/MayPay) each; TriggeringCard/TriggeringPermanent-conditional registrations -> own stack entry each; all remaining plain registrations share ONE stack entry (no CardEffect default handler for this slot). Also temporary global watchers (collectTemporaryGlobalAllyCreatureDeathTriggers) and Relic Vial look-back grants. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers; batch from performSimultaneousRemovals/DepartureService -> checkBatchedAllyCreatureDeathTriggers.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield (one or more, one event)
object: artifact or creature (printed or granted types)
notes: Single death: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (skipped when the permanent is in simultaneousDyingPermanents) dispatches for every permanent of the dying controller plus the dying permanent itself; batch: TriggerCollectionService#checkBatchedAllyArtifactOrCreatureDeathTriggers -> collectBatchedAllyArtifactOrCreatureDeathTrigger (once per watcher, first matching death, eventContainsCreature flag; dying watchers included). SURPRISE: only OneOrMoreArtifactOrCreatureDeathTriggerEffect has a handler (no CardEffect default), so any other effect class registered here never triggers. Type check uses printed+granted types, not layer-effective types. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers / removeOrphanedAuras; performSimultaneousRemovals, DepartureService.

event: creature put into a graveyard from the battlefield (dies), keyed to the graveyard owner
relation: put into your graveyard (watcher controller = owner; creature may be controlled by anyone)
notes: Borderline 11/12: it is a creature death but owner-keyed and coded with the permanent-to-graveyard family (AnyPermanentGraveyard context). TriggerCollectionService#checkCreaturePutIntoOwnersGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers (wasCreature branch); dispatchSlot over the owner's battlefield + simultaneousDyingPermanents of the owner + the dying creature itself (look-back). TriggerCollectionService#dispatchSlotEffect special-cases this slot: TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect with PermanentPowerAtMostPredicate/PermanentToughnessAtLeastPredicate is judged from LKI power/toughness, everything else via unwrapCreatureDeathConditional, plus intervening-if. No default handler: only 7 effect classes (MayEffect is put on the stack directly, MayPayManaEffect -> queueMayAbility, ReturnDyingCreatureToOwnerHandUnlessTargetPaysLifeEffect -> queueInteraction, others stack/enqueue). The same method also fires GRAVEYARD_ON_CREATURE_PUT_INTO_*_GRAVEYARD slots.

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
relation: another you control (incl. simultaneously dying watchers)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreatureOrPlaneswalkerDeathTriggers: dying permanent is not on the battlefield and is excluded from the simultaneous watcher list by id. MayEffect/MayPayManaEffect/MayPayLifeEffect -> dispatch (handleAllyCreatureOrPlaneswalkerMay) each; all other registrations share ONE stack entry with no target routing (a targeted non-may effect would get no target). Creature-death doublers only when wasCreature. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers.

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
object: creature dealt damage this turn by the source (or by the creature this Equipment is attached to)
notes: GraveyardService#triggerDamagedCreatureDiesAbilities -> enqueueDamagedCreatureDiesTriggers, run from GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard (updateThisTurnBattlefieldToGraveyardTracking) when a creature card arrives from the battlefield - SURPRISE: collected at graveyard arrival in GraveyardService, not in PermanentRemovalService with the other death slots. Self: not excluded, but a source that dies is only found if it is in simultaneousDyingCreatures (batched death) - a lone self-death never sees itself. Printed + temporary + granted effects; TriggeringPermanentConditional checked; targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else direct stack.add (MayEffect stays inside the entry). Equipment variant: Equipment currently attached to the damaging creature (its own controller is 'you').

event: deals combat damage to a player
relation: this; enchanted/equipped creature when on an Aura/Equipment; any creature dealing combat damage to the enchanted player when on a player-attached Curse
multiplicity: per object (per dealer per damaged player per combat damage step)
notes: readers disagree: CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers (creature path, merged with ON_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER/ON_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT) = each (one object/interaction per registration; untargeted MayEffect -> queueMayAbility; many effect-class special cases; intervening-if gated; face-down/lost-all/unattached noncreature Equipment skip printed effects); checkAttachedCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers = all (an attachment's effects share ONE object/interaction; SURPRISE: the attachment's ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER is ignored if it also has ON_EQUIPPED_CREATURE_DEALS_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER - two parallel mechanisms); checkPlayerAttachedCurseCombatDamageTriggers = each, but only effects with SOURCE_SELF/DAMAGED_PLAYER CombatDamageTriggerContext fire (others silently ignored). Cipher/Specialize handlers only add registrations.

event: deals combat damage to a creature
multiplicity: per object (per damaged creature per damage step)
notes: CombatDamageService#finishCombatDamageStep collects, processCombatDamageToCreatureTriggers queues one stack object per registration per damaged creature, the damaged creature baked as non-targeting targetId (no target selection, no may queueing); CombatExcessDamageAwareEffect only when excess > 0. SURPRISE: printed effects are read with no face-down or lost-abilities check.

event: deals combat damage to one or more blocking creatures
multiplicity: per event (once per source per damage step)
notes: CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToBlockingCreatureTriggers: when combatDamageToBlockingCreatureSources contains the source, one non-targeting entry per registration; no face-down/lost-ability check, no target/may handling.

event: deals damage (combat or noncombat) to a player
relation: this; enchanted/equipped creature when on an attachment
multiplicity: combat: per dealer per damaged player per step; noncombat: per damage event
notes: combat: merged into CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers (each) and checkAttachedCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers (all); noncombat: TriggerCollectionService#checkSourceDealsDamageToPlayerTriggers (from DamageSupport) -> queueNoncombatDamageToPlayerEffect per effect (each; attachments each too). SURPRISE: the noncombat path evaluates ANY ConditionalEffect at trigger time and unwraps it (combat gates only intervening-if), uses only hasLostAllAbilities (no face-down check) and ignores temporary/persistent ON_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER grants that the combat path includes.

event: deals damage (combat or noncombat) to an opponent
relation: this (or enchanted/equipped creature when on an attachment); damaged player is an opponent of the source's controller (of the attachment's controller in attached paths)
multiplicity: combat: per dealer per damaged player per step; noncombat: per damage event
notes: Same readers as ON_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER: combat creature path each, combat attached path all, noncombat checkSourceDealsDamageToPlayerTriggers each (with the same trigger-time unwrap of any ConditionalEffect). Opponent test = dealer controller != damaged player.

event: this creature is declared as an attacker
relation: this; enchanted/equipped creature when on an Aura/Equipment
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration: many event/intervening-if conditions filtered and unwrapped at trigger time; each untargeted MayEffect queued separately (queueMayAbility); trigger-time modals (ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect, ChooseModeNotChosenDuringLastCombatEffect) separate TriggeredModalTriggers; remaining printed effects share ONE stack object/targeting interaction except TriggerMode.INDEPENDENT regs (separate; not honoured in the graveyard-target path); granted/temporary effects separate; Decayed separate. An animated Equipment's own printed ON_ATTACK is ignored when it attacks. Attachments: CombatTriggerService#checkAuraTriggersForCreature (all-but-independent; an Aura's ON_ATTACK counts as granted to the creature unless isAttackTriggerOwnedByAura). Draft 'one or more (batch)' is wrong.

event: this creature becomes blocked
relation: this; enchanted/equipped creature when on an attachment
multiplicity: NORMAL/ONCE_PER_BLOCK: once per attacker when it becomes blocked; PER_BLOCKER: once per blocker
notes: CombatBlockService#fireCreatureBecomesBlockedTriggers -> pushRegularBecomesBlockedTriggers: non-PER_BLOCKER regs share ONE object (2+ Bushido split; any graveyard- or permanent/player-targeted effect turns the whole group into one interaction); PER_BLOCKER regs per blocker: plain ones share an object, each TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect separate; continuously granted effects separate. ONCE_PER_BLOCK behaves as NORMAL here. Other readers: collectEffectBecomesBlockedTriggers (effect-made blocks), markTokenAsBlocking, fireBecomesBlockedTriggersWithoutBlockers (PER_BLOCKER skipped), checkDelayedBecomesBlockedTriggers; attachments via CombatTriggerService#checkAuraTriggersForCreature + checkAttachedPerBlockerTriggers. Only lost-printed-abilities checked, no face-down check.

event: attacks and isn't blocked (once blocks are locked in)
notes: CombatBlockService#collectUnblockedAttackTriggers (after blocker declaration, or at once when no blocks are possible): printed effects form one group; permanent-targeting MayEffect/MayPayManaEffect each a separate AttackTriggerTarget; the rest one non-targeting entry with the defending player as targetId; 2+ spell target groups -> one ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger; granted instances separate. No trigger-time intervening-if evaluation; hasLostAllAbilities only (no face-down check). SURPRISE: that hasLostAllAbilities 'continue' also skips the attacker's Auras' ON_ENCHANTED_CREATURE_ATTACKS_UNBLOCKED triggers. isBlocked only checks the single defenderId's battlefield.

event: enchanted creature attacks and isn't blocked
notes: CombatBlockService#collectEnchantedCreatureUnblockedTriggers (called inside collectUnblockedAttackTriggers): permanent-targeting MayEffects each a separate AttackTriggerTarget; all other registrations share one non-targeting entry (sourcePermanentId = attacker, targetId = defending player). Not restricted to Auras; no lost-ability check on the attachment. SURPRISE: never fires while the enchanted creature has lost all abilities (skipped by the parent loop), although it is the Aura's own ability.

event: beginning of your draw step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleDrawStepTriggers: active player's battlefield, printed only (no temporary/persistent/granted), skips face-down and hasLostPrintedAbilities; intervening-if; targeted MayEffect -> UpkeepPermanentTargetTrigger, MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else stack entry with active player as targetId (no target selection for non-may targeted effects). SURPRISE: PutCountersOnUntapLockedPermanentsEffect (Giant Oyster) is skipped there and re-read by a second loop over ALL battlefields keyed on the lock activator (untapLockActivatorBySource), i.e. a delayed trigger stored in this slot. Also planes via PlanechaseService#drawStep. No copy scope

event: beginning of each draw step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleDrawStepTriggers: all battlefields, printed only, hasLostPrintedAbilities (SURPRISE: no isFaceDown check); DrawCardForTargetPlayerEffect.requireSourceUntapped and OpponentDrawStepOnlyEffect gates; every effect pushed straight to the stack with the active player as targetId (targeting unless DrawCardForTargetPlayerEffect !targetsPlayer or PutHandOnBottomOfLibraryAndDrawEffect) - no target choice, no special MayEffect path. Also planes via PlanechaseService#drawStep

event: draw-step draw
notes: Detected by effect class (IslandSanctuaryEffect, FastingEffect) in DrawService#findMaySkipDrawSource and StepTriggerService#findMaySkipDrawStepDrawSources; the same check reads MaySkipDrawReplacementEffect from STATIC, so the replacement already lives in two slots.

event: would draw a card
notes: Dredge (DredgeEffect, 14 cards), read by DredgeSupport#dredgeEffect.

event: beginning of each end step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: every player's permanents + face-up schemes in APNAP order; printed + persistent only (no temporary, no GrantedTriggeredAbilitySupport grants), skipped if face-down or hasLostPrintedAbilities. MonarchEndStepTriggeredEffect gate; intervening-if; ~15 condition/effect-specific branches (Impatience, Razor Pendulum, Morbid, Raid-like etc.); untargeted MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, declared target -> EndStepTriggerTarget/ETBTokenMultiTarget interaction, else stack entry (EndStepPlayerTargetedEffect bakes the active player). One per registration. Also planes via PlanechaseService#step; CopyControllerCastSpellEffectHandler adds SacrificeSelfEffect here for token copies. No AdditionalTriggeredAbilityEffect copy scope

event: beginning of each end step
relation: each player (every end step); card in its owner's graveyard
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: every player's graveyard in APNAP order via getEffectiveGraveyardEffects, merged in one list with GRAVEYARD_CONTROLLER_END_STEP_TRIGGERED. Any ConditionalEffect is checked at trigger time regardless of its interveningIf flag (and kept for resolution); MayEffect -> queueMayAbility bound to the graveyard stay, else stack entry with triggering card id + graveyard entry version. One per registration

event: beginning of your end step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: added to the GRAVEYARD_END_STEP_TRIGGERED list only for the active player's graveyard; otherwise identical handling (ConditionalEffect always checked at trigger time, MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else stack entry bound to the graveyard stay)

event: beginning of your end step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: active player's permanents + face-up schemes; printed (not if face-down) + temporary + persistent, all dropped by hasLostAllAbilities, then GrantedTriggeredAbilitySupport grants added regardless. If 2+ effects, 2+ spell target groups and every effect has a target index and targets -> ALL in one ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger; otherwise one per registration: intervening-if pre-check, ChooseOneAtTriggerTime/ChooseModeNotYetChosen/ChooseOne -> TriggeredModalTrigger, Raid and other ConditionalEffect branches, MayEffect/MayPayManaEffect -> queueMayAbility or EndStepTriggerTarget, random-target effects -> pushRandomlyTargetedControllerEndStepTrigger, targeted -> EndStepTriggerTarget/ETBTokenMultiTarget, else stack entry (DamageDealingEffect on an Aura bakes enchanted controller). Also planes via PlanechaseService#step. Grant writers: LibraryChoiceHandlerService (return-to-hand), Specialize/conjure handlers. No AdditionalTriggeredAbilityEffect copy scope

event: beginning of your end step
notes: mixed: also a marker. StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: active player's command zone, face-down command-zone cards skipped, intervening-if, one stack entry per registration. SURPRISE: zero card classes register it, and GameSetupService#initializeGame uses non-emptiness of this slot as the 'starts in the command zone' marker (conspiracies are pulled out of the deck)

event: beginning of each end step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: every player's command zone in APNAP order (face-up only; Dark Wings Bring Your Downfall scheme); intervening-if checked with ConditionContext.forCard; one stack entry per registration, controller = command-zone owner

event: beginning of each opponent's end step
relation: opponent (active player is not the controller)
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: every non-active player's permanents + face-up schemes. Any ConditionalEffect checked at trigger time (context targetId = end-step player) regardless of interveningIf; stack entry with the end-step player as non-targeting targetId; one per registration (Keeper of the Accord's two abilities stay separate). SURPRISE: no face-down and no ability-loss check at all; no copy scope

event: you draw a card
notes: DrawService#checkControllerDrawTriggers -> checkControllerDrawTriggerSlot, called from DrawService#completeDrawCard (single draw choke point). Planes are read by checkPlanarDrawTriggers when the planar controller draws. Reads printed (unless hasLostAllAbilities) + granted. Per registration it handles OncePerTurn/OnceOnly, the ExceptFirstDrawStep/FirstDrawStepDrawOnly/FirstDrawReveal/DrawReveal/DrawnCard/DrawTrigger wrappers, triggersOnControllerDrawCount, intervening-if and the Diviner's Wand gate; copies come from countAdditionalDrawTriggeredAbilityTriggers. Paths: non-targeting MayEffect -> queueMayAbility; player/any target -> DrawTriggerAnyTarget; permanent target -> DrawTriggerPermanentTarget/SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget; else direct stack.add (targetId=drawer). SURPRISE: NthCardDrawTriggerEffect(2, ...) here on about 9 cards duplicates ON_CONTROLLER_DRAWS_SECOND_CARD. RevealDrawnCardIfInstantOrSorceryEffect is not a trigger at all: it is pushed straight onto pendingMayAbilities.

event: you draw your second card of the turn
multiplicity: once per turn (on the draw that makes cardsDrawnThisTurn == 2)
notes: Same DrawService#checkControllerDrawTriggerSlot as ON_CONTROLLER_DRAWS (all wrappers and effect-class paths apply). checkControllerDrawTriggers gates it on cardsDrawnThisTurn == 2. No planar reader. SURPRISE: there is a second encoding of the same trigger, NthCardDrawTriggerEffect(2, ...) on ON_CONTROLLER_DRAWS.

event: this card's owner draws their second card of the turn
notes: DrawService#checkGraveyardControllerDrawTriggerSlot, called from checkControllerDrawTriggers when cardsDrawnThisTurn == 2. Scans only the drawing player's graveyard and is skipped when graveyardCardsHaveLostAllAbilities. One enqueueTrigger per registration (MayPayManaEffect stays wrapped for resolution), recording triggeringCardId and the graveyard entry version. Only triggersOnControllerDrawCount is honored; no other wrappers.

event: an opponent of this card's owner draws their second card of the turn
multiplicity: once per turn per drawing opponent
notes: DrawService#checkGraveyardOpponentDrawTriggerSlot, called at the end of checkOpponentDrawTriggers; scans every other player's graveyard. DrawTriggerEffect unwrapped. A MayEffect stays on the enqueued stack entry, whereas battlefield ON_OPPONENT_DRAWS uses queueMayAbility. Unlike the controller-side twin it records no triggering card or graveyard entry version.

event: an opponent draws a card
notes: DrawService#checkOpponentDrawTriggers (from completeDrawCard) scans every other battlefield, skips hasLostAllAbilities and reads no granted triggers. Handles OncePerTurn/OnceOnly, ExceptFirstDrawStep, DrawReveal and DrawTrigger (NthCardDrawTriggerEffect) wrappers, intervening-if with targetId=drawer, and draw-trigger copies. Paths: MayEffect -> queueMayAbility; player/any target -> DrawTriggerAnyTarget; else direct stack.add with targetId=drawing player, nonTargeting. checkPlanarDrawTriggers reads it for planes when a non-planar-controller draws (MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else enqueueTrigger).

event: enchanted player draws a card
notes: DrawService#checkEnchantedPlayerDrawTriggers (from completeDrawCard) finds Auras attached to the drawing player on any battlefield. DrawTriggerEffect unwrapped; draw-trigger copies applied. MayEffect -> queueMayAbility without a source permanent id; else direct stack.add with targetId=drawer. No ability-loss check and no granted triggers.

event: an opponent discards a card (cycling included)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkDiscardTriggers (central discard hook) scans every other battlefield and skips hasLostAllAbilities. It unwraps TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (dropped when the card went to the library unrevealed), then calls dispatchSlotEffect. DiscardTriggerCollectorService has many class-keyed handlers but no default CardEffect handler, so unlisted effect classes silently never trigger. Some are recipient-restricted: DealDamageToPlayersEffect only TRIGGERING_PLAYER, LoseLifeEffect only TRIGGERING_PLAYER/CONTROLLER. MayEffect -> direct stack.add; others enqueueTrigger. SURPRISE: collectTemporaryGlobalDiscardTriggers reuses this slot with the opposite meaning for a TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility (Pure Intentions): it fires when the watcher's own controller is made to discard by an opponent (discardCausedByOpponent).

event: you forage
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkForageTriggers; callers SpellCastingService (forage costs), AbilityActivationService (forage costs), ForageTriggerEffectHandler. Default handler ForageTriggerCollectorService#handleForage: one enqueued entry per registration, no target step.

event: you discard a card (cycling included)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkDiscardTriggers, own-battlefield loop. Unwraps TriggeringCardConditionalEffect and OncePerTurnTriggerEffect (firstCycling and FIRST_NONLAND_DISCARD_KEY special-cased), then uses the private dispatch. CyclingTriggerEffect is the 'whenever you cycle' wrapper (12 cards, parallel to ON_ANY_PLAYER_CYCLES); OpponentCausedDiscardTriggerEffect gates on discardCausedByOpponent. Class-keyed handlers only, no default; several are recipient-restricted (DealDamageToPlayersEffect and MillEffect EACH_OPPONENT, UntapPermanentsEffect SELF). Targeted classes -> DiscardControllerTriggerTarget; MayEffect -> direct stack.add; else enqueueTrigger. SURPRISE: unlike ON_OPPONENT_DISCARDS, this loop has no ability-loss check and ignores granted triggers, so a permanent that lost all abilities still triggers.

event: you discard one or more cards in one discard event
object: cards (any discarded card can satisfy TriggeringCardConditionalEffect)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkDiscardEventTriggers via dispatchSlot. Fired from finishDiscardEvent for batches (beginDiscardEvent/finishDiscardEvent; PlayerInputService also opens a batch for discard choices), or immediately from checkDiscardTriggers for a lone discard outside a batch. dispatchSlotEffect special-cases TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (matches if any discarded card does) and OncePerTurnTriggerEffect FIRST_DISCARD_EVENT_KEY. Handlers set eventValue=discarded count; MayEffect is enqueued; SequenceEffect and DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect -> DiscardControllerTriggerTarget; DealDamageToPlayersEffect and LoseLifeEffect only with EACH_OPPONENT. No default handler.

event: any player cycles a card
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCycleTriggers runs dispatchSlot over every permanent (forEachPermanent); called from AbilityActivationService on cycling activation. DiscardTriggerCollectorService handlers: MayEffect (targeted -> DiscardControllerTriggerTarget, else enqueue), ReturnToHandEffect, PutCountersOnSelfEffect, MayPayManaEffect, BoostSelfEffect, GrantKeywordEffect. No default handler. Many 'whenever you cycle' cards use ON_CONTROLLER_DISCARDS + CyclingTriggerEffect instead.

event: this card is cycled
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCycleTriggers, called from AbilityActivationService on cycling activation. Intervening-if conditionals are filtered at trigger time; all remaining registrations go in ONE stack object (Yidaro's two). Target paths: targets announced with the cycling ability (Rampaging War Mammoth); SPELL target -> ETBSpellTargetTrigger; permanent/player -> DiscardControllerTriggerTarget (TriggeredAbilityQueueService#processNextDiscardControllerTriggerTarget compares against the slot for exact multi-target counts); graveyard target -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger; else enqueueTrigger with X. Independent of the discard triggers (cycling also calls checkDiscardTriggers with cycled=true). ConjureSkywriterDjinnSpellbookEffectHandler only writes the slot on a conjured card.

event: you scry
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkScryTriggers runs dispatchSlot over the scrier's battlefield; called from ScryEffectHandler, ScryInteractionHandler and MayMiscHandlerService. ScryTriggerCollectorService: SequenceEffect, MayPayManaEffect and the default all go to enqueueOnScry. That sets eventValue=cards bottomed and cardsLookedAt, sends targeted effects to SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, skips ExileBottomCardsToSourceEffect(EventValue) when nothing was bottomed, and supports OncePerTurn markOnAcceptance.

event: an opponent scries
notes: Same collector and handlers as ON_CONTROLLER_SCRIES (TriggerCollectionService#checkScryTriggers over other battlefields). enqueueOnScry takes the opponent branch: targetId=scrying player, nonTargeting, and targeted effects never get a target interaction. River Song registers one SequenceEffect in three slots (opponent scries / surveils / searches library).

event: you search your own library (also when nothing is found)
notes: LibrarySearchTriggerHelper#recordSearchAndQueueTriggers is called from about 40 call sites in the search handlers (LibrarySearchSupport, SearchLibraryEffectHandler, BasicLandSearchQueueSupport, LibraryChoiceHandlerService, ...) and only for own-library searches. It puts ALL of the slot's effects into one enqueued, nonTargeting entry per permanent. Only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn is checked: static ability loss, granted triggers, OncePerTurn, May and target handling are all ignored. anyPermanentReactsToLibrarySearches is a presence check.

event: a card is put into your hand from your library (draw, seek, search, swap, ...)
notes: A library-to-hand zone change; it could also sit in 13.7 because draws fire it. TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCardPutIntoHandFromLibraryTriggers via dispatchSlot. Choke points: DrawService#completeDrawCard, LibrarySearchSupport#revealDeferredEachPlayerToHandPicks, LibraryChoiceHandlerService#addCardFromLibraryToHand, the Seek*EffectHandler family (SeekLibraryEffectHandler#resolve etc.) and PutCardsFromHandOnLibraryCardChoiceInteractionHandler#swapWithLibraryTop. There is no single choke point, so other library-to-hand moves may miss it. MiscTriggerCollectorService: TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (card predicate) and default; enqueueTrigger with triggeringCardId and a frozen card snapshot.

event: players finish a vote
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkVotingFinishedTriggers (forEachPermanent over all battlefields) from VotingFinishedSupport. Only ErestorOfTheCouncilEffect / ModelOfUnityEffect handlers (VotingFinishedTriggerCollectorService), each snapshotting the VotingResult into a new effect; no default handler.

event: the Ring tempts you and you choose a Ring-bearer
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkRingTemptTriggers from TemptTheRingEffectHandler; returns when no Ring-bearer was chosen. Default RingTriggerCollectorService#handleRingTempted skips the source when it is the chosen Ring-bearer - Gandalf, Friend of the Shire's intervening-if ('a creature other than Gandalf') is hard-coded for every effect in the slot. Distinct from ON_RING_TEMPTS_YOU.

event: you investigate for the first time this turn
multiplicity: once per turn (first investigate action only)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkInvestigateTriggers, gated by playersWhoInvestigatedThisTurn.add; called once per investigate action from CreateTokenEffectHandler and other token/investigate handlers. Only CreateTokenEffect handler (InvestigateTriggerCollectorService#handleClueCreation); no default handler.

event: you investigate
multiplicity: per investigate action (investigate N times = N triggers)
notes: Same TriggerCollectionService#checkInvestigateTriggers; default handler InvestigateTriggerCollectorService#handleEveryInvestigation enqueues one entry per registration. Javadoc says 'one or more times' but the code fires once per investigate action.

event: you surveil
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSurveilTriggers (from SurveilEffectHandler) uses dispatchSlot. dispatchSlotEffect drops OncePerTurnTriggerEffect FIRST_SURVEIL_KEY unless this is the first surveil this turn. MiscTriggerCollectorService: PutCountersOnSelfEffect, OncePerTurnTriggerEffect and the default all enqueueTrigger, with no target interaction for targeted effects. The same method also reads GRAVEYARD_ON_CONTROLLER_SURVEILS.

event: an opponent surveils
notes: Same TriggerCollectionService#checkSurveilTriggers over other battlefields, with the same handlers as ON_CONTROLLER_SURVEILS; they set targetId=surveiling player, nonTargeting. Only used by River Song.

event: you manifest dread
object: card put into the graveyard by the manifest dread
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkManifestDreadTriggers from ManifestDreadEffectHandler and LibraryChoiceHandlerService. Only ReturnTriggeringCardToOwnerHandEffect handler (bakes the graveyard card id + graveyard entry version); no default handler.

event: you complete a dungeon
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkDungeonCompletionTriggers from VentureIntoDungeonEffectHandler and TriggerCollectionService#completeDungeonRoomIfReady (also reads GRAVEYARD_ON_CONTROLLER_COMPLETES_DUNGEON). Default DungeonTriggerCollectorService handler: graveyard-only target -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger interaction, otherwise plain enqueue (permanent/player targets get no target step).

event: you roll one or more dice (incl. the planar die and Pokey coin-flip d20s)
zone: battlefield; command zone (face-up planes when you are planar controller)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerRollsOneOrMoreDiceTriggers (~15 roll effect handlers + CoinFlipService Pokey path) and #checkControllerRollsPlanarDieTriggers (PlanechaseService#completeRoll, also dispatches face-up planar cards). Default DiceRollTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerRollsDice: intervening-if checked with the roll result, permanent/player-targeted effects -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, else enqueue with eventValue = result.

event: you roll a die (each die, with its result)
notes: Dispatched once per die inside TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerRollsHighestNaturalResultTriggers (called by every die-roll effect handler); same DiceRollTriggerCollectorService handler, eventValue = result. Planar die rolls and Pokey coin-flip d20 rolls never call it, so per-die triggers miss those rolls while the one-or-more slot fires.

event: you roll a die showing its highest natural result
multiplicity: per die whose result equals its side count
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerRollsHighestNaturalResultTriggers (called by every die-roll effect handler, interleaved per die after ON_CONTROLLER_ROLLS_DIE); default handler delegates to DiceRollTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerRollsDice. Pokey coin-flip d20s don't reach it.

event: you airbend, earthbend, waterbend or firebend
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkBendingTriggers (also records the bending type) from Airbend*/EarthbendTargetLand/AwardManaUntilEndOfCombat effect handlers, WaterbendPaymentService, SpellCastingService and AbilityActivationService. Default BendingTriggerCollectorService handler: one non-targeting entry per registration, no target step.

event: you exert a creature
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkExertTriggers (records permanentsExertedThisTurn) from MayAbilityHandlerService (exert on attack) and ActivatedAbilityExecutionService. Default ExertTriggerCollectorService#handleExert: permanent/player-targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget interaction, else non-targeting entry with targetId = exerted creature.

event: you collect evidence
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCollectEvidenceTriggers from SpellCastingService, GraveyardChoiceHandlerService, CollectEvidenceEffectHandler and AbilityActivationService. Only CreateTokenEffect handler (CollectEvidenceTriggerCollectorService); no default handler.

event: you discover
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkDiscoverTriggers from DiscoverEffectHandler, LibraryChoiceHandlerService and PermanentChoiceSpellHandlerService. Default DiscoverTriggerCollectorService handler: non-targeting entry, eventValue = discover N; OncePerTurnTriggerEffect unwrapped by dispatchSlotEffect.

event: you seek one or more cards
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSeekTriggers from ~20 Seek*/seek-and-conjure effect handlers. Default SeekTriggerCollectorService#handleSeek: non-targeting entry; ConjureDuplicatesOfSoughtCardsAndManifestEffect gets the sought cards baked in and a hard-coded 'only during your turn' (active player) gate plus non-empty sought list.

event: you conjure one or more cards
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkConjureTriggers from ~70 conjure/spellbook handlers (no central choke point); also reads GRAVEYARD_ON_CONTROLLER_CONJURES. Default ConjureTriggerCollectorService handler: one non-targeting entry per registration.

event: this card is discarded for any reason (cycling included)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkDiscardTriggers (tail) puts all registrations in one entry. Any permanent/player target -> DiscardTriggerAnyTarget interaction; else enqueueTrigger. No intervening-if filtering (the BY_OPPONENT twin filters) and no ability-loss check.

event: this card is discarded by a spell or ability an opponent controls
relation: this; discard caused by an opponent
notes: mixed: replacement EnterBattlefieldOnDiscardEffect (5 cards) is read in place by the discard paths: CardChoiceHandlerService, VoidEffectHandler, TargetPlayerDiscardsAndDestroysCreaturesOfChosenTypeEffectHandler, RevealHandAndDiscardDuplicateNonlandCardsEffectHandler, PlayerInteractionSupport (x2) and ZyymRevealHandEffectMayHandler, all leading to BattlefieldEntryService#putPermanentOntoBattlefieldFromOpponentDiscard. The trigger path filters it out. Trigger: TriggerCollectionService#checkDiscardTriggers when gameData.discardCausedByOpponent; intervening-if conditionals are filtered and the rest go in one entry (targeted -> DiscardTriggerAnyTarget), recording the graveyard entry version. SURPRISE: every discard path has to check for the replacement itself (7 reader sites in 6 classes).

event: a land is tapped for mana
relation: varies by effect class: any player, you, opponent, enchanted land, this land
zone: battlefield; command zone (face-up planes); floating effects
notes: Mostly triggered mana abilities (CR 605.1b: no stack). TriggerCollectionService#checkLandTapTriggers (AbilityActivationService ON_TAP and Piracy paths, ActivatedAbilityExecutionService land ActivatedAbility path, ChoiceHandlerService, AwardManaOfChosenColorEffectHandler). Printed effects only (no granted), only hasLostAllAbilities checked; ~25 class-keyed handlers in LandTapTriggerCollectorService and no default (unhandled classes silently ignored). mixed: triggered mana abilities add mana immediately or defer to pendingManaAbilityTriggers (AddManaOnEnchantedLandTap, AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLand, AddManaWhenLandOfSubtypeTappedForMana, AddExtraManaOfChosenColorOnLandTap, AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanent...) vs stack triggers via enqueueTrigger (DealDamageOnLandTap, GainLifeWhenOpponentTapsLandOfSubtype as a MayEffect, ReturnTappedLandToHand, DestroyReferencedPermanent, OpponentTappedLandDoesntUntap, TapPermanents, Mana Web, RemoveCounterFromSource), CreateTokenForTargetPlayer via direct stack.add with no target step, RegisterDelayedChooseOpponentGainsControlOfSource as a delayed action, Camp effect via a target interaction. 'Opponent' checks compare against the tapping player, not the land's controller. Presence also read by PredicateEvaluationService#hasTriggeredManaAbility, PotentialManaService and AI.

event: a permanent is tapped for mana
relation: any player (Treasure Nabber handler: opponent taps an artifact)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPlayerTapsPermanentForManaTriggers (dispatchSlot over every permanent + face-up planar cards) from AbilityActivationService (ON_TAP) and ActivatedAbilityExecutionService (tap-cost mana abilities). mixed: ManaTapTriggerCollectorService GainControlOfTargetEffect = stack trigger; AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanentEffect = triggered mana ability (adds mana to the tapping player, colour choice, or pendingManaAbilityTriggers while the type is pending); no default. SURPRISE: it re-finds the tapped permanent by id and returns if gone, so sources sacrificed in the mana cost (Treasure) never trigger it (Eloren Wilds' extra mana lost). Suspected: in the ActivatedAbilityExecutionService path the call is not wrapped in the stack-diff deferral, so Treasure Nabber's trigger lands on the stack mid-payment instead of in pendingManaAbilityTriggers.

event: you tap a creature for mana
notes: Triggered mana ability (CR 605.1b: no stack). TriggerCollectionService#checkCreatureTapForManaTriggers (tapping player's battlefield, printed only, hasLostPrintedAbilities skip, registry.dispatch directly so no trigger-copy scope) from AbilityActivationService (ON_TAP mana from a creature) and ActivatedAbilityExecutionService. Only AddManaWhenCreatureTappedForManaEffect handler: adds the mana straight to the pool (triggered mana ability, no stack); no default.

event: you tap a nonland permanent for mana
notes: Triggered mana ability (CR 605.1b: no stack). TriggerCollectionService#checkNonlandPermanentTapForManaTriggers (same callers); returns when the tapped card's printed types include LAND or no new mana type was produced. Only AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanentEffect handler: adds mana directly, colour-choice interaction, or pendingManaAbilityTriggers entry while the type is pending; no default. Forsaken Monument's land half lives in ON_ANY_PLAYER_TAPS_LAND.

event: you tap an artifact token for mana
notes: Triggered mana ability (CR 605.1b: no stack). Same TriggerCollectionService#checkNonlandPermanentTapForManaTriggers loop; the slot is added only when the tapped card isToken and has printed ARTIFACT, and the early LAND return means artifact-land tokens never trigger. Handler delegates to the nonland AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanentEffect handler.

event: a permanent deals damage (combat or noncombat) to you
zone: battlefield (+ face-up schemes; face-up planes for the planar controller, creature sources only)
multiplicity: per object (per damage source per damage event)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkDamageDealtToControllerTriggers (from DamageSupport and CombatDamageService) dispatches each registration through the registry: only effect classes with a DamageTriggerCollectorService handler fire (ReturnDamageSourcePermanentToHand, DamageSourceControllerGainsControlOfThisPermanent, DestroyDamageSourcePermanent, PutCounterOnReferencedPermanent(TRIGGERING), ExileDamageSourcePermanentUntilSourceLeaves) - no default handler, other classes silently dropped. Planes via checkPlanarPermanentDealsDamageToYouTriggers (OncePerTurnPerCreatureTriggerEffect unwrap). Skips lost-printed-ability watchers.

event: sacrificed
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers is the sacrifice choke point (about 14 callers: DestructionSupport#logSacrifice, DepartureService#stepHooks, StateBasedActionService#depart, AbilityActivationService#sacrificePermanent, SpellCastingService#sacrificeForSpellCost, GraveyardService, LifeSupport, ...) and also fans out to the OPPONENT/ANY/NONTOKEN sacrifice slots. Watchers: sacrificer's battlefield + simultaneousDyingPermanents + the sacrificed permanent's own snapshot (look-back) unless its ON_DEATH has an onlyTriggersOnSacrifice effect (the heuristic). OncePerTurnTriggerEffect unwrapped in the check; non-TriggeringPermanentConditional effects go through unwrapCreatureDeathConditional. Handlers: MayPayManaEffect/MayEffect -> queueMayAbility; targeted -> queueInteraction; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect with graveyard-targeting return -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger; else enqueueTrigger. Granted triggers are not read.

event: an opponent gains control of a permanent you control
relation: you control (incl. this), new controller = opponent
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentGainsControlTriggers from CreatureControlService#recomputeControls before any battlefield move (previous controller's battlefield; simultaneous steals counted per permanent). New controller must equal getOpponentId(previous). Only CreateTokenEffect handler (MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleOpponentGainsControlCreateToken); no default.

event: sacrificed
relation: opponent (sacrificing player is not the watcher controller)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentPermanentSacrificedTriggers, only from #checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers. Watchers are current battlefields only (no look-back for watchers sacrificed in the same event). Full lost-ability checks. Handlers (MiscTriggerCollectorService): TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect (evaluated on new Permanent(sacrificedCard), so only types survive as LKI, not counters/P-T) and default; both enqueueTrigger with non-targeting targetId = sacrificing player. No may or targeting path.

event: sacrificed
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPermanentSacrificedTriggers, only from #checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers. Watchers: all battlefields (hasLostAllAbilities check), the sacrificed card's own effects (look-back, Carmen) and simultaneousDyingPermanents. Self exclusion is a text heuristic: watcherExcludesSacrificedSelf checks whether the card text contains 'sacrifices another' (Mazirek). Single default handler (MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleAnyPermanentSacrificedDefault): targeted -> queueInteraction, else enqueueTrigger, controller = watcher's controller.

event: sacrificed or destroyed
object: noncreature artifact (as it was on the battlefield)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyNoncreatureArtifactSacrificedOrDestroyedTriggers, called only from PermanentRemovalService#sacrificePermanentToGraveyard and #destroyPermanentToGraveyard after removal (fires even if a replacement sent it elsewhere; sacrifice paths not routed through sacrificePermanentToGraveyard do not fire it). dispatchSlot over all battlefields + simultaneousDyingPermanents look-back. SURPRISE: the only handler is for DealDamageToPlayersEffect (DeathTriggerCollectorService#handleNoncreatureArtifactSacrificedOrDestroyedDamage), so any other effect class registered here never triggers.

event: sacrificed
relation: opponent (sacrificing player is not the watcher controller)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentNontokenPermanentSacrificedTriggers, only from #checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers. Raw card.getEffects with NO lost-ability/face-down checks at all (the sibling OPPONENT slot has them), no look-back. Handlers: MayEffect -> queueMayAbility (target = sacrificed card id), StealDyingOpponentPermanentUnlessPaysLifeEffect baked and enqueued, default enqueueTrigger with triggeringCardId + graveyard/exile entry versions.

event: sacrificed
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyCreatureSacrificedTriggers, only from #checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers (Javadoc still names DestructionSupport.sacrificeAndLog as a second caller; it now funnels through the first). dispatchSlot over all battlefields + simultaneousDyingPermanents + the departed snapshot of the sacrificed creature (look-back); self excluded by the 'sacrifices another' card-text heuristic (Zodiark). Handlers: MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, PutCountersOnSourceEffect/default -> enqueueTrigger. SURPRISE: the OncePerTurnTriggerEffect handler is dead code (dispatchSlotEffect unwraps OncePerTurnTriggerEffect first), so a once-per-turn targeted effect would hit the default handler, which has no targeting path.

event: a spell or ability with targets is put on the stack (targets chosen)
object: spell or ability (the targeting stack entry)
relation: any player; AbilityTargetChoiceTriggerEffect: only your activated/triggered abilities that target a player or permanent
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkTargetChoiceTriggers loops over every permanent. It runs after becomes-target collection on the spell and ability paths, and also from StackedDividedDamageTriggerService, GraveyardChoiceHandlerService and MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService. Effect-class filters: TargetChoiceTriggerEffect (Loki, with OncePerTurn unwrap/mark); ReselectTargetAtRandomEffect (Grip of Chaos, single-target entries only); others unfiltered (Psychic Battle). enqueueTrigger with triggeringCardId=the targeting object. Ability loss is checked only for the first two classes. The trigger is about the targeting object, not about becoming a target (could arguably be 13.2).

event: becomes the target of a spell
relation: this; or the enchanted/equipped permanent when the source is an attached Aura/Equipment
multiplicity: per targeting spell per targeted permanent
notes: self: the source is the object unless it is attached, in which case the object is the permanent it is attached to. TriggerCollectionService#collectBecomesTargetTriggers, called from collectBecomesTargetOfSpellTriggers (spell path only). It runs for the unattached targeted permanent and for every Aura/Equipment attached to it; an attached Aura that is itself the target does not trigger, and bestow is not special-cased. Skips cloaked permanents and those that lost printed abilities; granted effects are read only when the source is the target. Split into stack objects: non-targeting effects in one entry; TriggeringSpellReferencingEffect ones in another (triggering card/controller set); targeting ones -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget interaction. All use direct stack.add (enqueueTargetTriggeredAbility).

event: becomes the target of an Aura spell
relation: this; or the enchanted creature when the source is an attached Aura (Brinebound Gift)
notes: self: the source is the object unless it is an attached Aura (then the enchanted creature). TriggerCollectionService#collectBecomesTargetOfAuraSpellTriggers, spell path only, with the same unattached-self + attached-permanents call pattern as ON_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_SPELL. All registrations go in one entry via direct stack.add. SURPRISE: only isCloaked is checked; unlike its siblings there is no hasLostPrintedAbilities check and no granted triggers.

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls
object: spell or ability controlled by an opponent
relation: this; attached Aura/Equipment for the enchanted/equipped creature (counter-unless path only)
multiplicity: per targeting object per targeted permanent
notes: This is where the Ward keyword's counter-unless lives (CounterUnless* = about 156 of 182 registrations, more inside ConditionalEffect). SURPRISE: despite the name it fires for abilities too. collectBecomesTargetOfOpponentCounterTriggers and collectBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpellOrAbilityNonCounterTriggers run from both the spell and ability paths; only a non-ward CounterUnlessDiscardsEffect is dropped for abilities (Reality Smasher). Split: each CounterUnlessEffect (after intervening-if) is its own nonTargeting entry targeting the triggering object in the STACK zone. All non-counter effects share one entry (targeted -> AttackTriggerTarget interaction), and that path runs only for the unattached targeted permanent. The counter collector also handles ward suppression/removal, the rule that printed ward needs the source to be the target, granted/perpetual ward, the cloaked/face-down ward placeholder and temporary/persistent grants. hasWardAbility and hasGrantedCounterUnlessTrigger are presence checks; rememberPerpetualWard writes perpetual grants. All direct stack.add.

event: becomes the target of a spell an opponent controls
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpellOnlyTriggers (spell path only, unattached targeted permanent). Printed registrations go in ONE entry; each granted effect gets its own entry (Opaline Sliver's grant). Direct stack.add with no target handling. SURPRISE: no ability-loss check, so printed effects fire even after the permanent lost its abilities.

event: you become the target of a spell
multiplicity: per targeting spell (targeted players deduplicated per spell)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectControllerBecomesTargetOfSpellTriggers (spell path only). Printed (unless printed abilities lost) + granted. MayEffect -> queueMayAbility; else direct stack.add.

event: you become the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls
object: spell or ability controlled by an opponent
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectControllerBecomesTargetOfOpponentTriggers, from the spell and ability paths. SURPRISE: only CounterUnlessEffect registrations are queued; any other effect class is silently ignored. The entry targets the triggering object in the STACK zone, sets setTriggerOrderChosen(true) and uses direct stack.add; the log text hard-codes '{1}'. Only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn is checked.

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
zone: battlefield (look-back; also emblems, planes, temporary global watchers)
multiplicity: per object; BatchedCreatureDeathTriggerEffect (OneOrMoreCreatureDeathTriggerEffect) -> per event in batches
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyCreatureDeathTriggers -> dispatchAnyCreatureDeathTriggersForWatcher (battlefield watchers, then simultaneously dying watchers) -> DeathTriggerCollectorService handleAnyCreatureDeathDefault/handleAnyCreatureDeathMay/many specific. Self: dying permanent is off the battlefield and skipped in the simultaneous loop unless the watcher has DrawCardForEachAuraAttachedToDyingCreatureEffect; batched OneOrMoreCreatureDeathTriggerEffect.includeSource() lets the source count. So 'whenever a creature dies' (no 'another') cards need ON_DEATH too. Grouping: each registration its own stack object in the per-death path; in TriggerCollectionService#collectBatchedAnyCreatureDeathTriggers plain batched effects share ONE entry while targeted/may ones are separate. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers; batches via checkBatchedAllyCreatureDeathTriggers.

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
relation: another you control (incl. simultaneously dying watchers)
multiplicity: per object (once-per-turn variants batched per event)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyNontokenCreatureDeathTriggers -> dispatchSlot per registration (ability loss checked; face-down skipped); dying permanent excluded by id in the simultaneous loop. OncePerTurnTriggerEffect registrations also via TriggerCollectionService#collectBatchedOncePerTurnAllyNontokenDeathTrigger (excludes watcher). Temporary global watchers via collectTemporaryGlobalTriggers (from checkAnyCreatureDeathTriggers). Default handler handleAllyNontokenDefault (DeathTriggerTarget if declaredTarget). Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers.

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyNontokenCreatureDeathTriggers -> dispatchSlot for every permanent and for simultaneously dying watchers (skips the same card). SURPRISE: the context uses the creature's OWNER as dying-creature controller and its PRINTED power/toughness (not last-known); default handler handleAnyNontokenCreatureDeathDefault puts the effect on the stack with no target routing. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
object: artifact (as it was on the battlefield)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyArtifactPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers (wasArtifact and wentToGraveyard); the same loop fires the two ON_ARTIFACT_PUT_INTO_OPPONENT_* slots and emblem watchers. Watchers: all battlefields + simultaneousDyingPermanents (includes the dying artifact itself, so self yes via look-back). Effect-class-dependent: TriggeringArtifactControllerConditionalEffect = 'you control' (+excludeSelf/onlyIfNontoken/onlyIfNotSacrificed flags); ReturnTriggeringArtifactToOwnerHandUnlessTargetTakesDamageEffect = your nontoken artifact into your graveyard, via queueInteraction; DealDamageToPlayersEffect excludes self (targetId = artifact controller); MayEffect -> queueInteraction if targeted else queueMayAbility; default direct stack.add.

event: exiled from the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyArtifactExiledFromBattlefieldTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToExile and #processGraveyardAndTriggers (graveyard move replaced by exile); dispatchSlot over current battlefields only, single default handler (direct stack.add). SURPRISE (rules gap): no simultaneousDyingPermanents look-back, unlike the graveyard twin, so an exiled artifact source (Shard of the Void Dragon) or watchers exiled in the same event do not trigger.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
object: enchantment (as it was on the battlefield)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyEnchantmentPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers (wasEnchantment); dispatchSlot over all battlefields + simultaneousDyingPermanents (look-back incl. itself, e.g. Femeref Enchantress dying). Single default handler, direct stack.add. Context carries no enchantment card, so per-object filters are impossible.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
object: enchantment (as it was on the battlefield)
notes: Same method as ON_ANY_ENCHANTMENT (TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyEnchantmentPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers, PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers); keyed on the enchantment's controller, not the graveyard owner. Look-back via simultaneousDyingPermanents includes itself. Single default handler (direct stack.add); context has no card, so no predicate gating is possible.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
relation: opponent controls (keyed on artifact controller, not graveyard)
notes: Fired in the ON_ANY_ARTIFACT loop (TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyArtifactPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers) for every watcher whose controller differs from the artifact's controller, incl. simultaneous look-back watchers. SURPRISE: name says 'opponent graveyard' but the test is the artifact's controller (the _OWNER_ twin keys on the graveyard owner). dispatchSlotEffect drops ConditionalEffect(SourceClassLevelAtLeast) when unmet (Class level gating). Handlers: MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, DealDamageToPlayersEffect(TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER) targetId baked, default direct stack.add.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
relation: owned by an opponent (graveyard owner is not the watcher controller)
notes: Fired in the ON_ANY_ARTIFACT loop (TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyArtifactPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers, PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers) for watchers whose controller differs from the graveyard owner, incl. simultaneous look-back watchers. Handlers shared with the controller-keyed twin: MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, default direct stack.add. Only user Viridian Revel.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
relation: opponent controls (dying permanent's controller is not the watcher controller)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers. Watchers: all battlefields + simultaneousDyingCreatures only (non-creature watchers that left in the same event are not looked back). No default handler: only PutCountersOnSelfEffect, TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect (judged on the LKI snapshot) and StealDyingOpponentPermanentUnlessPaysLifeEffect (baked; entry has no source permanent id) fire; all direct stack.add.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOtherPlayerOwnedPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers. Watchers: all permanents of non-owners + the dying permanent itself when its controller is not its owner (a stolen source sees its own death) + simultaneousDyingPermanents of non-owners. Single default handler, direct stack.add (Kothophed).

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
relation: any; narrowed to 'you control' by some effect classes
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers) -> #dispatchAnyPermanentDeathTriggersForWatcher over all battlefields, the dying permanent and simultaneous watchers. Self excluded unless the (TriggeringCardConditional-unwrapped) effect is TriggeringPermanentControllerConditionalEffect with includesSource; Javadoc's 'never sees its own death' is achieved by this skip, not by absence. Watcher check is only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn (no layer ability loss, no granted triggers). SURPRISE: the MayEffect handler returns false unless the watcher controls the dying permanent (Yuna's 'you control' encoded by effect class); TriggeringPermanentControllerConditionalEffect handler also = you control. Default: direct stack.add, targetId = graveyard owner.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
notes: Inside TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers): dispatchSlot for all battlefields, the dying permanent itself (look-back) and simultaneousDyingPermanents.
