Single default handler: direct stack.add with non-targeting targetId = graveyard owner (Liability: 'that player loses 1 life').

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
relation: put into your graveyard (watcher controller = graveyard owner)
notes: Inside TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers): owner's battlefield, dying permanent (look-back when controller = owner) and simultaneous watchers. SURPRISE: dispatched straight through the registry from card.getEffects with only TriggeringCardConditionalEffect unwrapping, bypassing dispatchSlot, so no lost-ability check and no granted triggers. Handlers: TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect (LKI permanent), ReturnTriggeringCardToOwnerHandEffect (baked), RegisterDelayedReturnCurseAttachedToPlayerEffect, default direct stack.add.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
relation: you control (dying permanent's controller = watcher controller)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#dispatchAllyPermanentDeathTriggersForWatcher from #checkAnyPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers) for watchers of the dying permanent's controller + simultaneous watchers of that controller (dying permanent itself excluded). SURPRISE: Javadoc says it fires for the graveyard owner, but code keys on the dying permanent's CONTROLLER; and the watcher loop has no lost-ability check at all and reads no granted triggers. unwrapCreatureDeathConditional applied. Handlers: Martyr's Bond, SacrificePermanentsEffect (LKI snapshot as source), curse return, TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect, default (declared target -> queueInteraction DeathTriggerTarget, else stack.add).

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
relation: put into your graveyard (watcher controller = graveyard owner)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#dispatchPutIntoYourGraveyardTriggers -> #dispatchPutIntoYourGraveyardForWatcher, first step of #checkAnyPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers). Watchers: owner's battlefield, the dying permanent (look-back when its controller is the owner) and simultaneous watchers. Only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn checked (no layer ability loss, no grants). Shares handlers with ON_ALLY_PERMANENT_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD (TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect on LKI, default).

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield
relation: put into an opponent's graveyard (graveyard owner is not the watcher controller)
notes: Inside TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPermanentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers): dispatchSlot for watchers whose controller is not the graveyard owner + simultaneous watchers (self skipped; a stolen source dying into its owner's graveyard does not see itself). dispatchSlotEffect applies unwrapCreatureDeathConditional and intervening-if for this slot. Default handler stack.add with targetId = graveyard owner (Patron of the Nezumi). SURPRISE: Grim Feast's 'creature' filter lives in the GainLifeEqualToDyingCreatureToughnessEffect handler (returns false for noncreatures), i.e. object type decided by effect class.

event: put into a graveyard from the battlefield, caused by an opponent's resolving spell or ability
relation: your land (graveyard owner = watcher controller); cause controlled by an opponent
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkLandPutIntoGraveyardByOpponentTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers (wasLand, skipped while sacrificingAsSpellCost); cause = currentlyResolvingControllerId. dispatchSlot over the owner's battlefield. Only handler: ReturnTriggeringLandFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect (Sacred Ground), so any other effect class never triggers.

event: destroyed by an opponent's spell or ability (incl. destroy replaced by exile)
relation: you control (incl. this); cause = opponent's resolving spell/ability
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkNoncreaturePermanentDestroyedByOpponentTriggers via PermanentRemovalService#recordNoncreaturePermanentDestroyedByOpponent in PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers (destroy paths). Cause = gameData.currentlyResolvingControllerId. Sources = controller's battlefield + simultaneousDyingPermanents + the destroyed permanent. Only MayEffect handler (DeathTriggerCollectorService) -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget targeted interaction; no default.

event: put into a graveyard from anywhere
multiplicity: per object; ONCE_PER_BATCH registrations once per mill / discard-cost / death batch
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkLandPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (choke point GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard), plus batch calls from GraveyardService#millCards and #endDeferredOncePerBatchGraveyardTriggers. dispatchSlot filters by the oncePerBatchOnly flag and special-cases this slot (OncePerTurnTriggerEffect.firstLandGraveyardEvent, hasEarlierLandInDeathBatch). Default handler enqueueTrigger. Suspected gap: other simultaneous multi-card moves (an effect discarding several lands) fire ONCE_PER_BATCH per card.

event: put into a graveyard from the library
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkLandCardMilledTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (sourceZone LIBRARY). Name says 'milled' but it fires for any library-to-graveyard move (surveil and the like), which matches Pedantic Learning's text. Default handler enqueueTrigger (MayPayManaEffect rides the stack).

event: put into a graveyard from the library
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkPermanentCardPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers. Only handler is ExileTriggeringPermanentCardFromLibraryWithCroakCounterEffect (Grolnok; checks the card is still in the graveyard, stamps entry version). No default handler, so other effect classes never trigger.

event: one or more cards put into a graveyard from the library (one library-to-graveyard event)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCreatureCardsPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryTriggers: batch calls from GraveyardService#millCards, #resolvePutTopCardsIntoGraveyard, #addCardsFromLibraryToGraveyard; single non-batched library moves fire it per card with count 1 via #collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers. Default handler enqueueTrigger with eventValue = creature card count. Voracious Brood pairs it with LIBRARY_ARRIVALS_BATCHED on the from-anywhere slot.

event: one or more cards put into a graveyard from the library (one library-to-graveyard event)
multiplicity: per event; per matching card for RegisterDelayedReturnCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCardsPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryTriggers: same batch call sites as the creature variant (GraveyardService#millCards etc.), per-card fallback in #collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers. Handlers: ReturnTriggeringLandFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect (one entry, one effect per land), ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect (event card ids stamped), RegisterDelayedReturnCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect (one entry PER matching card: multiplicity set by effect class), default (TriggeringCardsAwareEffect gets the batch; targeted -> queueInteraction).

event: put into a graveyard from a library
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyCreatureCardPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (sourceZone LIBRARY); dispatchSlot over all battlefields; default handler enqueueTrigger (Dreadhound).

event: one or more cards put into a library from anywhere
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCardsPutIntoLibraryTriggers: ~35 call sites with no single choke point (StackResolutionService#handleSpellDisposition, PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToLibrary*, CounterSupport, ZoneToLibraryService, shuffle/conjure handlers, GraveyardReturnSupport#moveCardToDestination); batch-aware callers pass a count, per-card movers call it once per card, so 'one or more' only holds where the caller batches. A source tucked into a library does not see itself. Default handler enqueueTrigger; the count is not passed as eventValue.

event: put into a graveyard from anywhere
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCardPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (choke point GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard). Handlers: TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (kept wrapped on the stack, re-checked on resolution), ExileTriggeringCardFromGraveyardEffect, default (targeted -> queueInteraction SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger with triggeringCardId). SURPRISE: RegisterDelayedReturnCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect only fires when the card came from HAND (zone narrowed by effect class, Desert Warfare). Watchers that left the battlefield in the same event are not looked back.

event: put into a graveyard from any zone except the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyArtifactCardPutIntoGraveyardFromNonBattlefieldTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (sourceZone != BATTLEFIELD). Shares MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleCardPutIntoGraveyardDefault (targeted -> queueInteraction, else enqueueTrigger). Ultron cards pair it with ON_PERMANENT_PUT_INTO_YOUR_GRAVEYARD to cover 'from anywhere'.

event: put into a graveyard from anywhere
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkNonblackCardPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers; dispatchSlot over all battlefields plus face-up Planechase planes (the only user, The Dark Barony, is a plane). SURPRISE: the only handler is LoseLifeEffect with TARGET_PLAYER recipient (targetId = graveyard owner, non-targeting); any other effect class or recipient never triggers.

event: put into a graveyard from anywhere
multiplicity: per object; ONCE_PER_BATCH once per death batch; LIBRARY_ARRIVALS_BATCHED skips library arrivals
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCreatureCardPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers; dispatchSlot special-cases this slot (hasEarlierCreatureCardInDeathBatch, LIBRARY_ARRIVALS_BATCHED, intervening-if). SURPRISE: TriggeringCardConditionalEffect handler returns false for battlefield origin, and PerpetuallyGrantTriggeredAbilityEffect only for HAND/LIBRARY origin (zone narrowed by effect class). Suspected bug: ONCE_PER_BATCH (Robot Domination) has no mill dedup (no batch call in millCards, per-card calls ignore oncePerBatchOnly), so milling several creature cards triggers once per card.

event: put into a graveyard from any zone except the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCreatureCardPutIntoGraveyardFromNonBattlefieldTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (sourceZone != BATTLEFIELD); dispatchSlot over all battlefields. Handlers: TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (unwrapped, triggering card + entry version stamped), default enqueueTrigger (Syr Konrad).

event: put into a graveyard from anywhere
multiplicity: per object; ONCE_PER_BATCH once per mill / discard-cost batch
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkPermanentCardPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers from GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers, plus batch calls from #millCards and #endDeferredOncePerBatchGraveyardTriggers; dispatchSlot applies the oncePerBatchOnly filter and the intervening-if check (Moonshadow's oil counters). Default handler only. SURPRISE (suspected bug): unlike the land and creature-card slots there is no death-batch dedup, so a wrath putting several permanent cards into your graveyard fires a ONCE_PER_BATCH registration (Moonshadow) once per card.

event: put into a graveyard from anywhere
relation: an opponent's graveyard (graveyard owner is not the watcher controller)
notes: Second loop of TriggerCollectionService#checkCreatureCardPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers (GraveyardService#collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers); dispatchSlot over all non-owner battlefields. Handlers: BecomeCopyOfCreatureCardInOpponentGraveyardEffect (Lazav: card baked, re-wrapped in MayEffect, enqueued), MayPayLifeEffect (life = card mana value, entry version stamped), default enqueueTrigger. Also read at resolution by BecomeCopyOfCreatureCardInOpponentGraveyardEffectHandler to carry the Lazav registration onto the copy.

event: card put into a graveyard from any zone (collected after it entered)
zone: battlefield; exile (suspended card with time counters, Nihilith)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCardPutIntoOpponentGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers: dispatchSlot over permanents of non-owners, then raw registry.dispatch for suspended exiled cards (skips ability-loss checks and AdditionalTriggeredAbility copies). Handlers MiscTriggerCollectorService: ExileTriggeringCardFromGraveyardEffect (shared with ON_ALLY_CARD_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD_FROM_ANYWHERE), ConditionalEffect (condition checked at trigger time; supports a card source), default. Token filter lives in the caller. SURPRISE: the exile path passes permanent=null; only the ConditionalEffect handler tolerates it, the default and ExileTriggeringCard handlers would NPE for any other effect on a suspended card. No look-back: a stolen source dying into its owner's graveyard does not see itself. Choke: GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard -> collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers.

event: land put into a graveyard from the battlefield (destroy, sacrifice, SBA)
object: land (last-known: a permanent that was a land counts; its card copy gets the LAND type)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyLandPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers: dispatchSlot over the battlefield plus simultaneousDyingPermanents; source not excluded, but a land source sees itself only through the simultaneous-dying look-back. DeathTriggerCollectorService handlers: DealDamageToPlayersEffect (bakes land controller as target), TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (returns true even when the predicate fails), default; all use direct stack.add. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers (wasLand and not creatureDeathTriggersSuppressed).

event: card put into a graveyard from any zone
object: black nontoken card (colour read from card.getColors())
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkBlackCardPutIntoOpponentGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers via dispatchSlot; called outside the caller's isToken guard but does its own card.isToken() check. DeathTriggerCollectorService handlers: MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, default -> stack.add. Choke: GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard -> collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers.

event: an Aura becomes attached to this
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAuraAttachedTriggers(Card...) (also via the Permanent overload); ~30 scattered callers (BattlefieldPlacementService, PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService, Attach*/CreateTokenAttached* effect handlers) - no choke point. Printed effects only, no ability-loss check, Aura test by printed subtype; one enqueued entry per registration controlled by the enchanted permanent's controller.

event: an Aura you control becomes attached to a creature you control
notes: Only in the Permanent overload of TriggerCollectionService#checkAuraAttachedTriggers (the Card-only overload, e.g. BecomeAuraManifestTopCardEffectHandler, skips it). Watchers on the Aura controller's battlefield, hasLostAllAbilities skip, printed only; one non-targeting entry per registration.

event: this Equipment becomes attached to a creature (not re-attached to the same one)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEquipmentAttachedTriggers via EquipSupport#notifyEquipmentAttached (24 callers) and LibraryChoiceHandlerService. mixed: ChooseColorForSourceEffect, ChooseCardNameAtResolution+ChooseSubtypeForSource SequenceEffect and AttachedCreatureBecomesCopyOfExiledCreatureEffect(asAttaches) are 'as this becomes attached' replacement-style choices done inline; targeted effects -> ETBTokenTargetTrigger interaction; others enqueued with triggeringPermanentId = equipped creature. Once-per-turn unwrapped; printed only, no ability-loss check. SURPRISE: the Equipment branch of AttachTargetAuraOrEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffectHandler sets attachedTo without notifying, so the slot does not fire there.

event: becomes tapped (any cause)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedPermanentTapTriggers, run from ~34 tap call sites (TapUntapSupport#tapPermanent, CombatAttackService, AbilityActivationService, ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, SpellCastingService, MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService, cost handlers incl. CrewCostHandler) - no single choke point. Printed effects of every permanent attached to the tapped one, dispatch() with trigger-copy scope; 12 class-keyed handlers in MiscTriggerCollectorService and no default (other classes silently ignored); no ability-loss check in the loop. Also read by AiManaManager#attachedTapTriggerCost.

event: becomes tapped (any cause)
multiplicity: per tapped permanent; ONCE_PER_BATCH registrations once per tap-batch scope
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedPermanentTapTriggers, run from ~34 tap call sites (TapUntapSupport#tapPermanent, CombatAttackService, AbilityActivationService, ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, SpellCastingService, MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService, cost handlers incl. CrewCostHandler) - no single choke point. Reads layered (LayerSystemService.currentCard) printed registrations + temporary + persistent + granted, plus temporary global watchers (collectTemporaryGlobalTriggers). Per registration: TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filter, global OncePerTurnPerCreature, ChooseOneAtTriggerTime -> TriggeredModalTrigger, graveyard target -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger, permanent/player target -> EntersTriggerTarget, else enqueue. SURPRISE: begin/endPermanentTapTriggerBatch scopes exist only in AbilityActivationService, CombatAttackService (attack), SpellCastingService and MayCastHandlerService; effect-driven mass taps through TapUntapSupport#tapPermanent are unbatched, so 'one or more' ONCE_PER_BATCH triggers (Deeproot Pilgrimage, Rewrite History) fire once per tapped permanent there.

event: this is tapped to pay a Vehicle's crew cost
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCrewsVehicleTriggers from CrewCostHandler (also run for saddle, filtered out by the printed VEHICLE subtype). Entries go to pendingActivatedAbilityCostTriggers, printed only. mixed: RegisterDelayedVehicleAttackEffect (Balthier and Fran) is not queued - it records a DelayedVehicleAttack marker, and the real 'whenever a Vehicle crewed by this attacks' trigger is fired by CombatAttackService#processDelayedVehicleAttackTriggers (which re-reads this slot for presence and ability loss); the marker is recorded before the lost-abilities check.

event: a creature you control crews a Vehicle
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreatureCrewsVehicleTriggers (dispatchSlot over the crewing creature's controller's battlefield) from CrewCostHandler. Only PerpetuallyBoostVehicleWhenMatchingCreatureCrewsEffect handler (MiscTriggerCollectorService; filters the crewing creature, queues to pendingActivatedAbilityCostTriggers); no default.

event: this is tapped to pay a teamwork cost
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSelfTappedToPayTeamworkCostTriggers from SpellCastingService (inside a tap-trigger batch). Printed + granted effects; only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn checked (static ability loss ignored); trigger copies added manually via countAdditionalTriggeredAbilityTriggers.

event: this becomes untapped (tapped to untapped, any cause)
notes: Printed registrations all go into one stack object (default MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleSelfBecomesUntapped bundles the whole slot when the first effect is dispatched and no-ops for the rest); each granted registration (Well Rested) is a separate entry. TriggerCollectionService#checkBecomesUntappedTriggers from TapUntapSupport#untapPermanent (untap step + untap effects) and MayMiscHandlerService; ~9 direct Permanent.untap() calls bypass it (e.g. untap-symbol costs in ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, MultiplePermanentUntapCostHandler). Handler: intervening-if filtered, targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget or ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger, else one enqueued entry. Also read by PermanentRemovalService#handleExileReturnOnLeave for presence of ReturnCardsExiledWithSourceOnUntapEffect (Tawnos's Coffin).

event: becomes untapped
notes: Same TriggerCollectionService#checkBecomesUntappedTriggers. Printed only; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filter then plain enqueue. No ability-loss check and no target, once-per-turn or intervening-if handling; no triggeringPermanentId set (unlike ON_ANY_PERMANENT_BECOMES_UNTAPPED).

event: you untap one or more permanents during your untap step
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerUntapsDuringUntapStepTriggers from UntapStepService#finishUntapStep (active player, count of permanents untapped in the step). Only PutCountersOnSelfEffect handler (MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleUntapStepPutCountersOnSelf); no default.

event: becomes untapped
notes: Same TriggerCollectionService#checkBecomesUntappedTriggers; all battlefields, skips face-down and lost-printed-abilities sources; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filter, once-per-turn unwrap, entry with triggeringPermanentId and eventPlayerIds = untapped permanent's controller; no target step.

event: becomes renowned
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkBecomesRenownedTriggers, called from RenownEffectHandler when renown flips. One enqueueTrigger per registration; no ability-loss check and no target handling.

event: a creature you control becomes renowned
notes: Same TriggerCollectionService#checkBecomesRenownedTriggers (forEachPermanent filtered to the renowned creature's controller). TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filters the renowned creature. One enqueueTrigger per registration; no ability-loss check, no target handling, and the triggering permanent id is not stamped.

event: becomes monstrous
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkBecomesMonstrousTriggers, called from MonstrosityEffectHandler. It uses registry.dispatch directly, so there is no additional-trigger copy wrapper and no ability-loss check. Only handler: the default MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleSelfBecomesMonstrous. It re-reads the slot and queues everything once, on the first registration's dispatch (later ones return true without queuing). Targeted -> ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger (multi-target) or SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget; else direct stack.add carrying X.

event: phases out (untap-step phasing or any phase-out effect); collected before it leaves the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkPhasesOutTriggers -> enqueuePhasingTriggers: direct getEffects, one enqueueTrigger per registration. No ability-loss check, no AdditionalTriggeredAbility copies, MayEffect goes straight to the stack, no target support (only the phases-in slot gets targeting). Called from PhasingService#movePhasedOut (applyPhasing, applyTimeAndTide, phaseOut, phaseOutUntil*/While*).

event: one or more permanents phase out in one phasing event
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOtherPermanentPhasesOutTriggers: dispatchSlot once per PhasingService#movePhasedOut call; every permanent in the phasing set is excluded as a watcher (not just the source). Handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleGlobalPhaseOutOrCardExileTriggers (shared with ON_ANY_CARD_EXILED) -> direct stack.add, no targeting.

event: phases in (any phase-in path)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkPhasesInTriggers -> enqueuePhasingTriggers. Effect-dependent path: an effect whose target spec admits PERMANENT -> queueInteraction(PermanentChoiceContext.PhasesInTriggerTarget) (Shimmering Efreet), others -> enqueueTrigger. No ability-loss check, no copies. Called from PhasingService#phaseIn, which serves applyPhasing, applyTimeAndTide, phaseInUntilPlaneswalk, phaseInLinkedPermanents and phaseInWhenSourceLeaves; the Javadoc says untap step only.

event: becomes tapped (any cause)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedPermanentTapTriggers, run from ~34 tap call sites (TapUntapSupport#tapPermanent, CombatAttackService, AbilityActivationService, ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, SpellCastingService, MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService, cost handlers incl. CrewCostHandler) - no single choke point. Printed only (no temporary/persistent/granted, unlike the ally variant) plus temporary global watchers. TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filter, once-per-turn, intervening-if, graveyard target -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger, else enqueue with triggeringPermanentId. SURPRISE: no permanent/player target step (the ally variant has EntersTriggerTarget), so a targeted effect goes on the stack without a chosen target (only TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER damage gets a baked targetId).

event: you tap a permanent an opponent controls
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedPermanentTapTriggers, run from ~34 tap call sites (TapUntapSupport#tapPermanent, CombatAttackService, AbilityActivationService, ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, SpellCastingService, MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService, cost handlers incl. CrewCostHandler) - no single choke point. Tapping player = explicit argument (TapUntapSupport) else currentlyResolvingControllerId / pendingEffectResolutionEntry controller, so taps outside a resolving effect (costs, attacks) never trigger it. Printed + temporary + persistent + granted; hasLostAllAbilities skip; permanent target (non-MayPayMana) -> EntersTriggerTarget, player targets get no target step. Sharae of Numbing Depths combines ONCE_PER_BATCH with OncePerTurnTriggerEffect.

event: enchanted permanent is dealt damage (combat or noncombat)
multiplicity: per object (per damage event / per source; combat per source-to-creature portion)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedCreatureDealtDamageTriggers (noncombat via checkDealtDamageToCreatureTriggers from DamageSupport#finishPermanentDamage; combat from CombatDamageService per damage portion): each registration dispatched to DamageTriggerCollectorService effect-class handlers or the CardEffect default, one enqueueTrigger entry each (damage as eventValue). No lost-ability check on the attachment.

event: enchanted player is dealt damage (combat or noncombat)
multiplicity: noncombat: per damage event; combat: once per damage step with the defending player's total (+ per redirected portion)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedPlayerDealtDamageTriggers -> DamageTriggerCollectorService CardEffect default: one enqueueTrigger per registration (damaged player targetId, amount eventValue). Doc says once per damage event; the combat reader aggregates all combat damage to the defender in the step.

event: enchanted creature deals damage (combat or noncombat) to the Aura's controller
relation: enchanted; damaged player must be the attachment's controller
multiplicity: per object (per source per damage event; combat per source per recipient)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedCreatureDealtDamageToControllerReflectTriggers (DamageSupport noncombat, CombatDamageService combat) scans the damaged player's battlefield for attachments on the source: all registrations in ONE non-targeting entry (amount as xValue, creature's controller as targetId); no lost-ability/face-down checks.

event: enchanted creature deals damage to anything
multiplicity: combat: once per source per damage step (total damage); noncombat: per damage event
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectEnchantedCreatureDealsDamageTriggers (combat, from CombatDamageService) / queueEnchantedCreatureDealsDamageTriggers (DamageSupport): an attachment's registrations share ONE entry (DamageSourceController* effects bound, damage as eventValue); no lost-ability check.

event: enchanted creature deals damage to another creature
object: creature (damaged; not the enchanted creature itself)
multiplicity: per object (per damaged creature; combat per source/target pair per step)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectEnchantedCreatureDealsDamageToCreatureTriggers (combat) / queueEnchantedCreatureDealsDamageToCreatureTriggers (DamageSupport noncombat): all registrations in ONE non-targeting entry with the damaged creature as targetId; source must currently be a creature; self-damage excluded.

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEquippedCreatureDeathTriggers: every Equipment (printed EQUIPMENT subtype, no lost printed abilities) attached to the dying creature, including simultaneously dying ones; TriggeringCardConditional checked against last-known subtypes (printed card for ReturnDyingCreatureToBattlefieldEffect). handleEquippedCreatureDeathDefault: targeted -> DeathTriggerTarget, else stack entry. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers.

event: equipped creature deals combat damage to anything
multiplicity: per event (once per source per damage step, total damage)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#queueSourceDealsCombatDamageTriggers (from CombatDamageService#processSelfDealsCombatDamageTriggers): only printed-Equipment attachments; each registration via DamageTriggerCollectorService default (targeted -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, graveyard -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger, else enqueueTrigger); the ConditionalEffect handler evaluates the condition at trigger time; no lost-ability check.

event: equipped creature deals combat damage to a player
multiplicity: per event (once per source per damage step if it dealt any damage to players; aggregated across players)
notes: queueSourceDealsCombatDamageTriggers -> DamageTriggerCollectorService#handleEquippedCreatureDealsCombatDamageToPlayer (eventValue = damage to players, targetId = first recipient for DAMAGED_PLAYER effects); printed-Equipment only. CombatDamageService#checkAttachedCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers only checks this slot's emptiness to suppress the same attachment's ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER (marker read).

event: equipped permanent transforms (either direction)
object: creature (whatever the Equipment is attached to)
notes: AnimationSupport#fireEquipmentTransformTriggers, called from transformToBackFace/transformToFrontFace after the transformer's own triggers: requires the EQUIPMENT subtype and puts ALL slot effects in one stack entry via direct stack.add (source snapshot set). No ability-loss check, no targeting, no copies. The Ludevic-copy toggle path (toggleLudevicCopy) does not fire it.

event: permanent transforms (either direction)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyPermanentTransformsTriggers via dispatchSlot over the transformer's controller's battlefield (transformer not excluded), from AnimationSupport#fireAllyPermanentTransformTriggers (transformToBackFace/FrontFace, not the Ludevic-copy toggle). Single default handler TransformTriggerCollectorService#handleAllyPermanentTransform unwraps TriggeringCard/TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect and enqueues; no target support.

event: day becomes night or night becomes day (not the initial NEITHER->day/night)
notes: TCS#checkDayNightChangeTriggers -> dispatchSlot per permanent in APNAP order -> DayNightTriggerCollectorService#handleDayNightChange (CardEffect default). Permanent-targeting effects go via queueInteraction(DayNightTriggerTarget), else enqueueTrigger; MayEffect stays wrapped on the stack (no queueMayAbility). Player-targeting effects get no target interaction. Caller DayNightService (line ~102). Graveyard variant collected inline in the same loop.

event: day becomes night or night becomes day
notes: TCS#checkGraveyardDayNightChangeTriggers (private, called from checkDayNightChangeTriggers per player after that player's battlefield). Uses getEffectiveGraveyardEffects; one StackEntry per registration via enqueueTrigger with graveyardEntryVersion; no registry, no target handling, MayPayManaEffect resolved on the stack.

event: permanent enters the battlefield transformed
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyPermanentEntersTransformedTriggers: only if the entering permanent isTransformed(); dispatchSlot over the controller's battlefield with no self-exclusion -> handleEnterDefault. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: enchanted permanent put into a graveyard from the battlefield (dies, for creatures)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedPermanentDeathTriggers: watchers = battlefield plus simultaneousDyingPermanents; direct getEffects + dispatch, only the until-EOT ability-loss flag is checked. 19 DeathTriggerCollectorService handlers bake last-known P/T, controller, owner and card ids; targeted effects -> DeathTriggerTarget interaction (addEnchantedPermanentDeathEntryReturning), the rest direct stack.add; several handlers wrap the effect in a MayEffect themselves. Side effect: retargets already-pending DealDamageToEnchantedPermanentControllerEffect entries. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers. Family: kept 12 (permanent-generic), but almost all uses are 'enchanted creature dies', the sibling of equipped-creature-dies in 11.

event: land enters the battlefield
notes: Permanent reader TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentLandEntersTriggers: each registration dispatched separately (lost printed abilities skipped; TargetPlayerControlsMoreLandsThanController intervening-if, entering subtype, imprinted-name and entered-this-turn conditionals), land controller as defaultTargetPlayerId -> handleEnterDefault/handleEnterMay/handleDealDamageToEnteringController. Planar reader TriggerCollectionService#checkPlanarLandEntersTriggers puts ALL of a plane's effects into one entry. Only for non-face-down land entries. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: land enters the battlefield (landfall)
multiplicity: per object; TriggerMode.ONCE_PER_BATCH -> per event while collecting simultaneous entries
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyLandEntersTriggers builds entries itself (no registry): printed + temporary + persistent + granted effects; all resolved registrations of a source share ONE stack object and one target choice (SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget / SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger); a lone ChooseOne/TriggeredModal effect becomes a modal trigger; SURPRISE: if ANY registration on the card is TriggerMode.INDEPENDENT, EVERY registration becomes its own stack object (not just the independent one). Planar reader checkPlanarLandEntersTriggers: one entry with all effects. Self heuristic: a printed land skips its own entry unless it has a TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect in the slot; a nonland permanent that is a land only by effect sees itself. Skips hasLostAllAbilities and ETB suppression. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: dies (battlefield to graveyard)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentCreatureDeathTriggers: watchers whose controller differs from the dying creature's controller (so the source's own death never counts); printed (unless lost) + granted effects; once-per-turn; death conditionals against the dying permanent; dispatch -> handleOpponentCreatureDeathDefault/handleOpponentCreatureDeathMay/specific. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers.

event: this permanent is dealt damage (combat or noncombat)
multiplicity: noncombat: per damage event (per source); combat: once per damaged permanent per step (summed), except DamageSourceAware/ControllerAware/PerDamageSource effects per source
notes: readers disagree in mechanics: noncombat TriggerCollectionService#checkDealtDamageToCreatureTriggers (DamageSupport#finishPermanentDamage, any permanent) dispatches through DamageTriggerCollectorService handlers; combat CombatDamageService#collectDealtDamageTriggerData/processDealtDamageTriggers is bespoke and covers creature recipients only. Both: one stack object/interaction per registration; face-down / lost-printed-abilities skip printed effects.

event: this permanent is dealt noncombat damage
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkNoncombatDamageToSelfTriggers (DamageSupport#finishPermanentDamage) -> handleNoncombatDamageToSelfDefault, which is the ON_DEALT_DAMAGE default handler (one entry per registration, amount as eventValue). Draft family 13.3 was wrong.

event: this permanent is dealt combat damage
multiplicity: once per damaged permanent per damage step (summed over sources)
notes: CombatDamageService#collectDealtDamageTriggerData + processCombatDamageReceivedTriggers: one entry per registration (targeted -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget), damage as event value; face-down / lost-printed skip printed effects; creature recipients only.

event: you are dealt combat damage
multiplicity: per damage step per (damaged player, dealing controller) group
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerDealtCombatDamageTriggers runs at the start of CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers, which is called once per recipient per dealer controller - so it can fire twice in one step if creatures of two controllers damage you (doc says once per step). One enqueueTrigger per registration with the total as eventValue; no target/may handling.

event: pregame: card is in the opening hand (Legacy-word cards also from library) before turn 1
notes: Opening-hand actions (CR 103.6), not a triggered ability. SURPRISE: not a triggered ability - every one of the 29 registrations is MayEffect(PregameChoiceEffect) (18 LeylineStartOnBattlefieldEffect, Gemstone Caverns, 5 RegisterOpeningHandUpkeepTriggerEffect, RegisterDelayedCounter/ManaTriggerEffect, ChooseLegacyWordEffect, BecomeStartingPlayerEffect, ExileSourceCardFromOpeningHand...). MulliganService#startGame adds one PendingMayAbility per registration (bypasses stack; onlyForNonStartingPlayer honoured; scans library for ChooseLegacyWordEffect). Chancellor-style choices register delayed triggers (openingHandUpkeepTriggers etc.) fired later by StepTriggerService#handleOpeningHandUpkeepTriggers. The second reader StepTriggerService#handleOpeningHandTriggers (turn-1 upkeep: MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else stack.add) skips PregameChoiceEffect, so it is dead for all current cards. mixed: pregame static-like choices (Leylines) + delayed-trigger registration (Chancellors).

event: mulligan decision
notes: Serum Powder and No Regrets Egret; read by MulliganService#queueMulliganActionChoice and #holdsSerumPowder.

event: player loses life (damage or direct loss), amount > 0
relation: opponent (any player other than the source's controller)
multiplicity: per event (per losing player per loss event)
notes: TCS#checkLifeLossTriggers -> loop over effects -> TCS#dispatch (with additional-trigger copies). Skips only hasLostPrintedAbilities (no computeStaticBonus loses-all check, no granted triggered abilities). No CardEffect default handler: only OncePerTurnTriggerEffect (accepts only a wrapped CastTargetInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardEffect, else silently returns false), FirstOpponentLifeLossEachTurnTriggerEffect, MillOpponentOnLifeLossEffect, GainLifeEffect, SequenceEffect (fires only when exactly 1 life lost: Ob Nixilis), ConditionalEffect have handlers in MiscTriggerCollectorService; any other effect class silently never triggers. Event value = life lost.

event: an opponent shuffles their library
notes: LibraryShuffleHelper#checkShuffleTriggers, called from LibraryShuffleHelper#shuffleLibrary (every engine shuffle; mulligan shuffles bypass it). One enqueueTrigger per registration with targetId=shuffling player, nonTargeting, plus a source snapshot. A MayEffect stays on the entry. No ability-loss check and no granted triggers.

event: any player shuffles their library
notes: Same LibraryShuffleHelper#checkShuffleTriggers (one entry per registration, targetId=shuffling player, nonTargeting). Psychogenic Probe's 'a spell or ability causes' wording is not checked: it fires on every shuffleLibrary call (in practice all of these come from spells/abilities). No ability-loss check.

event: a spell or ability causes its controller to shuffle their library
relation: any player (the shuffler must be the resolving object's controller)
notes: Same LibraryShuffleHelper#checkShuffleTriggers. The causing controller is currentlyResolvingControllerId, else pendingEffectResolutionEntry's controller. Fires on every permanent regardless of who controls it; targetId=shuffling player, nonTargeting. No ability-loss check.

event: an opponent searches their own library (also when nothing is found)
notes: Same LibrarySearchTriggerHelper#recordSearchAndQueueTriggers as ON_CONTROLLER_SEARCHES_LIBRARY. All of the slot's effects go in one enqueued entry per permanent (Ob Nixilis' two registrations bundled correctly), with targetId=searching player, nonTargeting. Only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn is checked. A search stopped by Leonin Arbiter never calls it.

event: beginning of enchanted permanent's controller's upkeep
notes: StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers aura lambda over all permanents (must be attached; enchanted controller must be the active player). SURPRISE: if the card has any ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER_AFFECTED_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED effect this slot is ignored entirely (either/or selection); no face-down or ability-loss check on the Aura. Granted sacrifice-host ForcedCostOrElseEffect dropped when the grant was removed; ForcedCostOrElse with TargetPlayerGainsControlOfEnchantedPermanentEffect -> UpkeepPlayerTargetTrigger (opponent); EnchantedCreatureControllerLosesLifeEffect baked; grantedToCreature effects use the enchanted creature as source/controller; else non-targeting stack entry with enchanted controller as targetId. One per registration

event: beginning of your upkeep (Aura controller)
relation: you (Aura controller); enchanted permanent's controller is the affected player
notes: Same StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers aura lambda; chosen instead of ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED whenever non-empty, fires when the Aura's controller is the active player, enchanted controller baked as non-targeting targetId (Strangling Grasp). One per registration

event: beginning of enchanted permanent's controller's draw step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleDrawStepTriggers: all permanents, attached Aura whose enchanted permanent's controller is the active player; one stack entry per registration, Aura controller controls it, enchanted controller as targetId (targeting flag not cleared). No face-down/ability-loss check

event: beginning of enchanted permanent's controller's end step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: all permanents, attached, enchanted controller = active player. SacrificeEnchantedPermanentAndReattachSourceAuraEffect is treated as an ability granted to the enchanted permanent (controller = enchanted controller, source id = enchanted permanent, dropped if grant removed); EnchantedCreatureDidntAttack checked at trigger time; non-targeting entry with enchanted permanent as targetId. No ability-loss check on the Aura. One per registration

event: beginning of enchanted player's upkeep
notes: StepTriggerService#handleUpkeepTriggers curse lambda: attachedTo is the player id and must be the active player. AdditionalUpkeepStepEffect skipped on an additional upkeep; ExileGraveyardCardsEffect / EachTargetPlayerDrawsCardsEqualToAttachedCountEffect get the enchanted player baked in; player-target effects -> UpkeepPlayerTargetTrigger, else stack entry with enchanted player as targetId. No intervening-if pre-check, no face-down/ability-loss check. One per registration

event: beginning of enchanted player's draw step
notes: StepTriggerService#handleDrawStepTriggers: attached curse whose enchanted player is the active player; one stack entry per registration with the enchanted player as targetId (Curse of Obsession)

event: beginning of each end step
relation: enchanted player (every end step, not just theirs)
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndStepTriggers: every attached curse at every end step; intervening-if checked with targetId = enchanted player; stack entry with enchanted player as targetId. One per registration

event: Equipment enters the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyEquipmentEntersTriggers (self excluded; lost printed abilities skipped; once-per-turn) -> handleEnterDefault/handleEnterMay. SURPRISE: the Equipment test reads the entering card's printed subtypes, not effective subtypes. Only for non-face-down entries. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: enchantment enters the battlefield (constellation)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyEnchantmentEntersTriggers builds entries itself (no registry): per registration, TriggeringCardConditional, intervening-if (WasCast unwrapped), once-per-turn; targeted -> EntersTriggerTarget, else direct stack.add (a MayEffect stays inside the entry, no queueMayAbility). Lost printed abilities skipped; no face-down or granted-trigger handling. Only for non-face-down entries. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: enchantment enters the battlefield
notes: Same loop in TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyEnchantmentEntersTriggers, collected for every permanent including the entering one. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: you fully unlock a Room (second door unlocked)
notes: SURPRISE: EnterTriggerCollectorService#handleRoomFullyUnlockedDefault puts non-targeting entries straight onto gameData.stack.add (bypasses enqueueTrigger/trigger ordering); targeting ones queue EntersTriggerTarget. Check method TCS#checkAllyRoomFullyUnlockedTriggers -> dispatchSlot. Callers: GameService unlock-door special action (~line 638), UnlockControlledRoomDoorEffectHandler, LockOrUnlockTargetRoomDoorEffectHandler (only on locked->fully-unlocked transition).

event: you fully unlock a Room
notes: Read inside TCS#checkAllyRoomFullyUnlockedTriggers via TCS#queueGraveyardEerieTriggers: uses printed card.getEffects (not getEffectiveGraveyardEffects); MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, anything else -> direct gameData.stack.add (bypasses enqueueTrigger). Only the Room controller's graveyard.

event: this Room's specified door becomes unlocked (cast with that door, unlock special action, or unlock effect)
notes: All 30 registrations are TriggeringRoomDoorConditionalEffect(doorIndex). MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleSelfRoomDoorUnlocked re-reads the slot: the first registration for the unlocked door queues ALL registrations for that door in one stack object (later ones return false); other doors' registrations are ignored. Targeting -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget or ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger, else enqueueTrigger. Identity check matchingEffects.getFirst()!=effect compares printed effects with the TextChangeTransformer output, so a text-change rewrite that yields a new effect object would suppress the trigger. Readers: TCS#checkSelfRoomDoorUnlockedTriggers (from StackResolutionService#resolveEnchantmentSpell, GameService unlock action, Unlock/LockOrUnlock effect handlers); StackResolutionService#resolveEnchantmentSpell also reads the slot to append spell-target metadata (appendSpellTargetingForEffectsFrom) for target indices.

event: creature enters the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentCreatureEntersTriggers: entering controller baked as defaultTargetPlayerId -> handleEnterDefault/handleEnterMay/copy and attach-aura handlers; also turn-scoped TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility watchers keyed to this slot. SURPRISE: reads printed effects with no face-down, ability-loss or granted-trigger handling. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: creature enters the battlefield from a graveyard
relation: this or another (any controller); from the watcher controller's graveyard
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEntersFromGraveyardTriggers: entering permanent must have enteredFromGraveyardOwnerId == watcher's controller; calls registry.dispatch directly (no ability-loss check, no additional-trigger copies beyond ETB doublers). SURPRISE: the CardEffect default handler handleCreatureEnterFromGraveyardDefault always queues an EnteringPermanentAnyTargetTrigger (any-target choice) even for a non-targeting effect; only AttachSourceEquipmentToEnteringCreatureEffect has its own handler. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: permanent enters the battlefield from any graveyard
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkPermanentEntersFromGraveyardTriggers: direct stack.add of each effect (no registry, no target handling), lost printed abilities skipped. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: permanent enters the battlefield directly from exile
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkPermanentEntersFromExileTriggers (enteredFromExile flag): direct stack.add of each effect, no registry, no target handling, no ability-loss check. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: this enters the battlefield from a graveyard
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSelfEntersFromGraveyardTriggers: printed effects of the entering card only; every ConditionalEffect is evaluated at trigger time (regardless of interveningIf) and kept wrapped; targeted -> ETBTokenTargetTrigger with the card's target filter, else direct stack.add. No ability-loss check. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: permanent enters the battlefield
multiplicity: per object; TriggerMode.ONCE_PER_BATCH -> per event while collecting simultaneous entries
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPermanentEntersTriggers: each registration dispatched separately; the player who put it there (cast controller) is baked as non-targeting targetId. Handlers handleAnyPermanentEnterDefault/CardConditional/PermanentConditional, ManaEchoes, ChampionOfTheHareish, UntapEnteringPermanent. SURPRISE: a TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect wrapper narrows the 'any' slot to permanents YOU control unless its anyController flag is set (24 of 44 registrations use that wrapper). Face-down / lost-printed-ability sources skipped. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: any player gains life (amount > 0)
notes: SURPRISE: never registered on a card with addEffect - used only as the key of a TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility created by RegisterGlobalTriggeredAbilityUntilEndOfTurnEffect (False Cure: delayed trigger from a spell). Read by TCS#collectTemporaryGlobalTriggers (called at the end of TCS#checkLifeGainTriggers); one non-targeting stack entry per watcher with targetId = gaining player and eventValue = life gained.

event: you gain life (amount > 0)
notes: TCS#checkLifeGainTriggers: printed (skipped if hasLostPrintedAbilities) + granted effects; unwraps OncePerTurnTriggerEffect (firstLifeGain / markOnAcceptance) and ConditionalEffect (unwrapLifeChangeConditional, so the ConditionalEffect handler is dead on this path) before TCS#dispatch. ~26 class-specific handlers in MiscTriggerCollectorService/LifeGainTriggerCollectorService, no CardEffect default -> unlisted classes silently never trigger. Effect-class paths: MayEffect -> queueMayAbility; MayPayManaEffect -> stack/target interaction. SURPRISE: duplicate (slot,class) handlers for MayPayManaEffect (Misc#handleLifeGainMayPayMana vs LifeGain#handleLifeGainMayPay) and SequenceEffect (Misc#handleLifeGainSequence sets eventValue vs LifeGain#handleLifeGainSequence which does not) - TriggerCollectorRegistry.register silently overwrites, last bean scanned wins. Iterates the live battlefield list (not a copy).

event: you become the monarch
notes: TCS#checkBecomesMonarchTriggers (shared with ON_OPPONENT_BECOMES_MONARCH, picks slot per permanent). SURPRISE: no ability-loss check at all (no hasLostPrintedAbilities/computeStaticBonus) and no registry/TCS#dispatch (no additional-trigger copies, no granted abilities). Intervening-if ConditionalEffect checked at trigger time but the wrapper stays on the stack; targeting -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, else enqueueTrigger non-targeting; MayEffect stays wrapped.

event: an opponent becomes the monarch
notes: Same reader as ON_CONTROLLER_BECOMES_MONARCH (TCS#checkBecomesMonarchTriggers). Non-targeting entry gets targetId = new monarch; targeting effects implementing TargetControllerIsTriggeringPlayerEffect restrict targets to the monarch's permanents (Garland). Same SURPRISE: no ability-loss check, bypasses registry.

event: the Ring tempts you
notes: TCS#checkRingTemptsYouTriggers -> dispatchSlot over the tempted player's battlefield -> RingTemptsYouTriggerCollectorService#handleRingTemptsYou (CardEffect default): always non-targeting enqueueTrigger; MayEffect stays wrapped on the stack.

event: an opponent gains life (amount > 0)
notes: TCS#checkLifeGainTriggers second loop -> dispatchSlot over every non-gaining player's battlefield. Only two handlers (PutCountersOnSelfEffect, ConditionalEffect checked at trigger time with targetId = gainer); no CardEffect default, other classes silently never trigger. Event value = life gained.

event: you get one or more energy counters
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnergyGainTriggers via dispatchSlot. Called from EnergyCountersEffectHandler, DoubleCountersOnControllerEffectHandler, AddAnotherCounterOfEachKindToTargetEffectHandler, ChoiceHandlerService and MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService. MiscTriggerCollectorService: BoostSelfEffect, and a default handler that checks intervening-if, sends targeted effects to SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget and otherwise enqueues.

event: you win a coin flip
notes: TCS#checkControllerWinsCoinFlipTriggers: hasActiveTriggeredAbilities check, then registry.dispatch directly (bypasses TCS#dispatch: no additional-trigger copies, no granted abilities) -> MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleCoinFlipWonDefault -> enqueueCoinFlipTrigger (any-target -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget). Called from ~20 scattered coin-flip sites.

event: any player wins a coin flip
notes: Read in TCS#checkControllerWinsCoinFlipTriggers via forEachPermanent; hasActiveTriggeredAbilities check; registry.dispatch directly (no additional-trigger copies, no granted abilities) -> handleAnyPlayerCoinFlipWonDefault.

event: you lose a coin flip
notes: SURPRISE: TCS#checkControllerLosesCoinFlipTriggers has no ability-loss check (the win path uses hasActiveTriggeredAbilities). registry.dispatch directly -> handleCoinFlipLostDefault, target chosen by an opponent (Karplusan Minotaur). ~16 scattered call sites.

event: an opponent is dealt noncombat damage
relation: opponent (player); the DrawCard and DealDamageToTargetCreatureOrPlaneswalker handlers also require the damage source to be controlled by you
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkNoncombatDamageToOpponentTriggers (DamageSupport) dispatches each registration to MiscTriggerCollectorService handlers (BoostSelf, BoostAllOwnCreatures, DrawCard, DealDamageToTargetCreatureOrPlaneswalker); no default handler; relation depends on the effect class; no lost-ability/face-down check. Draft family 13.3 was wrong.

event: a creature you control deals combat damage to a player
relation: you control; plus an owner-relative pass on other players' battlefields for 'commander you own' and opponentDealtDamage triggers
zone: battlefield (+ watchers that died in the same damage event, + face-up planes, + temporary global watchers)
multiplicity: per dealer; once per damage step per damaged player when oncePerDamageStep
notes: CombatDamageService#checkAllyCreatureCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers: only AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect (optionally inside OncePerTurnTriggerEffect) is honoured - any other class is silently ignored; self is decided by dealerPredicate (PermanentIsSourceCardPredicate = this creature only, null = includes itself, 'another' predicates exclude it); targeted -> AttackTriggerTarget, graveyard -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger, else one entry per registration. Also TriggerCollectionService#collectTemporaryGlobalTriggers, emblems and checkPlanarAllyCreatureCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers. Skips face-down / loses-all-abilities watchers (markFirstTimeEachTurnSelfCombatDamageSpent still marks).

event: a creature you control deals combat damage to a player or battle
multiplicity: per dealer; once per damaged player and once per damaged battle per step when oncePerDamageStep
notes: Same loop as ON_ALLY_CREATURE_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER; the battle path (CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToBattleTriggers, battleDamage=true) reads only this slot. Doc's 'one or more' holds only when the AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect sets oncePerDamageStep; batching sets are separate per player and per battle.

event: a creature with the same name deals combat damage to a player
notes: CombatDamageService#checkSameNameCreatureCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers scans every battlefield; only AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect honoured; whether the watcher itself counts is up to dealerPredicate (Pirated Copy includes itself); no face-down/lost-ability check. No printed registrations - Pirated Copy grants it through its copy effect.

event: any creature deals combat damage to one of your opponents
relation: any dealer; damaged player is an opponent of the watcher's controller
multiplicity: per dealer per damaged player per step
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyCreatureCombatDamageToOpponentTriggers (from processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers): every battlefield, one non-targeting enqueueTrigger per registration (damaged player as targetId); intervening-if gated; no target/may/modal handling; skips lost-printed-abilities (granted copies still read). Planes read the slot too.

event: any creature deals combat damage to any player (including you)
multiplicity: per dealer per damaged player per step
notes: Read in the same loop as ON_ANY_CREATURE_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT without the opponent gate; turn-scoped global watchers (The Sea Devils chapter III) via enqueueTemporaryAnyCreatureCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers, whose source is the dealing creature.

event: creature deals combat damage to its owner (commander owner resolved via playerCommanders, else card owner)
multiplicity: per object (per dealing creature per combat damage step)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyCreatureCombatDamageToOwnerTriggers, called per dealing creature from CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers. Scans all battlefields; printed (skipped if hasLostPrintedAbilities) + granted effects; unwraps TriggeringPermanentControllerConditionalEffect / TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect against the dealer and checks intervening-if ConditionalEffect; always enqueueTrigger, forced nonTargeting (no target support). Archivist of Gondor registers the same commander effect in both this slot and ON_ANY_CREATURE_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT.

event: one or more goaded creatures deal combat damage to a player
relation: any controller's goaded creatures; damaged player is not the watcher's controller
multiplicity: per event (per damaged player per dealer-controller batch)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkGoadedCreatureCombatDamageToOpponentTriggers from CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers; batch = the (recipient, dealer controller) damageBySource map, so in multiplayer goaded creatures of two different controllers hitting the same opponent give two triggers. Opponent check is just controllerId != damagedPlayerId. Printed + temporary + persistent + granted effects; skip if lost abilities; enqueueTrigger nonTargeting, copies counted via beginCombatDamageTriggerCopies using the first goaded dealer.

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability
object: spell or ability (any controller; TriggeringSpellController/OpponentController conditionals filter)
relation: this; or the enchanted/equipped permanent when the source is an attached Aura/Equipment (a bestowed permanent: itself)
multiplicity: per targeting object per targeted permanent
notes: self: the source is the object unless it is a non-bestow attached Aura/Equipment (then the attached-to permanent). TriggerCollectionService#collectBecomesTargetOfSpellOrAbilityTriggers, from the spell and ability paths. Reads printed (unless cloaked or printed abilities lost) + temporary + persistent + granted effects, plus Makeshift Mannequin's SacrificeSelfEffect. Conditionals and OncePerTurn are unwrapped, then everything goes in ONE entry: CounterSpellingEffect -> entry targeting the triggering object in the STACK zone; TriggeringSpellReferencingEffect -> entry carrying the triggering card/controller; targeted -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget; else plain. Direct stack.add. SURPRISE: 'first time each turn' (Glyph Keeper) is inferred from the CounterSpellEffect class via becomeTargetCounterUsedThisTurn, which is set on every permanent the collector runs for, including attached Auras.

event: a player mills (one mill action; count includes cards a replacement exiled)
multiplicity: per event (per mill action per player)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentMillTriggers via dispatchSlot, from GraveyardService#resolveMillPlayer only; a simultaneous each-player mill fires once per milled player. Only handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handlePutCountersOnOpponentMill (PutCounterOnEachControlledPermanentEffect); no default handler, so other effect classes silently never trigger.

event: a mill event with at least one nonland card (simultaneous multi-player mill batched)
multiplicity: per event; GainLifeEffect handler: per nonland card
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkNonlandCardsMilledTriggers via dispatchSlot (same call also dispatches ON_ANY_NONLAND_CARDS_MILLED); callers GraveyardService#resolveMillPlayer, #resolveMillPlayersSimultaneously; mills only, not other library-to-graveyard moves. Handlers: GainLifeEffect (one stack entry per nonland card, Glowing One), PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect (target interaction), SequenceEffect, CreateTokensForNonlandCardsMilledEffect (keeps raw MayEffect, eventValue=count); no default handler. SURPRISE: the Javadoc says once per one-or-more, but the GainLife handler fires per card; and the slot is functionally the same as ON_ANY_NONLAND_CARDS_MILLED (same dispatch, both any player); they differ only by handler set.

event: opponent mills cards (library to graveyard)
object: nonland card that reached the graveyard
relation: opponent (milling player != owner of the graveyard card)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkGraveyardOpponentNonlandCardMilledTriggers, from GraveyardService#resolveMillPlayer only; getEffectiveGraveyardEffects; one enqueueTrigger per card per effect (MayEffect resolved on the stack), stamped with the source's graveyard entry version. No copies. Counts only cards that entered the graveyard, unlike ON_NONLAND_CARDS_MILLED, which also counts replacement-exiled mills.

event: a mill event with at least one nonland card
notes: Same dispatch as ON_NONLAND_CARDS_MILLED (TriggerCollectionService#checkNonlandCardsMilledTriggers). Default handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleNonlandCardsMilled: targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget carrying the count, else enqueueTrigger with eventValue=count. Duplicates the ON_NONLAND_CARDS_MILLED semantics.

event: creature card put into a graveyard from its library (mill or batched library-to-graveyard move)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCreatureCardMilledTriggers: direct getEffects + dispatch, no ability-loss check; called from GraveyardService#resolveMillPlayer and #addCardsFromLibraryToGraveyard. Single handler ExileMilledCreatureAndCreateTokenEffect, no default. The name says milled, but non-mill batch moves fire it too (matches Undead Alchemist's 'from their library'); single-card library moves through addCardToGraveyard do not.

event: enchanted permanent leaves the battlefield (any destination)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkEnchantedPermanentLTBTriggers -> dispatchEnchantedPermanentLTB: direct getEffects + dispatch with NO ability-loss check; watchers include Auras leaving in the same simultaneous batch. DeathTriggerCollectorService handlers: ReturnEnchantedPermanentToBattlefieldOnDeathOrExileEffect (graveyard/exile destinations only), EnchantedPermanentLeavesConditionalEffect (card filter), EnchantedControllerSacrificesCreatureOnLeaveEffect and ReturnSourceAuraToChosenCreatureOnLeaveEffect (bake leaving controller), default; all direct stack.add, no target selection. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToGraveyard, #processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, #returnPermanentToHand, #removePermanentToCommandZone, #removePermanentWithoutDestination, #removePermanentToExile, #removePermanentToLibraryTop/Bottom/Position, #removePermanentToLibrary, CommanderReplacementChoiceInteractionHandler.

event: this card is milled (library to graveyard by a mill)
notes: GraveyardService#millCards: enqueueTrigger of each effect for every milled card that reached the graveyard; no ability-loss check, no target handling. Dead slot (0 card registrations); ON_SELF_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD_FROM_LIBRARY also fires on mill. Choke: GraveyardService#millCards only (not other library-to-graveyard moves).

event: this card is put into a graveyard from the library
zone: library (checked on arrival; global graveyard ability loss honoured)
notes: GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard (sourceZone == LIBRARY, skipped when graveyardCardsHaveLostAllAbilities): enqueueTrigger per effect with triggeringCard id/graveyard entry version; no target handling. Choke: GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard (all zone-to-graveyard moves incl. mill).

event: this card is put into a graveyard from any zone
zone: any (checked as a graveyard ability on arrival)
notes: GraveyardService#collectPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers (getEffectiveGraveyardEffects, so graveyard ability loss suppresses it), owner controls; direct stack.add, no target handling. SURPRISE: skipped whenever creatureDeathTriggersSuppressed is set for the move, even for a card coming from hand/library. Choke: GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard.

event: this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield
notes: GraveyardService#collectPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers (printed + snapshot persistent effects; targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget with LKI snapshot, else stack entry) controlled by the last battlefield controller; suppressed when PermanentRemovalService#selfGraveyardTriggerSuppressed (lost abilities) or creature-death suppression. SURPRISE: same event as ON_DEATH but collected at a different choke point (GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard, sourceZone == BATTLEFIELD) with different ability-loss and grant handling.

event: this card is put into a graveyard from its owner's hand (discard etc.)
notes: GraveyardService#collectPutIntoGraveyardFromHandTriggers: printed effects, owner controls, direct stack.add, no target handling, no graveyard ability-loss check (unlike FROM_ANYWHERE/FROM_LIBRARY). Choke: GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard (sourceZone == HAND).

event: one or more creatures declared as attackers (attacker count snapshotted as xValue)
multiplicity: per event (once per attack declaration); BoostCreaturesInAttackingBandsEffect: per declared band of 2+
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~1868-2230). NORMAL registrations + granted effects share one stack object, INDEPENDENT ones separate, BoostCreaturesInAttackingBandsEffect split per band. Many attack conditions (MinimumAttackers, HasAttacker, AllMatchingCreaturesAttack, ExactlyAttackers, AttackingCreaturesTotalPowerAtLeast, OncePerTurn/OnceOnly ...) are evaluated and unwrapped at trigger time. Routing is effect-dependent: single ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect -> queueInteraction TriggeredModalTrigger; graveyard target -> GraveyardTargetingService/SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger; permanent/player target -> AttackTriggerTarget or ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger; else direct stack.add (MayEffect/MayPayManaEffect stay inside the bundle). Also read by TriggerCollectionService#checkTemporaryGlobalAllyCreatureAttackTriggers (temporary global watchers) and #checkPlanarAllyCreaturesAttackTriggers (face-up planes). SURPRISE: the battlefield loop reads perm.getCard() with no hasLostPrintedAbilities/face-down gate (ON_ALLY_CREATURE_ATTACKS has one).

event: one or more creatures declared as attackers
notes: CombatAttackService#checkCommandZoneAllyCreatureAttackTriggers (called from finishAttackerDeclaration). Attacking player's command zone only, skips faceDownCommandZoneCards; HasAttacker-style conditions checked and unwrapped; all effects in one object: queueInteraction AttackTriggerTarget if targeted else stack.add. TriggerMode ignored. Javadoc says Eminence, but registrants are ongoing schemes too (DSC 332, MB2 269). No triggered-ability copy scope.

event: you attack a player directly with one or more creatures
relation: you control; attacked player is the event subject
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~2232-2338): shared loop with ON_ALLY_CREATURES_ATTACK_PLAYER_OR_PLANESWALKER; per directly attacked player, all printed + granted effects on a card in one object (MinimumAttackers/HasAttacker/MinimumMatchingAttackers unwrapped against that player's attackers, SourceClassLevelAtLeast kept); targeted -> AttackTriggerTarget with attacked player, else stack.add nonTargeting with eventValue = attackers at that player and attackedTargetId. Attacking a planeswalker/battle does not count. No lost-abilities gate; TriggerMode ignored.

event: you attack a player or planeswalker with one or more creatures
relation: you control; attacked player/planeswalker is the event subject
notes: Same loop as ON_ALLY_CREATURES_ATTACK_PLAYER in CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration; entries for each directly attacked player and each attacked planeswalker (battles excluded). A card with both slots gets separate objects per slot. No lost-abilities gate.

event: game-state condition true (checked after SBAs)
multiplicity: per registration while not already on the stack
notes: StateTriggerService#checkStateTriggers: key (permanentId, registration index) in stateTriggerOnStack prevents retrigger; skips face-down and hasLostPrintedAbilities; adds granted StateTriggerEffects (getGrantedEffects). Targeting -> ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger, else direct gameData.stack.add (bypasses enqueueTrigger/ordering). Card#validateEffectSlotType forces StateTriggerEffect in this slot. Also read by StateTriggerService#checkPlanarStateTriggers for face-up planes (command zone).

event: lore counter added reaching chapter I
notes: Chapter I also triggers on ETB (initializeSaga) and via initializeReturnedSaga. addSimultaneousEffects used by The Great Work (flag consumed at resolution by StackEntry, not by the collector). All registrations of one chapter slot form ONE ability: a lone ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect -> TriggeredModalTrigger, a lone ChooseOneAtRandomEffect picks its option at trigger time; targeting comes from Card#getSagaChapterTargetGroups (multi-group -> SagaChapterTarget), Card#getSagaChapterTargetFilters (PlayerPredicateTargetFilter -> player target), effect targetSpec (player+permanent -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, graveyard -> SagaChapterGraveyardTarget); Card#isSagaChapterTargetRequired decides whether a no-legal-target chapter is removed (SURPRISE: otherwise it is pushed with no target, so 'target X' chapters are treated as optional unless the card opts in; 17 cards do). readers that queue: StepTriggerService#handleSagaLoreCounters (precombat main, active player's Sagas, every chapter crossed by a Vorinclex-modified placement), SagaChapterService#triggerSagaChapter (initializeSaga on ETB from BattlefieldEntryService/BatchSupport, StackResolutionService, TokenCopySupport, ExileAndReturnTransformedService, read-ahead CardChoiceHandlerService; PermanentCounterSupport#placeCounterOnPermanent and PutCounterOnEachControlledPermanentEffectHandler for effect-placed lore counters; addLoreCounterAndTriggerChapter for Bedtime Stories; triggerCopiedSagaChapter), ExileAndReturnTransformedService#initializeReturnedSaga (chapter I only). SURPRISE: StepTriggerService and SagaChapterService carry duplicated copies of this logic, StackResolutionService#triggerSagaChapter is dead code (no callers, chapters I-IV only), initializeReturnedSaga pushes chapter I with no targeting and ignores doubled counters, addLoreCounterAndTriggerChapter triggers only the final count (skips a chapter when a lore counter is doubled), PermanentCounterSupport passes entry.getControllerId() as chapter controller (an opponent's effect putting a lore counter on your Saga would control the chapter), proliferate (MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService#proliferatePermanent) adds lore counters WITHOUT triggering any chapter, and no path checks ability loss or face-down (handleSagaLoreCounters filters on the real card's isSaga). TargetLegalityService#sagaChapterIgnoresCardTargetConstraint finds the chapter by name prefix 'SAGA_CHAPTER'; Card#getSagaFinalChapter / SagaChapterService#maximumChapter read presence

event: lore counter added reaching chapter II
notes: addSimultaneousEffects used by Avengers Under Siege (resolution-only flag). Same collectors and grouping as SAGA_CHAPTER_I (one ability per chapter slot, target data from Card saga chapter maps keyed by this slot; same surprises)

event: lore counter added reaching chapter III
notes: addSimultaneousEffects used by The Brothers' War (resolution-only flag). Same collectors and grouping as SAGA_CHAPTER_I (one ability per chapter slot, target data from Card saga chapter maps keyed by this slot; same surprises)

event: lore counter added reaching chapter IV
notes: StackResolutionService#triggerSagaChapter (dead) stops at IV. Same collectors and grouping as SAGA_CHAPTER_I (one ability per chapter slot, target data from Card saga chapter maps keyed by this slot; same surprises)

event: lore counter added reaching chapter V
notes: SURPRISE: StackResolutionService#triggerSagaChapter (dead) has no case for chapters V/VI. Same collectors and grouping as SAGA_CHAPTER_I (one ability per chapter slot, target data from Card saga chapter maps keyed by this slot; same surprises)

event: lore counter added reaching chapter VI
notes: SURPRISE: StackResolutionService#triggerSagaChapter (dead) has no case for chapters V/VI. Same collectors and grouping as SAGA_CHAPTER_I (one ability per chapter slot, target data from Card saga chapter maps keyed by this slot; same surprises)

event: final chapter ability of a Saga you control resolves
notes: StackResolutionService#checkSagaFinalChapterResolution (two resolution sites) -> TriggerCollectionService#checkSagaFinalChapterAbilityResolutionTriggers; dispatchSlot over all battlefields, default handler SagaTriggerCollectorService#handleFinalChapterResolution keeps only watchers whose controller equals the Saga's controller, event value = Saga mana value, enqueueTrigger per registration. SURPRISE: the final chapter is recognised by matching the stack entry DESCRIPTION string "<name>'s chapter <N> ability", so modal chapters (TriggeredModalTrigger entries) or differently-labelled entries are missed while copied chapter entries with the same label count

event: final chapter ability of a Saga you control triggers
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSagaFinalChapterAbilityTriggers called from StepTriggerService#handleSagaLoreCounters and SagaChapterService#triggerSagaChapter when loreCount == getSagaFinalChapter (not for copied chapters); fires as soon as the chapter is queued, even before its target is chosen or if it is later removed for lack of targets. SURPRISE: both callers 'continue/return' before this check for a modal ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect final chapter, and initializeReturnedSaga never calls it. Default handler SagaTriggerCollectorService#handleFinalChapterResolution (controller filter, event value = mana value), one entry per registration (Historian's Boon)

event: beginning of combat step on your turn
zone: battlefield (+ face-up schemes, + active player's command zone, + face-up planes)
multiplicity: per object (once per source per beginning of combat; +copies from additional-trigger effects)
notes: Main check StepTriggerService#handleBeginningOfCombatTriggers.
