StepTriggerService#queueBeginningOfCombatTriggers grouping: each untargeted MayEffect queued separately via queueMayAbility; each ChooseOneEffect / ChooseModeNotYetChosen(ThisTurn)Effect is its own modal trigger (TriggeredModalTrigger/UpkeepModalTrigger); ChooseOneAtRandomEffect is resolved at trigger time into the shared group; intervening-if ConditionalEffects gated at trigger time; ALL remaining registrations (mandatory, targeted mays, MayPayManaEffect) share ONE stack object or ONE targeting interaction (BeginningOfCombatTriggerTarget / ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger / SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger); TriggerMode is never read. Skips face-down / lost-printed-ability sources; an Equipment attached to a non-creature is skipped. Planes via PlanechaseService#step/trigger (mostly one entry per registration). SURPRISE: the active player's command zone (any non-scheme, face-up card) is scanned unconditionally (added for eminence, e.g. Arahbo) - a commander sitting in the command zone with an ordinary 'at the beginning of combat on your turn' ability triggers unless the card wraps it in a SourceCardInCommandZone/OnBattlefield intervening-if. SpecializeSarevokEffectHandler only adds a registration at runtime.

event: beginning of combat step on owner's turn
relation: this card; owner is the active player
notes: StepTriggerService#queueGraveyardBeginningOfCombatTriggers over getEffectiveGraveyardEffects of the active player's graveyard: every registration is its own stack object; intervening-if ConditionalEffect checked at trigger time; MayPayManaEffect/MayEffect -> queueMayAbility; everything else stack.add directly (no target selection support).

event: beginning of every combat step (any player's turn)
notes: StepTriggerService#handleBeginningOfCombatTriggers (forEachPermanent + forEachFaceUpSchemeSource), same queueBeginningOfCombatTriggers grouping as BEGINNING_OF_COMBAT_TRIGGERED (untargeted mays separate, modal effects separate, rest share one object; TriggerMode ignored). Controller = source's controller. SURPRISE: unlike the own-turn slot there is no face-down / lost-printed-abilities check, so a face-down or ability-stripped permanent still triggers.

event: beginning of combat step on an opponent's turn
relation: this; opponent's turn (sources not controlled by the active player)
notes: StepTriggerService#handleBeginningOfCombatTriggers (forEachPermanent filtered to playerId != activePlayerId), same queueBeginningOfCombatTriggers grouping. 'Opponent' = any non-active player. Same missing face-down / lost-ability check as EACH_BEGINNING_OF_COMBAT_TRIGGERED.

event: end of combat step begins (every combat phase, any player's turn)
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEndOfCombatTriggers (from TurnProgressionService after CombatService#clearCombatState): all registrations that pass the intervening-if filter go into ONE non-targeting entry via enqueueTrigger; no may/target/modal handling (MayEffect resolves on the stack); skips face-down / lost-printed-ability sources. PermanentRemovalService#handleExileReturnOnLeave only inspects the slot for ExileAllPermanentsUntilSourceLeavesEffect.returnsOnSourceLeavesTrigger (Wall of Nets return) - a presence read.

event: beginning of precombat main phase on your turn
notes: StepTriggerService#handlePrecombatMainBattlefieldTriggers: intervening-if gate; each ChooseOneEffect/ChooseModeNotYetChosenEffect its own TriggeredModalTrigger; player-only-targeted effects share one MainPhasePlayerTargetTrigger; permanent-targeted share one UpkeepPermanentTargetTrigger; graveyard-targeted share one SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger; untargeted ones (incl. MayEffect/MayPayManaEffect, resolved on the stack) share one stack object EXCEPT TriggerMode.INDEPENDENT registrations, each its own object (INDEPENDENT honoured only for untargeted effects). Reads playerBattlefields only (no face-up schemes); checks hasLostPrintedAbilities but not face-down. Planes via PlanechaseService#step from handlePrecombatMainTriggers.

event: beginning of precombat main phase on owner's turn
relation: this card; owner is the active player
notes: StepTriggerService#handlePrecombatMainGraveyardTriggers (getEffectiveGraveyardEffects): each registration separate; intervening-if checked; MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else its own stack.add; no target selection support.

event: beginning of each player's precombat main phase
relation: this; each player's turn (active player recorded as the entry's activePlayerId, not a target)
notes: StepTriggerService#handleEachPrecombatMainTriggers: all registrations passing the intervening-if filter in ONE stack object (stack.add); no may/target/modal handling; no face-down or lost-ability check. Doc says 'first main phase'; code fires at every precombat main phase.

event: beginning of each postcombat main phase on your turn
notes: StepTriggerService#handleMainPhaseTriggers (shared with SECOND_MAIN_PHASE_TRIGGERED): intervening-if + OnceOnlyTriggerSupport gates; player-only-targeted effects share one MainPhasePlayerTargetTrigger; graveyard-targeted share one SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger; permanent-targeted share one EndStepTriggerTarget; everything else (incl. untargeted mays) shares one stack object; no INDEPENDENT and no modal handling (a ChooseOneEffect would just go on the stack). Uses hasLostAllAbilities (not hasLostPrintedAbilities), no face-down check - differs from the precombat reader. Survival (SurvivalTriggerEffect, 16 regs, 'second main phase') lives here gated to the first postcombat main instead of SECOND_MAIN_PHASE_TRIGGERED.

event: beginning of the turn's second main phase on your turn
notes: Fired by StepTriggerService#handleMainPhaseTriggers when mainPhasesBegunThisTurn == 2, from either handlePrecombatMainTriggers (before the precombat slots) or handlePostcombatMainTriggers (after POSTCOMBAT_MAIN_TRIGGERED); same grouping as POSTCOMBAT_MAIN_TRIGGERED (player-/graveyard-/permanent-targeted groups, rest shared; no INDEPENDENT/modal support).

event: creature is dealt damage (combat or noncombat)
multiplicity: per object (per damaged creature per damage event; combat: per damaged blocker/attacker entry)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentCreatureDealtDamageTriggers(gameData, damagedControllerId) is passed only the controller, not the creature: printed effects only, direct stack.add with no targetId, no lost-abilities check, no targeting support. Called from DamageSupport (noncombat, gated by isCreature) and CombatDamageService (~907-916, once per entry of defDamageTaken/atkDamageTaken). Temporary-global variant TriggerCollectionService#checkTemporaryGlobalOpponentCreatureDealtDamageTriggers sets targetId = damaged creature (Green Dragon registers via RegisterGlobalTriggeredAbilityUntilEndOfTurnEffect, so the slot doubles as a temporary-watcher key).

event: creature or planeswalker is dealt excess damage (combat or noncombat)
multiplicity: per object (per damaged permanent per damage event; combat: summed per permanent per step)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentPermanentDealtExcessDamageTriggers (shared with the _NONCOMBAT_ slot); callers DamageSupport (noncombat, per damage application) and CombatDamageService#checkCombatExcessDamageTriggers (before SBA). Printed + temporary + persistent effects; intervening-if ConditionalEffect checked with targetId = damaged permanent; DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect -> queueInteraction SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget (target other than the damaged permanent), else stack.add nonTargeting with eventValue = excess. Planeswalker test is printed type. No lost-abilities check.

event: creature or planeswalker is dealt excess noncombat damage
multiplicity: per object (per damaged permanent per noncombat damage application)
notes: Same reader as ON_OPPONENT_CREATURE_OR_PLANESWALKER_DEALT_EXCESS_DAMAGE; the slot is only included when noncombatDamage is true (DamageSupport passes !event.combat(); CombatDamageService passes false). Draft family 13.3 is wrong: this is noncombat damage (13.4). DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect (Toralf) goes through queueInteraction, others stack.add.

event: one or more creatures are dealt excess noncombat damage by one resolving stack entry
multiplicity: per event (deduped per damage StackEntry + watcher + effect via markNoncombatExcessDamageTriggerFired)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentCreatureDealtExcessNoncombatDamageTriggers, called only from DamageSupport permanent-damage path. Code fires once per source stack entry (matches Magmatic Galleon's 'one or more'); Javadoc reads as per creature. Printed + temporary + persistent; direct stack.add nonTargeting with targetId = first damaged creature; no lost-abilities check. Draft family 13.3 is wrong (noncombat, 13.4).

event: creature is dealt damage (combat or noncombat)
multiplicity: per object (noncombat: per damage application; combat: per damaged creature summed over all sources in the step)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyCreatureDealtDamageTriggers -> dispatch per registration to DamageTriggerCollectorService handlers (EnchantedCreatureDealsDamageEqualToDealtDamageToController -> stack.add; MayEffect / TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect / default -> enqueueAnyCreatureDealtDamage: targeted MayEffect -> queueInteraction SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, else stack.add with targetId = damaged creature, eventValue = damage). Skips only hasLostAllAbilities. Also collectTemporaryGlobalTriggers and DelayedWatchedCreatureDealtDamage. Callers: DamageSupport (noncombat, isCreature-gated) and CombatDamageService#processAnyCreatureDealtDamageTriggers. Minor: the permanent-conditional handler computes the once-per-turn unwrap but enqueues the wrapped effect.

event: permanent is dealt damage
relation: you control (handler-enforced); paired-creature variant uses its predicate
multiplicity: per object (per damaged permanent per damage application)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyPermanentDealtDamageTriggers -> dispatchSlot (lost-abilities gate, printed + granted, one dispatch per registration). Only two handlers: DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect and TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect (no CardEffect default, so other effect classes silently never trigger). Both queueInteraction SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget. SURPRISE: Javadoc says 'regardless of its controller' but queueAnyPermanentDealtDamageTrigger requires the damaged permanent's controller == watcher's controller (the DealDamageToPlayersEffect paired branch skips that check). Matches the registered cards (Howlpack Avenger, Wrathful Raptors), so it is the name/doc that is off. Callers: DamageSupport (noncombat) and several CombatDamageService paths (~4358, 4617, 4624, 4854, 5422).

event: source deals damage (combat or noncombat) to a creature
relation: effect-dependent: this (most), you control, equipped, or any controller (DestroyCreatureDamagedByMatchingCreatureEffect)
multiplicity: per object (per source/damaged-creature pair per damage event)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyDealtDamageToCreatureTriggers = #checkWatchersDealtDamageToCreatureTriggers (other permanents of the source's controller, equipment on the source even if an opponent controls it, and any-controller watchers via #fireAnySourceDealtDamageToCreatureTriggers) + #checkSelfDealtDamageToCreatureTriggers (the source itself, incl. granted). Core: #fireAllyDealtDamageToCreatureTrigger tries registry.dispatch first (MayEffect, TriggeringPermanentConditional, PutCountersOnSource, CreateToken, SacrificePermanents, ExileDamagedCreature, DealDamageToPlayers handlers), then a long instanceof chain (ReflectAllyDamage..., DamageDamagedCreatureControllerAndSelf, DamagedCreatureTriggerEffect, TapAndSkipUntap, EquipmentTapsAndLocks, DestroyDamagedCreatureAtEndOfCombat, EquipmentDamagesOtherDefendingCreatures). Self/ally/equipped is decided per effect class (watcher==source checks). SURPRISE: the name says ally but most registrations are 'this creature deals damage to a creature'; no isCreature check on the damage source; the MayEffect handler only fires for combat damage (queueMayAbility). Mixed stack.add / enqueueTrigger / queueMayAbility. Callers: DamageSupport (noncombat) and CombatDamageService watcher/self reflection passes before SBA.

event: creature fights
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreatureFightsTriggers, called for both fighters from FightSupport and SourceFightsTargetCreatureEffectHandler; dispatchSlot over the fighter's controller's other permanents, then the fighter itself (still triggers if it died). Only handler: PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect -> enqueueTrigger RegisterDelayedCountersOnTriggeringPermanentEffect; with no default handler other effect classes never trigger. Fight is a keyword action (draft had 13.4).

event: spell cast
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers over the caster's graveyard (getEffectiveGraveyardEffects): only SpellCastTriggerEffect registrations honoured (others ignored); gates spellFilter, castSpellTargetCondition, nthSpellNumber, mana-spent; other SpellCastTriggerEffect fields (targetFilter, intervening, turn restrictions...) are not read here; each registration its own stack.add (no target/may queueing). SURPRISE: the manaCost path wraps only the FIRST resolved effect in a MayPayManaEffect (any further resolvedEffects are dropped) and sets triggeringCardId to the graveyard card rather than the spell.

event: spell cast
self: no (the card being cast is skipped)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers over the caster's hand: only SpellCastTriggerEffect (spellFilter + mana-spent gates); one stack object per registration holding its resolvedEffects; no target/may handling. Only user is Covercast (Summitfest Closing Ceremony), which registers the same trigger in GRAVEYARD_ON_CONTROLLER_CASTS_SPELL too.

event: spell cast
relation: you (owner of the face-up exiled card)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers loops face-up gameData.exiledCards owned by the caster and registry.dispatch()es each effect (null permanent); SpellCastTriggerCollectorService#handleExileResidentSpellCastTrigger -> handleGenericSpellCastTrigger (full SpellCastTriggerEffect gates, targeting/may there). No default handler, so non-SpellCastTriggerEffect registrations are silently ignored.

event: player sacrifices a token
relation: you (the exiled card's owner is the sacrificer)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkExileControllerTokenSacrificedTriggers, inside checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers: raw registry.dispatch with permanent=null, so no ability-loss check and no copies. Only handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleExileTokenSacrificePerpetualBoost (PerpetuallyBoostCardEffect); no default. Choke: checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers callers (SpellCastingService, AbilityActivationService, ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, StateBasedActionService, DepartureService, DestructionSupport, GraveyardService, LifeSupport, BattlefieldPlacementService, MakeAnExample and SacrificeEnchantedPermanentAndReattachSourceAura handlers).

event: you complete a dungeon
notes: TCS#checkDungeonCompletionTriggers (after the battlefield ON_CONTROLLER_COMPLETES_DUNGEON pass): printed card.getEffects (not getEffectiveGraveyardEffects), enqueueTrigger with graveyardEntryVersion; MayEffect stays wrapped on the stack.

event: you surveil
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSurveilTriggers reads getEffectiveGraveyardEffects of the surveiling player's graveyard; one enqueueTrigger per effect; no registry dispatch, no MayEffect/queueMayAbility path, no trigger-time condition check (Blood Operative's ConditionalEffect(SourceCardInGraveyard) only checked on resolution); unlike the proliferate graveyard reader the entry gets no triggeringCardId/graveyard entry version

event: you conjure one or more cards
notes: TCS#checkConjureTriggers (after battlefield ON_CONTROLLER_CONJURES pass): getEffectiveGraveyardEffects, plain enqueueTrigger, no entry version. checkConjureTriggers has ~73 call sites. Slot does not exclude the source card itself being conjured (it is in the graveyard).

event: you roll a natural 20
notes: TCS#checkControllerRollsNaturalTwentyTriggers: printed card.getEffects, enqueueTrigger, no graveyardEntryVersion (unlike dungeon/day-night graveyard readers).

event: exhaust ability activated (after costs)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerActivatesExhaustAbilityTriggersFromGraveyard, called from ActivatedAbilityExecutionService only for battlefield-permanent exhaust activations: one enqueueTrigger entry per registration (getEffectiveGraveyardEffects); no target/may/intervening-if handling.

event: player sacrifices a permanent
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkGraveyardAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers, from checkAllyPermanentSacrificedTriggers; skips the sacrificed card itself. Raw getEffects (not getEffectiveGraveyardEffects), so graveyard ability loss is ignored. MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else enqueueTrigger. Choke: same sacrifice callers as EXILE_ON_CONTROLLER_TOKEN_SACRIFICED.

event: permanent is turned face up
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkGraveyardAllyPermanentTurnsFaceUpTriggers, from GameService (turn-face-up path) and TurnFaceUpCopyService#finishTurnFaceUp. Raw getEffects, so graveyard ability loss is ignored. MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else enqueueTrigger.

event: creature card leaves a graveyard
relation: card in an opponent's graveyard (relative to this card's owner)
notes: Family is 12 (a card leaving a graveyard), not 13.11. TCS#checkCreatureCardLeavesOpponentGraveyardTriggers: getEffectiveGraveyardEffects; direct gameData.stack.add (bypasses enqueueTrigger); MayEffect stays wrapped. Choke points: GraveyardService#notifyCardLeftGraveyard (per card) and GraveyardService#clearGraveyard (per creature card); paths that remove graveyard cards without these miss it.

event: this card put into hand from its owner's graveyard
zone: graveyard (look-back; the card is already in hand when collected)
notes: Kept in step 12: the step 10 pilot is limited to the plan's list. TriggerCollectionService#checkCardReturnedToHandFromGraveyardTriggers, called only from GraveyardService#addCardToHandFromGraveyard when graveyard owner == hand owner; getEffectiveGraveyardEffects; enqueueTrigger per effect. Graveyard-to-hand moves that bypass addCardToHandFromGraveyard do not fire it. Family: the draft said 12, but this is the source's own zone change (graveyard to hand).

event: spell cast
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers over the caster's command zone: only SpellCastTriggerEffect.spellFilter checked (no mana/nth/target-condition gates, unlike the graveyard reader); stack.add of resolvedEffects per registration; no target/may handling and no triggeringCardId set. The 'if in the command zone' clause relies on a SourceCardInCommandZone intervening-if wrapper.

event: you lose life (damage or direct loss), amount > 0
notes: TCS#checkLifeLossTriggers second loop: hasLostPrintedAbilities only, no granted abilities; unwraps OncePerTurnTriggerEffect (firstLifeLoss vs unkeyed once flag; key/markOnAcceptance ignored) and ConditionalEffect, then registry.dispatch directly (bypasses TCS#dispatch: no additional-trigger copies). So the ConditionalEffect and OncePerTurnTriggerEffect handlers for this slot are dead. No CardEffect default handler. SURPRISE: duplicate SequenceEffect handlers (Misc#handleSequenceOnControllerLifeLoss sets eventValue; LifeGain#handleLifeGainSequence does not) - last registered wins; Marina Vendrell's Grimoire (discard EventValue) depends on the Misc one. Also written at runtime by SpecializeShadowheartEffectHandler#resolve.

event: you put counters (any kind) on a creature
relation: you (placing player); creature controlled by another player
multiplicity: per object (per creature per placement call)
notes: PermanentCounterSupport#fireCountersPutOnCreatureYouDontControlTriggers, from both PermanentCounterSupport#notifyCountersPlaced overloads; watchers on the placer's battlefield; all slot effects in one stack.add entry (Kros's 2 registrations = one ability), nonTargeting, eventValue=count, triggeringPermanentId/controller set; skips sources that lost abilities

event: you put counters (any kind) on a creature
relation: you (placing player); creature of any controller
multiplicity: per object (per creature per placement call)
notes: PermanentCounterSupport#fireYouPutCountersOnCreatureTriggers (private), from both PermanentCounterSupport#notifyCountersPlaced overloads (counter-type overload only when triggerCollectionService is wired); one stack.add entry per watcher with all effects, nonTargeting, eventValue=count, triggeringPermanentId set; skips sources that lost abilities

event: you pay life (cost payment, distinct from loss)
notes: TCS#checkLifePaymentTriggers: printed + granted effects, unwraps OncePerTurnTriggerEffect, TCS#dispatch. No ability-loss check on printed effects. Only handler: PutCountersOnSelfEffect (eventValue = life paid); other classes silently never trigger.

event: an opponent pays mana for a tax imposed by your spell or permanent
notes: TCS#checkTaxPaymentTriggers (7 call sites): printed + granted effects, no ability-loss check, unwrapOncePerTurnTrigger, TCS#dispatch. Only handler: CreateTokenEffect (eventValue = mana paid, Tax Taker); other classes silently never trigger.

event: this permanent leaves the battlefield (any destination)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSelfLeavesTriggered: printed + temporary + persistent effects only if hadPrintedAbilities; each dispatched (handleSelfLeavesDefault: targeted/graveyard-target -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else stack entry; many specific handlers); destination zone in TriggerContext.SelfLeaves. Also drains DelayedZoneChangeTrigger actions and TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility watchers keyed to this slot for the watched permanent. Choke points: every PermanentRemovalService leave path (graveyard via removePermanentToGraveyard/processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, hand, command zone, exile, library variants, removeOrphanedAuras, enforceAttachmentLegality).

event: permanent leaves the battlefield (any destination)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnotherPermanentLeavesBattlefieldTriggers: watchers = battlefield + simultaneousDyingPermanents + face-up schemes; direct getEffects + enqueueTrigger. Checks ability loss, including a look-back for a Humility-style static on the leaving permanent. TransformSelfWhenChosenPermanentLeavesEffect fires only for the chosen permanent; TriggeringPermanentConditional and LeavingPermanentIdAware binding. No target support, no copies. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToGraveyard, #processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, #returnPermanentToHand, #removePermanentToCommandZone, #removePermanentWithoutDestination, #removePermanentToExile, #removePermanentToLibraryTop/Bottom/Position, #removePermanentToLibrary.

event: creature leaves the battlefield (any destination; last-known creature)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnotherCreatureLeavesBattlefieldTriggers: watchers = permanentLeaveBatchWatchers snapshot inside a leave batch, otherwise the live battlefield (no simultaneous-dying look-back outside batches); only the until-EOT ability-loss flag. Effect-dependent path: a card-declared target -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget interaction (Extractor Demon), else enqueueTrigger; LeavingCreatureNameAwareEffect skips tokens. Face-up planes queue non-targeting entries. No copies. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToGraveyard, #processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, #returnPermanentToHand, #removePermanentToCommandZone, #removePermanentWithoutDestination, #removePermanentToExile, #removePermanentToLibraryTop/Bottom/Position, #removePermanentToLibrary.

event: artifact leaves the battlefield (any destination)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnotherArtifactLeavesBattlefieldTriggers: watchers = controller's battlefield + simultaneousDyingPermanents; until-EOT flag only. Declared target -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget (Sludge Strider's MayPayManaEffect with a player target), else enqueueTrigger; MayPayManaEffect is not routed through queueMayAbility. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToGraveyard, #processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, #returnPermanentToHand, #removePermanentToCommandZone, #removePermanentWithoutDestination, #removePermanentToExile, #removePermanentToLibraryTop/Bottom/Position, #removePermanentToLibrary.

event: artifact put into a graveyard or exile from the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnotherNontokenArtifactPutIntoGraveyardOrExileFromBattlefieldTriggers: the destination is the caller's intended zone (removePermanentToGraveyard always passes GRAVEYARD, even if a replacement then moves the card elsewhere); face-down and until-EOT-ability-loss watchers are skipped; declared target -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget (Psychomancer), else enqueueTrigger. The registration stats show no effects because the cards register a shared local or use target(...).addEffect. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToGraveyard, #processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, #removePermanentToExile.

event: creature leaves the battlefield (any destination)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreatureLeavesBattlefieldTriggers: watchers = leave-batch snapshot, or battlefield + simultaneousDying; until-EOT flag only. Unwraps OncePerTurn, binds LeavingCreatureCountersAware/LeavingPermanentCountersAware, evaluates ConditionalEffect at trigger time (forStaticEffect, whatever the interveningIf flag), targeted -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, else enqueueTrigger. Zurgo Stormrender's 2 registrations give 2 objects. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToGraveyard, #processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, #returnPermanentToHand, #removePermanentToCommandZone, #removePermanentWithoutDestination, #removePermanentToExile, #removePermanentToLibraryTop/Bottom/Position, #removePermanentToLibrary.

event: creature put into exile from the battlefield (includes graveyard-replaced-by-exile)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreatureExiledFromBattlefieldTriggers: watchers = battlefield + simultaneousDying; until-EOT flag only; TriggeringPermanentConditional; enqueueTrigger, no target support. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToExile, #processGraveyardAndTriggers (exile replacement).

event: creature put into exile from the battlefield (includes graveyard-replaced-by-exile)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyCreatureExiledFromBattlefieldTriggers: dispatchSlot over battlefield + simultaneousDying, excluding the exiled creature, BUT dispatchCounterReturnForLeavingSource first lets the exiled creature itself fire ReturnTriggeringPermanentToBattlefieldWithCounterEffect / DyingCreatureControllerMayDrawCardEffect. Handlers MiscTriggerCollectorService: default (eventValue = exiled power) and ReturnTriggeringPermanentToBattlefieldWithCounterEffect (needs the counter). SURPRISE (suspected rules bug): Athreos ('another creature with a coin counter') would return itself if exiled while a creature with a coin counter; there is no self guard in the handler or resolver. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToExile, #processGraveyardAndTriggers.

event: creatures leave the battlefield to a non-graveyard zone (without dying)
multiplicity: per event inside a permanent-leave batch; per creature outside one
notes: Unbatched: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreatureLeavesBattlefieldWithoutDyingTriggers fires for each leaving creature. Batched: #checkAllyCreatureLeavesBattlefieldWithoutDyingBatchTriggers at PermanentRemovalService#endPermanentLeaveBatch, once per watcher (watchers = batch-start snapshot, so a co-leaving watcher still triggers). Shared enqueueCreatureLeavesBattlefieldWithoutDyingTriggers: hasLostPrintedAbilities; targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#notifyCreatureLeftWithoutDying (returnPermanentToHand, removePermanentToCommandZone, removePermanentWithoutDestination, removePermanentToExile, library paths); batches are opened by BounceSupport, DepartureService, DestructionSupport and mass-exile handlers. SURPRISE: unbatched multi-creature removals fire this one-or-more trigger once per creature.

event: creature leaves the battlefield to a non-graveyard zone (without dying)
notes: Same two readers as ON_ALLY_CREATURES_LEAVE_BATTLEFIELD_WITHOUT_DYING (unbatched check fires both slots per leaving creature; the batch check enqueues this slot once per other leaving creature) and the same enqueueCreatureLeavesBattlefieldWithoutDyingTriggers helper. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#notifyCreatureLeftWithoutDying / #endPermanentLeaveBatch.

event: creature leaves the battlefield to a non-graveyard zone (without dying)
multiplicity: per object (per leaving creature, both paths)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSelfOrAllyCreatureLeavesBattlefieldWithoutDyingTriggers (leaving creature's own slot + battlefield sources) / #...BatchTriggers (per watcher x leaving controlled creatures); helper enqueueCreatureLeavesBattlefieldWithoutDyingTriggers. SURPRISE: the plural name, the draft, and Aang, Airbending Master's Oracle text ('Whenever one or more creatures you control leave the battlefield without dying') call for once per event, but both paths fire per leaving creature, so Aang gets N experience counters. Three Tree Scribe ('this or another creature') is correctly per creature. The slot mixes the two semantics.

event: permanent leaves the battlefield while its controller is the active player
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyPermanentLeavesBattlefieldDuringControllerTurnTriggers: watchers = battlefield + simultaneousDying; until-EOT flag only; OncePerTurn unwrap + mark; TriggeringPermanentConditional; enqueueTrigger, no target support. Oni-Cult Anvil's 'one or more artifacts' is modelled as per object + once per turn; its own leaving is covered by a separate ON_SELF_LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD registration. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToGraveyard, #processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, #returnPermanentToHand, #removePermanentToCommandZone, #removePermanentWithoutDestination, #removePermanentToExile, #removePermanentToLibraryTop/Bottom/Position, #removePermanentToLibrary.

event: permanent leaves the battlefield (any destination)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyPermanentLeavesBattlefieldTriggers: watchers = battlefield + simultaneousDying + face-up schemes; until-EOT flag only. OncePerTurn unwrap, LeavingPermanentCountersAware binding, ConditionalEffect evaluated at trigger time, targeted -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, else enqueueTrigger. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToGraveyard, #processAlreadyRemovedToGraveyard, #returnPermanentToHand, #removePermanentToCommandZone, #removePermanentWithoutDestination, #removePermanentToExile, #removePermanentToLibraryTop/Bottom/Position, #removePermanentToLibrary.

event: one or more permanents leave the battlefield
multiplicity: per event inside a permanent-leave batch; per permanent outside one
notes: Unbatched: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyPermanentsLeaveBattlefieldTriggers (controller's battlefield + the leaving permanent). Batched: #checkAllyPermanentsLeaveBattlefieldBatchTriggers at endPermanentLeaveBatch. Both use enqueueAllyPermanentsLeaveBattlefieldTriggers: hasLostPrintedAbilities; targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processRemovalCleanup -> notifyPermanentLeftBattlefield (every removal path). SURPRISE: removals not wrapped in a leave batch fire this one-or-more trigger (Nefarious Imp) once per permanent.

event: Aura or Equipment put into a graveyard from the battlefield
object: Aura or Equipment (filter in the caller)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyAuraOrEquipmentPutIntoGraveyardTriggers via dispatchSlot over battlefield + simultaneousDying (those that keep abilities); the source sees itself only through look-back. Only two handlers (DeathTriggerCollectorService): RegisterDelayedReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect (Mazzy) and ExileTriggeringAuraFromGraveyardMayCastUntilNextTurnEffect (Tiana; Aura only). No default handler, so other effect classes never trigger. Direct stack.add. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers, #removeOrphanedAuras, #enforceAttachmentLegality.

event: one or more creatures declared as attackers (count as xValue)
relation: you control; owned-commander form: your commander attacks under anyone's control
multiplicity: per event (once per declaration); owned-commander form: per attacking matching commander
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~2595-2720) via GameQueryService#getEffectiveGraveyardEffects. Normal form: attacking player's graveyard only, graveyardAttackConditionsMet + MinimumAttackers/HasAttacker unwrapped, one stack.add per registration with graveyard-entry version bound. isOwnedCommanderAttackTrigger form scans every player's graveyard and fires once per attacking commander they own (no entry-version binding). No target support. AI reader: CombatSimulator#hasPerAttackerAllyTrigger.

event: attacking creature isn't blocked (declare blockers)
notes: CombatBlockService#checkUnblockedExileCardTriggers (from the no-blocks path and declareBlockers); face-up exiled cards owned by the active player; TriggeringCardConditionalEffect filtered against the attacker and unwrapped; all matching effects of one card in one stack.add per attacker, nonTargeting, targetId/triggeringPermanentId = attacker, sourcePermanentId = exiled.sourcePermanentId().

event: one or more creatures declared as attackers (count as xValue)
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~2722-2750): face-up exiled cards owned by the attacking player; all slot effects in one stack.add, no condition filtering, no target support, no triggered-ability copy scope.

event: creature deals combat damage to a player (not battles)
relation: you control; owner-relative pass: commander you own under another player's control
multiplicity: per object (per dealing creature); oneOrMoreDealers: once per (recipient, controller) batch
notes: CombatDamageService#checkAllyCreatureCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers tail, from #processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers per dealing creature. Reads the dealer controller's graveyard (owner-relative pass reads other players' graveyards, keeping only owned-commander triggers). Only AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect is honored (anything else silently ignored); stack.add per registration with source-card graveyard version bound. Returns early for battle damage.

event: creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker
multiplicity: per object (per dealing creature per recipient kind); oncePerDamageStep: once per batch
notes: CombatDamageService#checkGraveyardAllyCreatureCombatDamageTriggers, called from #checkAllyCreatureCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers (player damage) and #processAllyDealtDamageToPlaneswalkerTriggers (per source per damaged planeswalker). Only AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect honored; stack.add per registration. Only registrant (Forgeborn Phoenix) gets it perpetually from ON_DEATH/ON_EQUIPPED_CREATURE_DIES, so there are no static addEffect registrations. Player and planeswalker passes use different firedBatched sets, so a oncePerDamageStep trigger could fire twice in one step.

event: creature put into a graveyard from the battlefield (dies)
relation: owner's graveyard (source is in the dying creature's owner's graveyard)
notes: Tail of TriggerCollectionService#checkCreaturePutIntoOwnersGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers: skips the dying card and cards that died simultaneously; getEffectiveGraveyardEffects. queueGraveyardCreaturePutTrigger: TriggeringCardConditional filter, SourceCardInGraveyard rebound to the entry version, MayPayManaEffect/MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else stack.add; stamps the graveyard entry version. The name says controller, but it is ownership-based. Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers (creature branch, with graveyardLookBackExcludedCardIds). Family: the draft said 12; this is the graveyard form of a creature-death trigger (Recover).

event: creature put into a graveyard from the battlefield (dies)
relation: opponent's graveyard (source is in a graveyard of a player other than the dying creature's owner)
notes: Second loop of TriggerCollectionService#checkCreaturePutIntoOwnersGraveyardFromBattlefieldTriggers, same queueGraveyardCreaturePutTrigger path as the controller-graveyard slot (Bridge from Below's exile half). Choke: PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers. Family: the draft said 12; this is the graveyard form of a creature-death trigger.

event: land card put into a graveyard from any zone
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAnyLandPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereTriggers iterates every graveyard; getEffectiveGraveyardEffects; TriggeringCardConditional filter; MayPayManaEffect/MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else enqueueTrigger. Source not excluded, but only a land-card source could match itself. Choke: GraveyardService#addCardToGraveyard -> collectCardPutIntoGraveyardTriggers (nontoken land).

event: combat damage is dealt to you or a planeswalker you control
multiplicity: per damaged recipient (once per damaged player + once per damaged planeswalker)
notes: CombatDamageService#checkGraveyardCombatDamageToYouOrPlaneswalkerTriggers in the combat damage step (before SBA). All slot effects of a card bound to the graveyard version and queued as one AttackTriggerTarget interaction (targets chosen as it goes on the stack, skipped with no legal target). Vengeful Pharaoh's 2 registrations form one ability. Recipient player set built only when damageToDefendingPlayer/poison > 0.

event: land enters the battlefield (landfall)
notes: Graveyard loop at the end of TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyLandEntersTriggers (getEffectiveGraveyardEffects): entering-land subtype conditional, intervening-if; MayEffect -> queueMayAbility (graveyard entry version stamped), other effects (incl. MayPayManaEffect) -> direct stack.add with no target handling; no doublers. Only for non-face-down land entries. choke point: EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers (run at the end of EtbTriggerService#processCreatureETBEffects / processFaceDownCreatureETBTriggers, which are reached from ~300 call sites via BattlefieldEntryService#processCreatureETBEffects/processLandETBEffects and AsEntersInteractionService#handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield).

event: enters the battlefield
relation: you control (entering creature's controller = graveyard owner)
notes: Inline loop at the end of TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreatureEntersTriggers (graveyard of the entering creature's controller, getEffectiveGraveyardEffects); choke point EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers. Unwraps TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (raw entering card) then TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect (entering permanent); MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else direct gameData.stack.add (not enqueueTrigger) with graveyard entry version; entering-permanent reference baked as non-targeting targetId. No target-selection path at all. Added after Naban/Panharmonicon duplication so never doubled.

event: enters the battlefield
relation: you control; also your commander entering under another player's control
notes: TriggerCollectionService#queueGraveyardPermanentEntersTriggers, called from #checkAllyPermanentEntersTriggers (choke point EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers). SURPRISE: also scans every other player's graveyard, but there only registrations that are TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect(PermanentIsCommanderPredicate(ownedBySourceController)) can fire ('whenever your commander enters' under someone else's control); both current users (Endless Ranks of HYDRA, Vivi's Persistence) are exactly that. MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else enqueueTrigger (MayPayManaEffect rides the stack). No targeting path.

event: enters the battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkGraveyardAnyCreatureEntersTriggers (private), called from #checkAllyCreatureEntersTriggers (choke point EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers); scans all graveyards, trigger controlled by graveyard owner. Javadoc says it is checked in checkAllyCreatureEntersTriggers (true only indirectly). Same unwrap/queue shape as the ALLY variant but uses enqueueTrigger and does NOT stamp the source's graveyard entry version (ALLY variant does). No targeting path.

event: dies (battlefield -> graveyard)
relation: you control (dying creature's controller = graveyard owner)
multiplicity: per object; BatchedCreatureDeathTriggerEffect registrations once per simultaneous death batch
notes: Per-death: TriggerCollectionService#checkGraveyardAllyCreatureDeathTriggers from PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers; batched: #collectBatchedGraveyardAllyCreatureDeathTriggers from #checkBatchedAllyCreatureDeathTriggers (PermanentRemovalService#performSimultaneousRemovals, DepartureService#perform). Per-death skips the dying card and cards that died in the same batch; unwraps only TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (no permanent/LKI conditionals, unlike the OPPONENT variant); MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else direct stack.add. Grouping split: per-death registrations each; a card's batched registrations share ONE stack entry (may ones queued separately). SURPRISE: the batched collector picks ALLY slot if any ally creature is in the batch, otherwise OPPONENT slot, so a mixed batch never fires the OPPONENT slot (Soul Shredder relies on registering in both to mean 'any creature').

event: dies (battlefield -> graveyard)
relation: opponent controls (dying creature controlled by a player other than the graveyard owner)
multiplicity: per object; BatchedCreatureDeathTriggerEffect registrations once per batch
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkGraveyardOpponentCreatureDeathTriggers (PermanentRemovalService#processGraveyardAndTriggers) + #collectBatchedGraveyardAllyCreatureDeathTriggers for batched effects. Uses unwrapCreatureDeathConditional (TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect supported) then #queueGraveyardCreatureDeathTrigger: MayPayManaEffect/MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else stack.add with triggeringCardId and targetId=dying controller for LoseLifeEffect(DYING_CREATURE_CONTROLLER). SURPRISE: batched registrations are skipped whenever any creature of the graveyard owner died in the same batch (collector switches to the ALLY slot). SourceCardInGraveyard conditions are not version-bound here.

event: creature enters the battlefield from a graveyard, or after being cast from a graveyard
relation: entered from your graveyard, or cast from a graveyard by you
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkGraveyardCreatureEntersFromGraveyardTriggers, choke point EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers. Every registration goes straight to gameData.stack.add with no unwrapping, may or target handling (Prized Amalgam's RegisterDelayedSelfReturnFromGraveyardEffect). SURPRISE (edge rules bug): the cast branch matches the graveyard of the entering creature's controller, not the graveyard it was cast from, so casting an opponent's creature card from their graveyard triggers your Amalgams.

event: enters the battlefield
relation: you control (entering artifact's controller = graveyard owner)
notes: Inline loop at the end of TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyArtifactEntersTriggers (choke point EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers); uses getEffectiveGraveyardEffects and the entering permanent's effective characteristics for TriggeringCardConditionalEffect. MayEffect -> queueMayAbility (sets triggeringCardId = the graveyard card itself), else direct stack.add; both stamp graveyard entry version. No TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect or targeting support.

event: enters the battlefield
relation: you control (entering enchantment's controller = graveyard owner)
notes: Inline loop at the end of TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyEnchantmentEntersTriggers (choke point EtbTriggerService#collectEntersTriggers). SURPRISE (rules bug): reads raw card.getEffects instead of getEffectiveGraveyardEffects, so 'cards in graveyards lose all abilities' and perpetual grants are ignored (the other graveyard-enter readers honour both). MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, else direct stack.add (MayPayManaEffect rides the stack).

event: opponent is dealt noncombat damage by a red instant/sorcery spell or red planeswalker you control
object: red instant or sorcery spell, or red planeswalker
multiplicity: per object (per damage application to an opponent)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkRedSpellOrPlaneswalkerDamageToOpponentTriggers, from DamageSupport noncombat player-damage path (~1679) only. Entry must be INSTANT_SPELL/SORCERY_SPELL or have a planeswalker source permanent; color from effective colors or LKI. Plain stack.add per registration, no graveyard-version binding. Combat damage from a red planeswalker creature never reaches this reader.

event: instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage to an opponent or a battle
relation: you control; recipient another player or a battle
multiplicity: per damaged recipient (per opponent/battle recorded in the spell's damage batch)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkInstantOrSorceryDamageToOpponentOrBattleTriggers, called getInstantOrSorceryDamageRecipientCount() times from DamageSupport#flushSourceDamageReflections (end of resolution; also DamageSupport ~1755/1915, EffectResolutionService ~609). Recipients recorded in DamageSupport#accumulateSourceDamageForReflection (player != caster, or printed BATTLE). enqueueTrigger per registration; MayPayManaEffect goes on the stack unwrapped (resolved later); no graveyard-version binding.

event: source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent
relation: you control; damaged player is another player
multiplicity: per object (per noncombat damage application to a player)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkNoncombatDamageToOpponentTriggers (graveyard tail), from DamageSupport noncombat player-damage path (~1677). Reads the source controller's graveyard; stack.add per registration, no graveyard-version binding, MayPayManaEffect not unwrapped. Draft family 13.3 is wrong (noncombat, 13.4).

event: +1/+1 counters put on this
multiplicity: per event; TriggerMode.PER_COUNTER registrations per counter
notes: PermanentCounterSupport#firePlusOnePlusOneCountersPutOnSelfTriggers (via PermanentCounterSupport#firePlusOnePlusOneCounterTriggers, RenownEffectHandler). PER_COUNTER registrations: one stack object per registration per counter (SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget interaction if targeted); all other registrations share one object (interaction if any declares a target, else stack.add); YouPutCounterOnControlledCreatureTriggerEffect gates placer==controller; OncePerTurn unwrapped; hasLostPrintedAbilities check. SURPRISE: PER_COUNTER uses the caller's count, but most callers (PutCountersOnSourceEffectHandler, PutCounterOnEach*Handler, DoublePlusOneCounters*Handler, the short firePlusOnePlusOneCounterTriggers overloads) pass 1, so a Fathom Mage-style per-counter trigger fires once for N counters there

event: this trains (its training trigger resolves and puts a +1/+1 counter on it)
notes: TrainEffectHandler#resolve fires it mid-resolution when placeCounterOnPermanent returned >0; all effects in one stack.add entry with no target interaction, except when one is a BattlefieldAndGraveyardCardChoosingEffect: then GraveyardTargetingService#handleBattlefieldAndGraveyardExileTargeting takes all of them; no ability-loss check. Also read by PermanentRemovalService#handleExileReturnOnLeave only to detect leaves-trigger exile returns (ExileTargetCreaturesUntilSourceLeavesEffect)

multiplicity: per object (per Human per placement call)
notes: PermanentCounterSupport#firePlusOnePlusOneCountersPutOnControlledHumanTriggers, from PermanentCounterSupport#firePlusOnePlusOneCounterTriggers; OncePerTurn unwrapped and marked immediately (masks per-object vs 'one or more Humans' for Cloaked Cadet); one stack.add entry; no ability-loss check

event: this Class becomes level 2 (or its first level counter is placed)
notes: SURPRISE: two readers. ClassLevelUpEffectHandler#resolve (Class level is Permanent.classLevel, not counters; uses ClassLevelUpEffect.gainedEffects instead when non-empty): SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger if a graveyard target, SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget if permanent/player target, else stack.add. PermanentCounterSupport#fireSelfReachesLevelTwoTriggers via notifySelfCountersPlaced on LEVEL counters fires when level counters go 0 -> >=1 (PermanentCounterSupport#queueLevelReachedTriggers; only permanent targets get an interaction, player targets don't). All 3 cards are Classes, so the counter path is effectively dead and its semantics differ

event: this Class becomes level 3 (or reaches the level-counter threshold)
notes: SURPRISE: same two readers as ON_SELF_REACHES_LEVEL_TWO: ClassLevelUpEffectHandler#resolve (classLevel) and PermanentCounterSupport#fireSelfReachesLevelThreeTriggers (threshold 2 level counters if the card has >1 level-up abilities, else 3 - 'historical' rule); Cool but Rude's 2 registrations share one stack object

multiplicity: per object (per creature per placement call)
notes: Same shared PermanentCounterSupport#firePlusOnePlusOneCountersPutOnControlledPermanentTriggers(slot) from recordPlusOnePlusOneCounterPlacedOnControlledPermanent (creature and controller==placer); same event as ON_CONTROLLER_PUT_PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE_COUNTERS_ON_CREATURE but grouped differently (duplicate slot). SURPRISE: PutCountersOnSourceEffectHandler (PutCountersOnSourceEffect, ~387 card uses) never calls recordPlusOnePlusOneCounterPlacedOnControlledPermanent, so this slot does not fire for that placement path

event: +1/+1 counters put on a creature (any placer)
multiplicity: per object (per creature per placement call)
notes: Same shared PermanentCounterSupport#firePlusOnePlusOneCountersPutOnControlledPermanentTriggers(slot) from recordPlusOnePlusOneCounterPlacedOnControlledPermanent (creature, no placer check); targeted effects (Shalai and Hallar) via SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget with eventValue=count. multiplicity: per object (per permanent per placement call)

event: you put counters (any kind) on a creature

notes: PermanentCounterSupport#fireCounterPutOnControlledCreatureTriggers (from placeCountersOnPermanents, placeCounterOnPermanent for non +-1 kinds, fireMinusOneMinusOneCounterPutOnCreatureTriggers, firePlusOnePlusOneCounterTriggers, BattlefieldPlacementService); per iteration all surviving registrations share one object (SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget if any targets, else stack.add); unwraps YouPutCounterOnControlledCreatureTriggerEffect (placer==controller), TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect, intervening-if ConditionalEffect, OncePerTurn, OncePerTurnPerCreature (first counters on that creature this turn); no ability-loss check.
