event: you put -1/-1 counters on a creature
relation: you (placing player); creature of any controller
multiplicity: per object (per creature per placement call)
notes: Same PermanentCounterSupport#fireMinusOneMinusOneCounterPutOnCreatureTriggers loop, only for watchers whose controller is the placer; one stack.add per watcher with all registrations (Obelisk Spider's 2 effects share it), eventValue=count, no triggeringPermanentId; skips only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn sources

event: one or more cards leave your graveyard (any destination)
multiplicity: per event when batched (begin/endGraveyardLeaveBatch or list-form notify); per card for single-card notifies
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCardsLeaveGraveyardTriggers via dispatchSlot. MiscTriggerCollectorService handlers: ChooseModeNotYetChosenThisTurnEffect (modal interaction), TriggeringCardConditionalEffect (any leaving card matches), OncePerTurnTriggerEffect (likely unreachable: dispatchSlotEffect unwraps once-per-turn first), default -> shared handleControllerArtifactOrCreatureCardsLeaveGraveyard (TriggeringCardsAware binding, interveningIf check, targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger). Oasis of Renewal's 2 registrations give 2 objects. Choke: GraveyardService#notifyCardsLeftGraveyard (many callers) / #endGraveyardLeaveBatch.

event: card put from your graveyard into your hand
notes: Family is 12 (graveyard->hand zone change), not 13.11. TCS#checkControllerCardReturnedFromGraveyardToHandTriggers -> dispatchSlot -> MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerCardReturnedFromGraveyardToHand (CardEffect default; frozen snapshot of the returned card). Only choke point: GraveyardService#addCardToHandFromGraveyard (hand owner must equal graveyard owner); other graveyard->hand paths do not fire it.

event: instant or sorcery card leaves your graveyard
multiplicity: per object (per card, also inside batches)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerInstantOrSorceryCardLeavesGraveyardTriggers via dispatchSlot; default handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerInstantOrSorceryCardLeavesGraveyard -> enqueueTrigger, no targeting. Choke: GraveyardService#notifyInstantOrSorceryCardLeftGraveyard / #endGraveyardLeaveBatch.

event: one or more cards exiled from your graveyard
multiplicity: per event when batched or list-form; per card for single-card notifies
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCardsExiledFromGraveyardTriggers via dispatchSlot, which then chains checkControllerCardsExiledFromLibraryOrGraveyardTriggers. Default handler eventValue = count, direct stack.add. Choke: GraveyardService#notifyCardsExiledFromGraveyard / #endGraveyardLeaveBatch.

event: one or more cards exiled from your library and/or graveyard
multiplicity: per event (per graveyard-exile event; per library-exile resolution)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCardsExiledFromLibraryOrGraveyardTriggers via dispatchSlot; default handler eventValue = count, stack.add. Graveyard side comes from checkControllerCardsExiledFromGraveyardTriggers. SURPRISE: the library side is fired only by ExileTopCardsToSourceEffectHandler, ExileTopCardMayPlayThisTurnEffectHandler, ExileRandomCardFromLibraryMayPlayThisTurnEffectHandler and DiscoverEffectHandler, so other library-exile effects do not trigger it; one event exiling from both zones fires twice.

event: creatures you control exiled from the battlefield and/or creature cards exiled from your graveyard
multiplicity: per event inside a graveyard-leave batch; otherwise per graveyard-exile event and per exiled creature permanent
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCreaturesOrCreatureCardsExiledTriggers via dispatchSlot, from GraveyardService#notifyCardsExiledFromGraveyard and #notifyCardsExiledFromBattlefield (PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToExile, #processGraveyardAndTriggers). Handler: KayaSpiritsJusticeEffect -> DrawTriggerPermanentTarget interaction (token target) carrying the exiled creature card ids; default stack.add. SURPRISE: battlefield exiles are batched only by the graveyard-leave batch, not by the permanent-leave/card-exile batches that mass-exile handlers open (e.g. ExileAllPermanentsEffectHandler), so a board exile fires once per creature.

event: a card is put into exile from any zone
object: nontoken card owned by an opponent (face-down included)
multiplicity: per event (card-exile batch) or per card
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentOwnedCardExiledTriggers is the GameData opponentOwnedCardExiledListener (GameSetupService), fired from GameData#notifyCardsExiled / runAsSingleCardExileBatch; dispatchSlot; default handler stack.add. SURPRISE: it reads only gameData.exiledCards.getLast(), so a batch whose last card is yours (or a token) misses the opponent-owned cards exiled earlier in the same batch.

event: one or more cards exiled from any graveyard or from the battlefield during the source controller's turn
relation: any graveyard or battlefield; source controller is the active player
zone: battlefield (plus look-back for itself when exiled)
multiplicity: per event inside a graveyard-leave batch (count forced to 1); otherwise per graveyard-exile event and per exiled permanent
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCardsExiledFromGraveyardsOrBattlefieldDuringYourTurnTriggers (active player's battlefield, dispatchSlot) + #checkDepartedPermanentCardsExiledDuringYourTurnTriggers (the exiled source itself, direct getEffects + dispatch, called only from PermanentRemovalService#removePermanentToExile, so not for exile-replaced deaths). Default handler eventValue = count, stack.add. Callers GraveyardService#notifyCardsExiledFromGraveyard, #notifyCardsExiledFromBattlefield, #endGraveyardLeaveBatch. SURPRISE: same batching gap as Kaya, so a board exile fires once per exiled permanent.

event: you proliferate
multiplicity: per event (per proliferate; repeated proliferateCount times)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkProliferateTriggers -> dispatchSlot; MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleProliferateDefault (CardEffect default, one enqueueTrigger per registration) and #handleConditionalProliferate (intervening-if checked at trigger time)

event: you proliferate
multiplicity: per event (per proliferate; repeated proliferateCount times)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkProliferateTriggers reads getEffectiveGraveyardEffects of the proliferator's graveyard; one enqueueTrigger per effect with triggeringCardId + graveyard entry version; no registry dispatch, no trigger-time intervening-if check (Ichor Aberration shares one ConditionalEffect instance between its battlefield and graveyard slots), no MayEffect path

event: +1/+1 counters put on a creature you control (any placer)
multiplicity: per object (per creature per placement call)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkGraveyardAllyPlusOnePlusOneCountersPutOnCreatureTriggers from PermanentCounterSupport#recordPlusOnePlusOneCountersPutOnControlledCreaturesThisTurn (this one is reached by PutCountersOnSourceEffectHandler too); getEffectiveGraveyardEffects; MayEffect -> queueMayAbility, others enqueueTrigger with triggeringCardId + entry version; no trigger-time 'if in graveyard' check beyond presence

event: one or more cards put into exile from any zone during your turn
relation: any; source controller is the active player
multiplicity: per event (GameData card-exile batch via runAsSingleCardExileBatch), else per card
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCardsExiledDuringTurnTriggers via checkCardsExiledTriggers (GameData cardsExiledListener from GameData#notifyCardsExiled); dispatchSlot on the active player's battlefield; MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerCardsExiledDuringTurn -> stack.add. Uses the card-exile batch, a third batching mechanism separate from the graveyard-leave and permanent-leave batches. A source exiling itself does not see it (no look-back).

event: one or more creature cards leave your graveyard
multiplicity: per event when batched/list-form; per card for single-card notifies
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCreatureCardsLeaveGraveyardTriggers via dispatchSlot; skips a permanent made from one of the leaving cards (isPermanentMadeFrom); cards entering under a creature-ETB-trigger suppressor (Hushbringer) are dropped (withoutSuppressedEntries). Shared handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerCreatureCardsLeaveGraveyard (also used by the singular slot) -> direct stack.add, no targeting support. Choke: GraveyardService#notifyCreatureCardsLeftGraveyard / #endGraveyardLeaveBatch.

event: creature card leaves your graveyard
multiplicity: per object (per card, also inside batches)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCreatureCardLeavesGraveyardTriggers is called N times with the same card list (the context has no per-card identity); same isPermanentMadeFrom skip and the same shared stack.add handler, no targeting. Along the Crooked Way's ConditionalReplacementEffect here is an if/else effect, not a replacement. Choke: GraveyardService#notifyCreatureCardsLeftGraveyard / #endGraveyardLeaveBatch.

event: one or more artifact and/or creature cards leave your graveyard
multiplicity: per event when batched/list-form; per card for single-card notifies
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerArtifactOrCreatureCardsLeaveGraveyardTriggers via dispatchSlot; handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerArtifactOrCreatureCardsLeaveGraveyard (TriggeringCardsAware binding, interveningIf ConditionalEffect, targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger). No isPermanentMadeFrom skip, unlike the creature-cards slot. Choke: GraveyardService#notifyArtifactOrCreatureCardsLeftGraveyard / #endGraveyardLeaveBatch.

event: one or more artifact cards leave your graveyard
multiplicity: per event when batched/list-form; per card for single-card notifies
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerArtifactCardsLeaveGraveyardTriggers via dispatchSlot; the context carries no card list. Handler MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerArtifactCardsLeaveGraveyard (interveningIf check; targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger). No isPermanentMadeFrom skip. Choke: GraveyardService#notifyArtifactCardsLeftGraveyard / #endGraveyardLeaveBatch.

event: a creature you control explores
notes: TCS#checkExploreTriggers: all registrations of one permanent (after TriggeringCardConditionalEffect filtering against the revealed card, null when nothing revealed) go into ONE stack object; any permanent-targeting effect -> ExploreTriggerTarget for the whole group, else direct gameData.stack.add (bypasses enqueueTrigger). Only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn checked (no static loss / hasLostPrintedAbilities), no registry, no granted abilities, iterates live battlefield. Callers: ExploreEffectHandler, MayMiscHandlerService.

event: a creature you control connives
notes: TCS#checkAllyCreatureConniveTriggers (uses LKI controller) -> dispatchSlot -> MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleAllyCreatureConnivesDefault: always non-targeting, targetId = conniving creature, enqueueTrigger; MayPayManaEffect stays wrapped.

event: this exploits a creature (sacrifice from its ExploitEffect completed)
notes: TCS#checkExploitTriggers: all registrations in ONE stack object, routed by the first matching targeting kind (graveyard-only / stack / permanent / player interaction, else direct gameData.stack.add, bypassing enqueueTrigger); uses source card LKI so it works after the exploiter sacrificed itself. No ability-loss check, no registry. Caller: PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService (~line 2786, exploit sacrifice completion).

event: a creature you control exploits a creature
notes: TCS#checkAllyCreatureExploitTriggers -> dispatchSlot per permanent; if the exploiter left the battlefield its LKI is dispatched via TCS#dispatch. MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleAllyCreatureExploit (CardEffect default): TriggeringCardConditionalEffect tested against the exploited card; targeted -> EntersTriggerTarget, else enqueueTrigger with eventValue = exploited power.

event: a creature you control exploits a nontoken creature
notes: Same reader and handler as ON_ALLY_CREATURE_EXPLOITS, gated on !exploitedCard.isToken().

event: creature declared as attacker
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~2340-2575). Per attacker x per permanent of the attacking player: printed effects via LayerSystemService.currentCard (gated by face-down/hasLostPrintedAbilities) + temporary/persistent + granted. Filters: TriggeringCard/TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect on the attacker, AttacksAlone, AttacksPlayerAlone, SourceAttackedThisCombat, intervening-if. Grouping: single ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect / ChooseModeNotYetChosenThisTurnEffect -> TriggeredModalTrigger; each MayEffect separate (declared target -> AttackTriggerTarget, else queueMayAbility); mandatory: INDEPENDENT registrations and each granted effect separate, rest bundled; targeted bundles -> AttackTriggerTarget, else stack.add with targetId = attacker. Extra granted Exalted instances are synthesized right after. Planar: TriggerCollectionService#checkPlanarAllyCreatureAttackTriggers bundles plane's ON_ALLY_CREATURE_ATTACKS with ON_ANY_CREATURE_ATTACKS.

event: attacking creature isn't blocked (declare blockers)
notes: CombatBlockService#checkUnblockedAttackerTriggers (no-blocks path ~279 and declareBlockers ~948). Skips hasLostAllAbilities; printed effects only (no granted/temporary); TriggeringCard/TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect unwrapped; all matching effects of a card in one stack.add, nonTargeting, targetId and sourcePermanentId = the unblocked attacker. No target support.

event: one or more creatures attacking you directly end up unblocked
notes: CombatBlockService#checkOpponentCreaturesAttackYouUnblockedTriggers (plural; called at ~277 and ~946). Printed + granted effects bundled into one stack.add, targetId = attacking player; no lost-abilities check, no target support. defenderId comes from getOpponentId, so only one opponent's battlefield is checked (2-player assumption). The singular twin #checkOpponentCreatureAttacksYouUnblockedTriggers (adds an isCreature check) has no callers (dead code). The slot is in TriggerCollectionService#isDirectAttackTriggerSlot, but no reader goes through dispatch, so that entry has no effect.

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability
relation: you control; source is an opponent's spell or ability
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyCreatureBecomesTargetOfOpponentTriggers from TriggerCollectionService#checkBecomesTargetOfSpellTriggers and #checkBecomesTargetOfAbilityTriggers (activated and triggered abilities), wrapped in collectWithAllyCreatureBecomesTargetCopies; includes granted triggered abilities; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filtered; each CounterSpellingEffect gets its own stack object targeting the triggering entry; other non-targeting effects share one stack.add; targeting effects share one SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget (hard-coded 'another creature you control' filter if the card declares no target group); skips hasLostPrintedAbilities sources

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability
relation: another you control; any spell/ability controller
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAnotherAllyCreatureBecomesTargetOfSpellOrAbilityTriggers (spell and ability paths); skips the targeted creature itself, cloaked sources and isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn; includes granted; one stack.add with targetId=targeted creature (non-targeting); MayEffect resolved from the entry, not queueMayAbility

event: one or more become the target of an activated ability
multiplicity: per event (once per ability per watcher, however many creatures it targets)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyCreatureBecomesTargetOfActivatedAbilityTriggers, ability path only, ACTIVATED_ABILITY entries that are not copies; one enqueueTrigger per registration; OncePerTurnTriggerSupport unwrap/mark; skips cloaked and isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn sources; not wrapped in collectWithAllyCreatureBecomesTargetCopies

event: becomes the target of a spell
relation: you control; source is an opponent's spell
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyCreatureBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpellTriggers, spell path only; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filtered; includes granted; one stack.add; no ability-loss check. SURPRISE: creature check is the printed getCard().hasType(CREATURE), not the effective type (animated noncreatures don't trigger it, type-stripped creatures do)

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability
relation: you control; source is an opponent's spell or ability
multiplicity: per object (per targeted creature or creature spell)
notes: Two overloads of TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyCreatureOrCreatureSpellBecomesTargetOfOpponentTriggers: permanent target (spell and ability paths) and stack target (targetZone STACK, targeted entry is CREATURE_SPELL); one stack.add each with all effects; includes granted; no TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect handling, no ability-loss check

event: you or a permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability
relation: you / you control; source is an opponent's spell or ability
multiplicity: per event (once per spell/ability per watcher and effect); per target for draw and CounterUnlessEffect effects
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyPermanentOrPlayerBecomesTargetOfOpponentTriggers (spell and ability paths; repeated targets deduped); each CounterUnlessEffect gets its own stack object per target, targeting the triggering entry; remaining effects share one stack.add, deduped per (source, effect) across the spell's targets except DrawCardEffect (also under Conditional/May) via isPerTargetDrawTrigger; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect never matches player targets; skips hasLostPrintedAbilities; includes granted. Dedup is effect-class heuristic, not a registration flag

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability
relation: you control; source is an opponent's spell or ability
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyPermanentBecomesTargetOfOpponentTriggers (spell and ability paths); one stack.add with all effects incl. granted and a source snapshot; no triggeringPermanentId, no conditional filtering, no ability-loss check; MayEffect resolved from the entry

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability
relation: another you control; source is an opponent's spell or ability
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAnotherAllyPermanentBecomesTargetOfOpponentTriggers (spell and ability paths); each CounterUnlessEffect gets its own stack object targeting the triggering entry; the rest share one stack.add with triggeringPermanentId/controller (non-targeting); includes granted; no ability-loss check

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAnyCreatureBecomesTargetTriggers (spell and ability paths), watchers on every battlefield; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filtered; each effect passed through CardEffect#resolveForBecomesTargetOfSpellOrAbility (can drop it, e.g. the named-land condition); one stack.add with targetId=creature (non-targeting); trigger-copy multiplier only when the watcher's controller controls the creature; skips hasLostPrintedAbilities; no granted triggers

event: becomes the target of a spell or ability
relation: opponent controls; source is your spell or ability
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectOpponentCreatureBecomesTargetOfYourSpellTriggers (spell and ability paths), watchers on the triggering entry controller's battlefield, creature controlled by any other player; one stack.add with targetId=creature (non-targeting) and the watcher as source; skips hasLostPrintedAbilities; no granted triggers; not wrapped in the copies helper

event: becomes the target of a spell
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyCreatureBecomesTargetOfSpellTriggers, spell path only; skips sources that lost abilities; includes granted. SURPRISE: always queues a target-choice interaction (ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger if several target groups, else ETBTokenTargetTrigger with the card's target filter) with all effects, even non-targeting ones, and the targeted creature is not recorded on the trigger

event: becomes the target of a backup triggered ability (ability path only)
multiplicity: per targeted creature, capped once per turn per source
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyCreatureBecomesTargetOfBackupAbilityTriggers, called only from collectBecomesTargetOfAbilityTriggers (checkBecomesTargetOfAbilityTriggers). Printed + granted effects bundled into one non-targeting entry (targetId = triggering entry), direct gameData.stack.add. 'Backup ability' = any TRIGGERED_ABILITY whose source card has printed Keyword.BACKUP, not specifically the backup trigger. Once-per-turn via Permanent.backupAbilityCopyUsedThisTurn set when queued. No ability-loss check on printed effects.

event: becomes the target of an instant or sorcery spell (any spell controller; spell path only)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#collectAllyCreatureBecomesTargetOfInstantOrSorceryTriggers from collectBecomesTargetOfSpellTriggers (checkBecomesTargetOfSpellTriggers). All registrations (TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filtered against the target) bundled into one non-targeting entry with targetId = targeted creature, direct stack.add via enqueueTargetTriggeredAbility. Skips hasLostPrintedAbilities sources; granted abilities not read; instant/sorcery test uses the spell card's printed types.

event: this permanent transforms front to back (incl. day/night)
notes: mixed: ApplyLudevicCopyEffect and CreateEmblemEffect ('as it transforms', Super Nova/Sephiroth) resolve immediately without the stack. AnimationSupport#fireTransformTriggers (from transformToBackFace and toggleLudevicCopy) reads the back face's slot: each non-targeting MayEffect -> its own queueMayAbility; the first other effect puts the WHOLE slot list into one stack entry, or one target interaction (DealDamageToTargetAndUpTo split-damage, graveyard-target ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect, other targeted effects via TriggerTargetCollector), then returns. SURPRISE (latent): a card mixing a MayEffect or emblem/Ludevic effect with another effect would get it twice (queued, and again inside the combined entry); no current card does. No ability-loss check, direct stack.add, no copies. Casal, Pathbreaker Owlbear's two registrations correctly share one entry.

event: this permanent transforms back to front (incl. day/night)
notes: AnimationSupport#fireTransformTriggers (from transformToFrontFace and toggleLudevicCopy) reads the front (original) face's slot. Same split as ON_TRANSFORM_TO_BACK_FACE: non-targeting MayEffects queued separately, then the whole list goes into one stack entry or target interaction. The immediate CreateEmblemEffect special case applies only to the BACK slot, so a front-face emblem would go on the stack. No ability-loss check, direct stack.add, no copies.

event: turned face up
notes: mixed: replacement = PutCountersOnTurnFaceUpEffect (TurnFaceUpReplacementEffect; megamorph/'as turned face up' counters, applied in place before triggers, honours appliesWithoutPayingCost), TurnFaceUpCopyEffect (Vesuvan Shapeshifter copy choice), TurnFaceUpAttachAuraEffect (Gift of Doom), ChoosePowerToughnessFormEffect (Aquamorph Entity, PowerToughnessFormChoiceEffect); all implement ReplacementEffect, read by TurnFaceUpCopyService#prepareChoice/findCopyEffect/preparePowerToughnessChoice/applyTurnFaceUpReplacements and filtered out of the trigger; every other class is the 'when turned face up' trigger. Non-replacement effects (intervening-if ConditionalEffect pre-checked) go into ONE stack object or one targeting interaction (graveyard / spell / player-or-permanent / multi-target); a lone ChooseOneEffect becomes a TriggeredModalTrigger. SURPRISE: two divergent readers: GameService#finishTurningFaceUp adds temporary+persistent granted effects (GrantTurnFaceUpAbilityToOwnFaceDownCreaturesEffect, each granted one as its own stack object in the untargeted branch), checks hasLostAllAbilities and multiplies by countAdditionalTriggeredAbilityTriggers; TurnFaceUpCopyService#finishTurnFaceUp does none of that, and the GameService path hands off to it whenever prepareChoice opens a choice. Other readers: PermanentRemovalService#handleExileReturnOnLeave (looks for exile-until-leaves effects), GrantTurnFaceUpAbilityToOwnFaceDownCreaturesEffectHandler (grants). choke points: GameService#finishTurningFaceUp (morph/megamorph/disguise/manifest/cloak special action, turnPermanentFaceUpWithoutPayingManaCost*) and TurnFaceUpCopyService#finishTurnFaceUp (turnFaceUpWithoutCost from StateBasedActionService#performStateBasedActions masked auto-turn, TurnTargetCreatureFaceUp(IfFaceDown)EffectHandler; completeChoice after copy/aura/PT choice); MutationSupport turns a host face up without triggers

event: turned face up
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSelfOrAllyCreatureTurnsFaceUpTriggers: turned permanent must be a creature after turning; watchers = turned permanent's controller's battlefield; skips face-down watchers and isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn only (no layer ability-loss check). Dispatch per registration to FaceUpTriggerCollectorService: DealDamageToPlayersEffect(EACH_OPPONENT, SourcePower) uses the turned creature as damage source; default handler unwraps TriggeringCard/TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect (CardPredicate checked on effective subtypes), OncePerTurn/OnceOnly; declared-target effects -> EntersTriggerTarget interaction, else stack.add with turned permanent as non-targeting targetId. MayEffect not unwrapped (resolves as may). choke points: GameService#finishTurningFaceUp (morph/megamorph/disguise/manifest/cloak special action, turnPermanentFaceUpWithoutPayingManaCost*) and TurnFaceUpCopyService#finishTurnFaceUp (turnFaceUpWithoutCost from StateBasedActionService#performStateBasedActions masked auto-turn, TurnTargetCreatureFaceUp(IfFaceDown)EffectHandler; completeChoice after copy/aura/PT choice)

event: turned face up
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSelfOrAnyPermanentTurnsFaceUpTriggers: scans every battlefield, no type check on the turned permanent; skips face-down watchers and isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn only. Same FaceUpTriggerCollectorService#handleCreatureTurnsFaceUp default handler (targeted -> EntersTriggerTarget interaction, else non-targeting stack entry). choke points: GameService#finishTurningFaceUp (morph/megamorph/disguise/manifest/cloak special action, turnPermanentFaceUpWithoutPayingManaCost*) and TurnFaceUpCopyService#finishTurnFaceUp (turnFaceUpWithoutCost from StateBasedActionService#performStateBasedActions masked auto-turn, TurnTargetCreatureFaceUp(IfFaceDown)EffectHandler; completeChoice after copy/aura/PT choice)

event: turned face up
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSelfOrAllyPermanentTurnsFaceUpTriggers: watchers = turned permanent's controller's battlefield, no type check; skips face-down watchers and isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn only. Default handler FaceUpTriggerCollectorService#handleCreatureTurnsFaceUp (OncePerTurn/OnceOnly unwrapped and marked; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect gate). choke points: GameService#finishTurningFaceUp (morph/megamorph/disguise/manifest/cloak special action, turnPermanentFaceUpWithoutPayingManaCost*) and TurnFaceUpCopyService#finishTurnFaceUp (turnFaceUpWithoutCost from StateBasedActionService#performStateBasedActions masked auto-turn, TurnTargetCreatureFaceUp(IfFaceDown)EffectHandler; completeChoice after copy/aura/PT choice)

event: creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control (not battles)
relation: opponent's attacker; you or your planeswalker attacked
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~2752-2855). Defender's permanents, gated by face-down/lost abilities; printed only. DealDamageToTriggeringAttackerEffect.attackerCondition and any ConditionalEffect checked at trigger time. SURPRISE: non-INDEPENDENT effects from ON_CREATURE_ATTACKS_YOU, ON_CREATURE_ATTACKS_YOU_DIRECTLY and ON_CREATURE_ATTACKS_DEFENDING_PLAYER on the same card are bundled into one stack object; INDEPENDENT ones are separate. Always stack.add nonTargeting with targetId = attacker (no target support). Temporary watchers: TriggerCollectionService#checkTemporaryGlobalCreatureAttacksYouTriggers, registered by RegisterGlobalTriggeredAbilityUntilNextTurnEffectHandler.

event: creature attacks you (player only)
notes: Same loop as ON_CREATURE_ATTACKS_YOU in CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration; added only when the attack target is a player. Bundled with the card's ON_CREATURE_ATTACKS_YOU / _DEFENDING_PLAYER effects (cross-slot); INDEPENDENT separate (Barbed Foliage).

event: creature attacks while you are the defending player (you, your planeswalker, or a battle you protect)
notes: Same loop as ON_CREATURE_ATTACKS_YOU in CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration; the only one of the three that also fires for battle attacks (protector). Bundled cross-slot with the card's ON_CREATURE_ATTACKS_YOU(_DIRECTLY) effects. Not in isDirectAttackTriggerSlot, but the loop uses beginAttackTriggerCopies, so attack-trigger doublers still count. Kazuul's MayPayManaEffect goes straight on the stack.

event: one or more creatures attack you directly
multiplicity: per player attacked (once per directly attacked player)
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~2857-2925). Intervening-if ConditionalEffect checked; all printed effects of a card in one object: targeted -> AttackTriggerTarget (target chooser = active player if a MayEffect has ACTIVE_PLAYER choice), else stack.add nonTargeting with attacker snapshots. No lost-abilities/face-down gate, no granted effects.

event: opponent attacks a planeswalker you control with one or more creatures
relation: you control; attacking player is an opponent
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~2927-2975). Javadoc says 'once per combat' but code fires once per attacked planeswalker; that matches the Oath of Kaya ruling (2019-05-03), so the doc is wrong, not the code. All printed effects in one stack.add, targetId = attacking player, no target support, no lost-abilities gate. Copy scope via countAdditionalTriggeredAbilityTriggers(..., true).

event: creature declared as attacker
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~3017-3105): per attacker x every permanent on every battlefield; printed effects only (no lost-abilities/face-down gate, no granted). Nested TriggeringPermanentControllerConditionalEffect / TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect / PutCounterOnAttackingCreatureOnAttacksYouEffect (attached-player check) / AttackedTargetIsMonarch filters; all matching effects in one stack.add nonTargeting with targetId = attacker (targeted effects such as DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect get the attacker as an implicit non-chosen target). Also TriggerCollectionService#checkTemporaryGlobalCreatureAttackTriggers (temporary watchers, can queue AttackTriggerTarget) and #checkPlanarAllyCreatureAttackTriggers.

event: a player attacks with one or more creatures
relation: any player (incl. you); some conditions narrow to opponents
multiplicity: per event (once per declaration); PlayerAttacksOneOfYourOpponents / OpponentAttacksAnotherOpponent / AttackedOpponentHasMoreLife... / ...PowerOrToughnessEqualToSourceChosenNumber: per attacked opponent
notes: CombatAttackService#finishAttackerDeclaration (~3134-3315) + #addPlayerAttackTrigger. Every permanent on every battlefield, printed only, no lost-abilities gate. A long condition switch: some unwrapped at trigger time, AllOf and AttackedOpponentHasMoreLife kept for resolution recheck. Per-opponent conditioned effects grouped per attacked opponent into separate objects; the rest: INDEPENDENT separate, others bundled; targeted -> AttackTriggerTarget, else stack.add with targetId = attacking player.

event: this spell is cast
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers: special classes each get their own stack object (CopyThisSpellIfCondition/IfCasualtyPaid/ForXValue, ReplicateEffect, SpellCastCopyTriggerEffect incl. Gravestorm/Coststorm, StormEffect, CascadeEffect, Demonstrate); intervening-if gated against the spell entry; ALL other registrations share ONE stack object or one targeting interaction (SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget / ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger / SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger), except a lone untargeted non-Ripple MayEffect goes to pendingMayAbilities. TriggerMode.INDEPENDENT ignored (only used on CascadeEffect, which is separate anyway). Granted replicate/demonstrate and perpetual grants are folded in (untargeted perpetual grants each separate). Doc says instant/sorcery but permanent spells use it too (cascade/emerge creatures). Other readers only inspect/add (PredicateEvaluationService, EffectResolution#hasManaSpentToCastAmount, perpetual grant handlers).

event: instant or sorcery spell cast
notes: Static ability granting storm. TriggerCollectionService#checkSpellCastTriggers puts the granted storm trigger straight on the stack (stack.add) once per granting permanent.

event: first spell cast each turn
notes: Static ability granting cascade (Maelstrom Nexus). checkSpellCastTriggers puts one cascade trigger per granting permanent straight on the stack, sourced from the spell; all registrations are one stack object.

event: first spell cast each turn with Treasure mana
notes: As GRANT_CASCADE_TO_FIRST_SPELL (Rain of Riches).

event: instant or sorcery spell cast from hand
notes: As GRANT_CASCADE_TO_FIRST_SPELL (Quandrix, the Proof).

event: enchantment spell cast from hand
notes: As GRANT_CASCADE_TO_FIRST_SPELL (Wildsear, Scouring Maw).

event: Sliver spell cast
notes: As GRANT_CASCADE_TO_FIRST_SPELL (The First Sliver).

event: first spell cast from outside hand each turn
notes: Static ability granting demonstrate (The Twelfth Doctor). Holds a MayEffect; the trigger is sourced from the permanent, not the spell.

event: spell cast from hand during your turn, mana value at most life lost by opponents this turn
notes: As GRANT_CASCADE_TO_FIRST_SPELL (Abaddon the Despoiler).

event: you clash (after the clash ends, whether you initiated it or were the opponent)
notes: TCS#fireClashTriggers (called for both clashing players): won/lost ClashOutcomeConditionalEffect (IfWonClashEffect/IfLostClashEffect) resolved at trigger time; all remaining registrations in ONE stack object; any targeting -> ClashTriggerTarget for the group, else direct gameData.stack.add (bypasses enqueueTrigger). Only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn checked; no registry.

event: a player loses the game
notes: GameOutcomeService#firePlayerLosesGameTriggers: all registrations of a permanent in ONE stack entry (targetId = loser, non-targeting), direct gameData.stack.add; skipped in simulations; no ability-loss check. Only intervening-if: WinGameIfPlayerAttackedByControlledSubtypeThisTurnEffect. SURPRISE: Curse of Vengeance ('enchanted player loses') and Shinryu ('chosen player loses') are not restricted to that player; moot since the 2-player game ends first.

event: this creature blocks two or more creatures
notes: CombatBlockService#processBlockerDeclaration (~832-857: blockers with 2+ assignments in the declaration) and #applyBlockFromEffect (~1033: whenever blockingTargetIds.size() >= 2 after an effect-created block, so it can fire again when a third attacker is added). All printed effects in one stack.add, nonTargeting, targetId/sourcePermanentId = blocker. No lost-abilities gate, no granted effects.

event: creature blocks
multiplicity: per blocker (once per blocking creature even if it blocks several)
notes: CombatBlockService#checkAnyCreatureBlocksTriggers, from #processBlockerDeclaration (~862) and #applyBlockFromEffect (~1052, so effect-created blocks also count). Every battlefield; skips hasLostPrintedAbilities; TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect filtered against the blocker; all matching effects in one stack.add nonTargeting, targetId = blocker. Also TriggerCollectionService#collectTemporaryGlobalTriggers(ON_ANY_CREATURE_BLOCKS) for temporary watchers.

event: a creature is championed (exiled) with this
notes: SURPRISE: PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService#handleChampionCreature -> beginChampionedTrigger always treats the group as player-targeting (ChampionedTriggerTarget via setPermanentChoiceContext, not the queued-interaction system), runs SBAs inline, and silently drops the trigger when no valid targets; no non-targeting path, no ability-loss check. One interaction for all registrations.

event: ability of a permanent activated (incl. mana abilities)
object: permanent whose ability was activated (TriggeringPermanent/Triggering*AbilityConditionalEffect filters)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerActivatesAbilityTriggers (ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, battlefield-permanent abilities only - never for hand/graveyard abilities): one entry per registration; permanent-target -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, any-target -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, else enqueueTrigger; mana-ability triggers deferred. mixed readers: CopyControllerActivatedAbilityTriggerEffect regs are skipped there and collected after the ability is on the stack by checkControllerActivatesAbilityCopyTriggers (also from hand paths; no lost-ability check); TriggeringNinjutsuAbilityConditionalEffect regs by checkControllerActivatesNinjutsuAbilityTriggers.

event: an opponent activates an ability (incl. mana abilities)
relation: opponent (player); watchers on non-activating players' battlefields
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentActivatesAbilityTriggers: one entry per registration, activating player baked as non-targeting targetId; targeted effects -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget / SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget. Called from ActivatedAbilityExecutionService and from only ONE of the two hand-ability completion paths in AbilityActivationService (~2862, non-mana only); the other hand path (~2743) and graveyard abilities never call it - inconsistent.

event: exhaust ability activated (after costs)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerActivatesExhaustAbilityTriggers (ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, battlefield-permanent exhaust activations only): one enqueueTrigger entry per registration; no lost-ability/face-down check, no target/may/intervening-if handling.

event: this is tapped to pay a saddle or crew cost during your main phase
notes: TCS#checkSelfSaddlesOrCrewsDuringMainPhaseTriggers from CrewCostHandler (per tapped creature): printed + granted, only isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn checked; entries go to pendingActivatedAbilityCostTriggers (stacked after the activated ability), additional-trigger copies added manually, non-targeting with triggeringPermanentId = Mount/Vehicle.

event: a creature stations this Spacecraft (tapped to pay its station cost)
notes: TCS#checkStationedTriggers from TapCreatureCostHandler (station cost): registry.dispatch directly (no ability-loss check, no copies, no granted) -> MiscTriggerCollectorService#handleBecomesStationed: non-targeting, targetId = stationing creature card, added to pendingActivatedAbilityCostTriggers.

event: non-mana ability activated (copy triggers fire after it is on the stack)
object: activated ability / its source (sourceFilter, targetPredicate, sourcePermanentFilter, loyalty/exhaust/X flags)
relation: you; equippedCreatureOnly copy triggers: ability of the equipped creature, any activator
notes: mixed readers: TriggeringNonTapAbilityConditionalEffect regs are captured BEFORE costs by TriggerCollectionService#collectNonTapActivationTriggersBeforeCosts (battlefield activations only; no lost-ability check; entries added after the ability); the rest by checkControllerActivatesNonManaAbilityTriggers after the push (battlefield, hand and graveyard activation paths): CopyControllerActivatedAbilityTriggerEffect -> copy trigger wrapped in MayPayMana/MayPayLife/May; other effects -> any-target interaction or plain entry (permanent-only targets are not routed to target selection). One entry per registration.

event: embalm or eternalize ability activated
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerActivatesEternalizeOrEmbalmTriggers from AbilityActivationService's graveyard-ability path after the ability is on the stack: one enqueueTrigger per registration; no lost-ability/target/may handling.

event: an opponent activates a non-mana ability
notes: Pre-cost capture of TriggeringNonTapAbilityConditionalEffect regs in collectNonTapActivationTriggersBeforeCosts + TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentActivatesNonManaAbilityTriggers (battlefield, hand, graveyard activation paths): one non-targeting entry per registration with the activating player (or triggering-permanent controller) as targetId; no target selection support.

event: creature becomes blocked
notes: CombatBlockService#checkAllyBecomesBlockedTriggers(mode), called per blocked attacker (band-mates included) from #processBlockerDeclaration (NORMAL once, PER_BLOCKER once per blocker, but the blocker itself is not passed in), effect-created blocks (~1251), token entering blocking (~2065) and #fireBecomesBlockedTriggersWithoutBlockers (NORMAL only). Registrations are split by TriggerMode, and all of one mode on a card share one object. Skips hasLostPrintedAbilities (PER_BLOCKER also when the blocked attacker lost abilities). TriggeringCard/TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect unwrapped; targeted -> AttackTriggerTarget, else stack.add with sourcePermanentId = blocked attacker (watcher if BoostReferencedPermanentEffect).

event: one or more creatures you control become blocked in a blocker declaration
notes: CombatBlockService#checkAllyCreaturesBecomeBlockedTriggers from #processBlockerDeclaration only (effect-created blocks, blocking tokens and blocked-without-blockers never fire it). Only NORMAL registrations; all in one stack.add nonTargeting; no lost-abilities gate, no target support.

event: creature becomes blocked / attacker-blocker pair formed
multiplicity: varies: per attacker/blocker pair (BlockPairConditionalEffect); per blocked attacker (BlockedCreatureTriggerEffect)
notes: Two readers in CombatBlockService. #checkAnyCreatureBecomesBlockedTriggers keeps only BlockPairConditionalEffect (DestroyWeakerBlockParticipantEffect, BoostBlockerWhenAttackerMatchesEffect): one stack.add per registration per pair, targetId = named participant. #checkBlockedCreatureTriggers keeps only BlockedCreatureTriggerEffect (implemented by TriggeringCardConditionalEffect): all matching on a card bundled per blocked attacker. SURPRISE: any other effect class in this slot is silently ignored. No lost-abilities gate. Called from #processBlockerDeclaration, #applyBlockFromEffect (attacker not previously blocked), and #fireBecomesBlockedTriggersWithoutBlockers (BlockedCreatureTriggerEffect reader only).

event: one or more creatures block
multiplicity: per event (once per blocker declaration; again per effect-created block)
notes: CombatBlockService#checkAnyCreaturesBlockTriggers from #processBlockerDeclaration (~902) and #applyBlockFromEffect (~1074, so it re-fires for each effect-created block in the same combat). Skips hasLostAllAbilities; all printed effects in one stack.add, no targetId.

event: returned to hand (battlefield -> hand)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkPermanentReturnedToHandTriggers: watchers = all battlefields plus permanentLeaveBatchWatchers (simultaneous-leave look-back); hasLostAllAbilities only, no face-down check. All registrations of a watcher (TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect resolved against the returned permanent, OncePerTurn unwrapped) go into ONE stack.add entry with the owner as non-targeting targetId. choke point PermanentRemovalService#returnPermanentToHand (removePermanentToHand), checked BEFORE removeFromBattlefield; commanders deferred to CommanderReplacementChoiceInteractionHandler. SURPRISE: ExileTargetPermanentThenDiscardAndReturnToBattlefieldEffectHandler (The Grand Tour) also fires it for a card moving exile -> hand (overload without the returned permanent)

event: returned to hand (battlefield -> hand)
relation: you (owner's hand); watcher on owner's battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerCreatureReturnedToHandTriggers: wasCreature computed before removal; watchers = battlefield of the returned card's OWNER ("your hand") plus simultaneousDyingPermanents and leave-batch look-back watchers of that player; isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn only (no layer ability-loss, no face-down check). One enqueueTrigger per registration, controller = owner. choke point PermanentRemovalService#returnPermanentToHand (removePermanentToHand), checked BEFORE removeFromBattlefield; commanders deferred to CommanderReplacementChoiceInteractionHandler

event: returned to hand (battlefield -> hand)
relation: you (owner's hand); watcher on owner's battlefield
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerPermanentReturnedToHandTriggers(gameData, ownerId): receives no permanent at all, so no type filter is possible; watchers = owner's battlefield only (SURPRISE: unlike the creature/another-nonland/any variants it has no simultaneous-leave look-back); checks isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn and hasLostPrintedAbilities. One enqueueTrigger per registration (MayPayManaEffect resolves on the stack). choke point PermanentRemovalService#returnPermanentToHand (removePermanentToHand), checked BEFORE removeFromBattlefield; commanders deferred to CommanderReplacementChoiceInteractionHandler

event: returned to hand (battlefield -> hand)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerAnotherNonlandPermanentReturnedToHandTriggers: land check via gameQueryService.isLand before removal; watchers = returned permanent's CONTROLLER's battlefield (not owner) plus leave-batch look-back; source excluded by id; isLosesAllAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurn only. One enqueueTrigger per registration. choke point PermanentRemovalService#returnPermanentToHand (removePermanentToHand), checked BEFORE removeFromBattlefield; commanders deferred to CommanderReplacementChoiceInteractionHandler

event: source deals damage (all simultaneous damage summed per source)
object: source (creature or spell; handler filters color/type)
relation: any; several handlers require the source to be one you control
multiplicity: per damage source per event; OtherChosenPlayerLosesLife: per damaged remembered player; Ghyrson: per recipient dealt exactly 1
notes: TriggerCollectionService#queueSourceDealsDamageReflections (watcher scan over all battlefields, skipping hasLostPrintedAbilities) -> dispatch per registration. Choke points: CombatDamageService#processSourceDealsDamageReflectionTriggers (per source per step, before SBA, entries held and re-added after SBA) and DamageSupport#flushSourceDamageReflections (end of resolution: EffectResolutionService ~609, DamageSupport ~1755/1915). Only effect-specific handlers (ReflectSourceDamageToItsController -> stack.add; SourceDamageGainLifeForSourceController, OtherChosenPlayerLosesLife, GainLife (noncreature source you control), PutCountersOnSourceCardForColorSourceDamage, GhyrsonStarnKelermorph (other source you control) -> enqueueTrigger; MayPayManaEffect (chosen color, damage to you) -> queueInteraction). No CardEffect default handler, so other effect classes never trigger. Relation, self and multiplicity all depend on the handler.

event: instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage (summed per spell damage event)
multiplicity: per event (per spell damage event, summed over recipients)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyInstantOrSorcerySpellDealsDamageTriggers, called from DamageSupport#flushSourceDamageReflections only for batches keyed by a spell stack entry (INSTANT_SPELL/SORCERY_SPELL, see DamageSupport#accumulateSourceDamageForReflection); noncombat only. Scans the caster's battlefield, skips hasLostPrintedAbilities, dispatch per registration to DamageTriggerCollectorService handlers (DealDamageToTargetCreatureDamagedPlayerControls, DealDamageToEachOpponentWhenSingleTargetCreatureSpellDealsDamage, ExileTopCardMayPlay..., default). Javadoc says it shares queueSourceDealsDamageReflections; it is actually a sibling call from the same flush.

event: this permanent deals damage (combat or noncombat), summed per source per event
multiplicity: per event (per damage event for this source)
notes: Self section of TriggerCollectionService#queueSourceDealsDamageReflections, using effects snapshotted at damage time by CombatDamageService#snapshotSelfDealsDamageEffects (before SBA) or DamageSupport#snapshotSelfDealsDamageEffects (first accumulation; returns empty if the source already left), so it still fires when the source died. Printed effects are gated by face-down/hasLostPrintedAbilities, plus temporary/persistent/granted. Handler DamageTriggerCollectorService#handleSelfDealsDamage: optional TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect on damaged-permanent snapshots, intervening-if with eventValue; targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger with eventValue = total. Same choke points as ON_ANY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE.

event: this permanent deals combat damage to anything (summed per step)
multiplicity: per event (per combat damage step for this source)
notes: CombatDamageService#processSelfDealsCombatDamageTriggers -> TriggerCollectionService#queueSourceDealsCombatDamageTriggers -> #dispatchSourceDealsCombatDamageTriggers: printed sourceCard.getEffects(slot) plus temporary/persistent/granted snapshotted in the combat damage step (~723) before SBA, plus temporary-global watchers bound to this permanent. Handler #handleSelfDealsCombatDamage: graveyard target -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger, permanent/player target -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, else enqueueTrigger with eventValue. SURPRISE: printed effects have no face-down/hasLostPrintedAbilities gate (ON_SELF_DEALS_DAMAGE has one), so Humility or a face-down source would still trigger.

event: this permanent deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker (summed)
multiplicity: per event (per combat damage step for this source)
notes: CombatDamageService#processSelfDealsCombatDamageToPlayerOrPlaneswalkerTriggers -> TriggerCollectionService#queueSourceDealsCombatDamageToPlayerOrPlaneswalkerTriggers -> #dispatchSourceDealsCombatDamageTriggers; totalDamage = player + planeswalker damage. Same handler and same missing lost-abilities/face-down gate on printed effects as ON_SELF_DEALS_COMBAT_DAMAGE.

event: this permanent deals combat damage to a player or battle (summed)
multiplicity: per event (per combat damage step for this source)
notes: CombatDamageService#processSelfDealsCombatDamageToPlayerOrBattleTriggers -> TriggerCollectionService#queueSourceDealsCombatDamageToPlayerOrBattleTriggers -> #dispatchSourceDealsCombatDamageTriggers (same call also fires ON_EQUIPPED_CREATURE_DEALS_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER_OR_BATTLE). Extra ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect handler -> TriggeredModalTrigger. Same missing lost-abilities/face-down gate on printed effects.

event: equipped creature deals combat damage to a player or battle (summed)
multiplicity: per event (per equipped damage source per combat damage step)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#queueEquippedCreatureDealsCombatDamageToPlayerOrBattleTriggers (from #queueSourceDealsCombatDamageToPlayerOrBattleTriggers): all permanents whose printed subtypes contain EQUIPMENT and are attached to the source (last-known attachment if the host died). Handler #queueEquippedCreatureCombatDamageTrigger: targeted -> SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget, graveyard -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger, else stack object from the equipment. Printed only, no lost-abilities gate; the Equipment check is the printed subtype, not effective.

event: creature deals combat damage to anything (summed per step)
multiplicity: per object (per dealing creature per combat damage step)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#snapshotAllyCreatureDealsCombatDamageWatchers (before SBA, so watchers killed by the same damage still trigger) + #queueSourceDealsCombatDamageTriggers -> dispatch per registration -> DamageTriggerCollectorService#handleAllyCreatureDealsCombatDamage (intervening-if, enqueueTrigger nonTargeting with the watcher as source, triggeringPermanentId = dealer, eventValue = damage). Printed only; no lost-abilities gate on watchers.

event: creature deals damage (combat or noncombat) to a planeswalker
multiplicity: per object (per source/planeswalker damage event; combat: per source per planeswalker per step)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyDealtDamageToPlaneswalkerTriggers from DamageSupport (~285, noncombat) and CombatDamageService#processAllyDealtDamageToPlaneswalkerTriggers (combat; entries deferred to state.allyCreatureDealsDamageToPlaneswalkerTriggers and added after SBA). Printed + temporary + persistent; calls registry.dispatch directly (bypassing TriggerCollectionService#dispatch, so no additional-trigger copy counting). Only handler: TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect (with combatDamageOnly flag), so bare effects never trigger. No lost-abilities gate.

event: creature deals damage to the planeswalker this permanent is attached to
relation: enchanted (watcher.getAttachedTo() == damaged planeswalker); any source controller
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCreatureDealsDamageToEnchantedPlaneswalkerTriggers, invoked at the start of #checkAllyDealtDamageToPlaneswalkerTriggers (same choke points). Printed + temporary + persistent + granted; registry.dispatch directly (no copy counting) -> default handler DamageTriggerCollectorService#handleCreatureDealsDamageToEnchantedPlaneswalker: targetId = damaging creature, nonTargeting, deferred list in combat. No lost-abilities gate.

event: you are dealt damage (combat or noncombat)
multiplicity: per event (noncombat: per damage application; combat: once per damaged player per step with the summed total)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerDealtDamageTriggers -> dispatch per registration to default/MayEffect/SacrificePermanentsOrLoseGame/RemoveCounterFromSource handlers (all enqueueTrigger with eventValue = amount). Scans the damaged player's battlefield; printed only, no lost-abilities gate. Callers: DamageSupport (~1638, noncombat) and CombatDamageService (~972, includeAllSources=true with the total across all sources; the per-controller follow-up calls pass includeAllSources=false and only feed the _BY_OPPONENT/_BY_ALLY_SOURCE slots). SURPRISE: the Javadoc says simultaneous sources trigger once each, but combat sums them into one trigger. Rulings for similar 'is dealt damage' triggers favour one trigger, so the doc looks stale; worth confirming.

event: you are dealt damage (combat or noncombat) by a source you control
relation: you (damaged player); source controlled by you
multiplicity: per damage application (noncombat); combat: once per step with all your sources summed
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerDealtDamageTriggers (fromAllySource gate: source controller == damaged player), called from DamageSupport (noncombat player damage) and CombatDamageService. SURPRISE: in combat, when the source controller is the recipient, CombatDamageService passes the summed damage of all that player's sources in one call, so it fires once per step instead of once per source (the BY_OPPONENT twin fires per source). OncePerTurnTriggerEffect unwrapped and marked in the collector. Only handler: the default DamageTriggerCollectorService#handleControllerDealtDamageByAllySource. A player-targeting effect gets queueInteraction(SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget) carrying the amount (Daredevil). Otherwise enqueueTrigger with eventValue=amount. No ability-loss check.

event: damage that would be dealt to you is prevented
multiplicity: per prevention application (one per prevented damage event/shield use)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerDamagePreventedTriggers via DamagePreventionService#notifyControllerDamagePrevented, which is called from the blanket-flag/shield paths of applyPlayerPreventionShield, applyPlayerDamagePreventionShield and PlayerDamagePreventions#playerFlag. Default handler handleControllerDamagePreventedDefault: enqueueTrigger with eventValue=amount prevented. SURPRISE: not every prevention path notifies. DamagePreventionService#applyHalfDamagePrevention (Gisela) and applyControllerAndCreaturesFixedPerSourceDamagePrevention prevent damage silently, so Selfless Squire misses them.

event: an opponent is dealt damage (combat or noncombat)
relation: opponent (any player other than the watcher's controller)
multiplicity: per damage source per damaged opponent (noncombat: per damage application)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentDealtDamageTriggers scans every other battlefield. Called from DamageSupport (noncombat) and CombatDamageService (per source in the combat-damage-to-player loop, and per redirected portion). SURPRISE: calls registry.dispatch directly, bypassing the private dispatch wrapper, so additional-trigger copy effects are never applied. No ability-loss check. Handlers: PutCountersOnSelfEffect (War Elemental, eventValue). ConditionalEffect: intervening-if evaluated with the damage amount (Pain Magnification 3+). Default: targetId=damaged player, nonTargeting, eventValue.

event: a source deals damage to a player other than its controller (combat or noncombat)
object: source (permanent or spell; some handlers require a creature)
relation: source you control; damaged player is another player
multiplicity: per damage source per damaged player (noncombat: per damage application)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllySourceDealtDamageToOpponentTriggers (skips permanents that lost printed abilities). Called from CombatDamageService (per source) and DamageSupport (noncombat). Planes go through checkPlanarAllySourceDealtDamageToOpponentTriggers: the planar controller must control the source, which must be a creature, and dispatchPlanarDamageTrigger unwraps OncePerTurnPerCreatureTriggerEffect. SURPRISE: self semantics depend on the effect class. handleSelfDealsDamageToOpponent (DealDamageToPlayersEffect, Flesh Reaver) fires only when the watcher is the source. TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect and PutCounterOnReferencedPermanentEffect need a creature source. PutCountersOnSelfEffect/MayEffect/DrawCardIfEventValueAtLeastEffect fire for any source, except that excludeDamageSource drops the watcher itself (Talon of Pain). There is no default CardEffect handler, so other effect classes silently never trigger. Everything is enqueueTrigger.

event: a source deals damage to any player, including its controller
relation: source you control; damaged player any
multiplicity: per damage source per damaged player (noncombat: per damage application)
notes: Read in the same loop as ON_ALLY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT (TriggerCollectionService#checkAllySourceDealtDamageToOpponentTriggers), but without the 'damaged player != controller' gate. No planar reader. Handlers: TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect (needs a source permanent, no creature check, sets triggeringPermanentId and eventValue; Vraska) and DrawCardIfEventValueAtLeastEffect. No default handler. SURPRISE: Dragonborn Champion's '5 or more damage' threshold is only checked when DrawCardIfEventValueAtLeastEffectHandler resolves, so the ability triggers and uses the stack for any amount.

event: a creature deals damage to its own controller
relation: any creature whose controller (the damaged player) is not the planar controller
multiplicity: per damage source per damage event
notes: Read only by TriggerCollectionService#checkPlanarSourceDealtDamageToItsControllerTriggers, called from checkAllySourceDealtDamageToOpponentTriggers when source controller == damaged player. Dispatched under the planar controller. dispatchPlanarDamageTrigger unwraps OncePerTurnPerCreatureTriggerEffect per creature (registry.dispatch, no copy wrapper). Only handler: PutCounterOnReferencedPermanentEffect (TRIGGERING), shared with the planar ON_ALLY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT path. SURPRISE: Stensia is split across three slots, and in multiplayer none of them covers a non-planar-controller's creature damaging a third player.

event: one or more creatures deal damage to a player (combat or noncombat)
relation: dealers you control; damaged player any
multiplicity: per event: combat once per attacking controller per damaged player per damage step; noncombat once per damage application
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreaturesDealDamageToPlayerTriggers, called from CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers (batch of dealers) and from DamageSupport (noncombat, only when the source is a creature). Reads printed + temporary + persistent + granted effects with no ability-loss check. Only handler: TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect; dealers must be creatures even when a predicate is given (unlike the OPPONENT twin), and bare effects never trigger. targetId=damaged player, nonTargeting. SURPRISE: watchers are read live after combat state-based actions, with no look-back snapshot (unlike ON_ALLY_CREATURES_DEAL_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT), so a watcher killed by the same combat damage misses its trigger.

event: one or more creatures (or predicate-matching objects) deal damage to an opponent (combat or noncombat)
object: creature; with a predicate, any matching object including spells (Kindred Pirates)
relation: dealers you control; damaged player is an opponent
multiplicity: per event: combat once per attacking controller per defender per damage step; noncombat once per damage application
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyCreaturesDealDamageToOpponentTriggers runs over watchers from snapshotAllyCreaturesDealDamageToOpponentTriggers, which CombatDamageService takes before state-based actions (look-back). Watchers include printed (skipped if printed abilities lost) + temporary + persistent + granted effects. Called from CombatDamageService#processCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers and DamageSupport, where the dealer is the source permanent or a spell snapshot. Only handler: handleAllyCreaturesDealDamageToOpponent (TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect); an unfiltered trigger requires creature dealers. targetId=damaged player, nonTargeting.

event: a source deals noncombat damage to an opponent
relation: source you control; damaged player is another player
multiplicity: per damage application (per source per damaged player)
notes: The draft's 13.3 is wrong: the slot is noncombat only. TriggerCollectionService#checkAllySourceDealtNoncombatDamageToOpponentTriggers, called only from DamageSupport (noncombat player damage). The path depends on the effect class. MayEffect: queueMayAbility immediately with the amount (Virtue of Courage, Thor). OncePerTurnTriggerEffect (inner ConditionalEffect checked at trigger time; Molten Lavamancer), CreateTokenEffect and SequenceEffect: enqueueNoncombatDamageTrigger (MiscTriggerCollectorService). DealDamageToTargetCreatureDamagedPlayerControlsEffect, alone or wrapped in a ConditionalEffect (DamageTriggerCollectorService): intervening-if checked with the amount, target limited to the damaged player's creatures. A ConditionalEffect wrapping any other class returns false. No default handler and no ability-loss check.

event: you are dealt damage (combat or noncombat) by a source an opponent controls
relation: you (damaged player); source controlled by an opponent
multiplicity: per damage source (combat: per opposing source; noncombat: per damage application)
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkControllerDealtDamageTriggers (fromOpponent gate). The first combat call passes a null source controller and skips this slot; the per-controller calls then fire it once per source amount. Handlers: SacrificePermanentsEffect works only with a TARGET_PLAYER recipient (bound to the source's controller, Michiko); any other recipient returns false with no fallback. ConditionalEffect (intervening-if), MayEffect and default: enqueueTrigger with eventValue=amount. No ability-loss check.

event: a source an opponent controls deals damage to you or a permanent you control (combat or noncombat)
object: source controlled by an opponent; recipient is you or a permanent you control
relation: source controlled by an opponent; recipient you / you control
multiplicity: per damage source per recipient (player or each damaged permanent) per damage event
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkOpponentSourceDamageToYouOrYourPermanentTriggers, called from DamageSupport (noncombat batch recipients) and CombatDamageService#processOpponentSourceDamageToYouOrYourPermanentTriggers. The opponent gate lives in the handlers. LoseLifeUnlessPaysEffect: enqueue with targetId=source controller (Elesh Norn). SURPRISE: the MayEffect handler (handleOpponentSourceDamageToYouOrYourPermanent) ignores the wrapped effect and always queueMayAbility's a hard-coded DealDamageToDamageSourceControllerEffect(1,...) (Flameblade Angel). No default handler.

event: a creature deals damage (combat or noncombat) to you or a permanent you control
object: creature of the watcher's chosen color; damaged permanent filtered by the effect
relation: recipient is you or a permanent you control; creature of any controller
multiplicity: per damaging creature per recipient per damage event
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkCreatureDamageToYouOrYourPermanentTriggers, called from the four damage choke points: DamageSupport player and creature paths, CombatDamageService player and creature paths. Only handler: ReflectDamageToChosenColorCreatureEffect (handleChosenColorCreatureDamageReflection). It gates on the watcher's chosenColor and the damagedPermanentFilter, then rewrites the effect into DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(damage) with targetId=damaging creature, nonTargeting, via direct stack.add (not enqueueTrigger). No ability-loss check.

event: a creature deals combat damage to you
relation: you (damaged player); creature of any controller
zone: battlefield (+ face-up schemes; + command zone for planes)
multiplicity: per damaging creature; BatchedCombatDamageToYouTriggerEffect once per watcher registration per recipient per damage step
notes: TriggerCollectionService#checkDamageDealtToControllerTriggers (combat branch), called per source per recipient from CombatDamageService after state-based actions. queueCreatureCombatDamageToYouTriggers resolves TriggeringPermanentConditionalEffect and intervening-if ConditionalEffect, unwraps Batched* (deduped by perm:index key) and rewrites DamageSourceControllerGainsControlOfThisPermanentEffect. It then puts ONE stack entry per watcher holding all surviving effects (grouping all): targetId=damaging creature, nonTargeting, direct stack.add. queuePlanarCreatureCombatDamageToYouTriggers instead makes one entry per registration (grouping each); hasPlanarCreatureCombatDamageToYouTrigger is a presence check. Cabal Slaver and Brood Sliver use this slot as the 'to you' half of 'to a player', paired with ON_ANY_CREATURE_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT. SURPRISE: watchers are read after combat state-based actions, so a watcher killed by the same damage misses its trigger, and two independent abilities on one card would be merged into one stack object.

event: an opponent gains life
notes: TCS#collectGraveyardOpponentLifeGainTriggers (from checkLifeGainTriggers): getEffectiveGraveyardEffects in every non-gaining player's graveyard; plain enqueueTrigger, no entry version; MayPayManaEffect stays wrapped.

event: you gain life
notes: TCS#collectGraveyardControllerLifeGainTriggers: getEffectiveGraveyardEffects; unwraps OncePerTurnTriggerEffect (firstLifeGain, once flag keyed by card id); plain enqueueTrigger.

event: one or more tokens enter the battlefield (token-creation batch)
multiplicity: per event (NORMAL); per token for PER_TOKEN registrations or effects with an ability-resolution condition
notes: Opponent loop at the end of TriggerCollectionService#checkAllyTokenEntersTriggers (called from token-creation paths: EtbTriggerService, BattlefieldEntryService, BattlefieldEntryBatchSupport, TokenCopySupport, PermanentControlSupport, AsEntersInteractionService). OncePerTurnTriggerEffect unwrapped in the check; handlers in EnterTriggerCollectorService: default (targeted -> queueInteraction EntersTriggerTarget, else enqueueTrigger with eventValue=count, both x perEffectTriggerCount), CreateTokenCopyOfTargetPermanentEffect (Kambal: one entry over all token ids), CreateTokenCopyOfEnteringTokenForTargetPlayerEffect (first token only). The count-only overload passes no token ids, so the copy handlers return false. No lost-ability check on watchers; Elesh Norn-style suppression checked per watcher controller.

event: you commit a crime (spell/ability/trigger you control targets an opponent, their permanent, spell or graveyard card)
notes: TCS#checkCrimeTriggers (gated by GameData#isCommittedCrime) -> dispatchSlot. Called from ~17 sites (SpellCastingService, AbilityActivationService x7, ActivatedAbilityExecutionService, TriggeredAbilityQueueService, ETBTokenTargetService, PermanentChoiceTriggerHandlerService, StackedDividedDamageTriggerService). dispatchSlot already unwraps OncePerTurnTriggerEffect, so Misc#handleCrimeOncePerTurn is dead on this path; Misc#handleCrimeConditional checks intervening-if then leaves the wrapper; default: graveyard target -> SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger, other target -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger. MayEffect/MayPayManaEffect stay wrapped.

event: an opponent commits a crime
notes: Same reader/handlers as ON_CONTROLLER_COMMITS_CRIME, over every non-committing player's battlefield.

event: you commit a crime
notes: Read at the end of TCS#checkCrimeTriggers: getEffectiveGraveyardEffects -> TCS#queueGraveyardCrimeTrigger (enqueueTrigger with graveyardEntryVersion); MayPayManaEffect stays wrapped.

event: this card becomes plotted
notes: Zone is exile (the plotted card), not battlefield. TCS#checkPlotTriggers: all registrations in ONE stack object (Aloe Alchemist's two registrations = one ability); any permanent/player target -> PlotTriggerAnyTarget, else enqueueTrigger. Callers: SpellCastingService (plot special action), StackResolutionService, CardChoiceHandlerService, ExileTargetSpellAndPlotEffectHandler.

event: an Aura you control becomes attached to an opponent's nonland permanent with mana value <= the Aura's
relation: you control (Aura); attached permanent opponent controls
notes: TCS#checkAuraAttachedTriggers(Permanent,UUID) (~27 call sites): skips hasLostAllAbilities; compares printed mana values (enchanted.getCard().getManaValue()); no registry. SURPRISE: the stack entry's source permanent id is the Aura's id (not the watcher's) and targetId = attached permanent, non-targeting, so the effect (GainControlOfAuraAttachedPermanentEffect) can track the Aura.

event: (unused)
notes: SURPRISE: dead constant - no card registers it and no engine code reads it; TCS#checkEquipmentAttachedTriggers reads ON_EQUIPMENT_ATTACHED instead. agent-docs TRIGGER_SLOT_TARGETING.md and CARD_PATTERNS_PERMANENTS_ARTIFACTS.md (Assimilation Aegis) still document it as live.

event: this Vehicle becomes crewed (crew ability resolves)
notes: SURPRISE: Javadoc says 'for the first time each turn' but the code fires on every crew; only Mindlink Mech wraps OncePerTurnTriggerEffect (Ghost Ark, Mobilizer Mech, Protean War Engine are every-time per Oracle, so code is right and the Javadoc is wrong). TCS#checkBecomesCrewedTriggers from AnimationSupport (crew animation): registry.dispatch directly (no ability-loss check, no copies, no granted) -> Misc#handleBecomesCrewedOncePerTurn / #handleBecomesCrewedDefault (targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger).

event: this becomes saddled (unsaddled -> saddled when the saddle ability resolves)
notes: TCS#checkBecomesSaddledTriggers from BecomeSaddledUntilEndOfTurnEffectHandler: registry.dispatch directly (no ability-loss check, no copies, no granted) -> Misc#handleBecomesSaddledOncePerTurn / #handleBecomesSaddledDefault; neither handler supports targets (always enqueueTrigger).

event: a creature you control mutates
notes: TCS#checkMutateTriggers (from MutationSupport): first every card in the merged permanent, then every other permanent of the controller; registry.dispatch directly (no ability-loss check, no copies, no granted) -> Misc#handleAllyCreatureMutatesDefault: non-targeting, targetId = mutated permanent, enqueueTrigger.

event: this permanent mutates
relation: this (every card in the merged permanent)
notes: TCS#checkMutateTriggers dispatches each card of the merged permanent (sourceCard = that card) via registry.dispatch directly (no ability-loss check, no copies). Misc#handleSelfMutatesDefault re-reads the slot: registrations sharing a target-group index (getEffectTargetIndex) go into one stack object queued by the first of the group; untargeted registrations are one stack object each. Targeted -> SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget, else enqueueTrigger; MayEffect stays wrapped.

event: a source deals noncombat damage to a creature
multiplicity: per damaged creature per damage application
notes: The draft's 13.3 is wrong: the slot is noncombat only. TriggerCollectionService#checkAllySourceDealtNoncombatDamageToCreatureTriggers, called from DamageSupport's noncombat permanent-damage path (handlers drop noncreature recipients). Handlers: ConditionalEffect (intervening-if at trigger, Crude Abattoir door) and PerpetuallyBoostCreatureCardInHandEffect enqueue nonTargeting with a source snapshot. SURPRISE: the DrawCardEffect handler hard-codes Taii Wakeen's 'damage equal to that creature's toughness' check, so any DrawCardEffect in this slot inherits it. No default handler.

event: a creature becomes tapped
notes: SURPRISE: never registered on a card - only the key of a TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility from RegisterGlobalTriggeredAbilityUntilNextTurnEffect (Don't Move, a scheme spell). TCS#checkEnchantedPermanentTapTriggers calls collectTemporaryGlobalTriggers when the tapped permanent is a creature; TCS#enqueueTemporaryGlobalTrigger sets triggeringPermanentId = tapped creature; one non-targeting entry per watcher.
